The Founding Primus, Napoli the Second

Being the first leader chosen by the Sentinel to bear the Orchestrate carrying Their power, Napoli the Second was the commander who brought an end to the War of Faith, restoring both unified belief and territory to the people of Rinascita.
His ten-year reign brought legal reforms that standardized Rinascita's confused patchwork of laws. Furthermore, by the Sentinel's will, he also oversaw the propagation of the "Common Echoes," designed to shepherd the people back towards a life of normalcy. Under his watch, the Council of Ten was established to balance and legislate between the interests of nobility and common folk.
However, the exhaustive task of laying Rinascita's very foundations ultimately claimed this remarkable Primus. He did not live to see Rinascita grow to its full potential (a point of contention to this day).

The Gilded Primus, Clement

Clement, the sole Primus to hail from the Fisalia bloodline, led the formal codification of the Order's doctrines with the help of the Fisalias. Backed by his family's immense wealth, he elevated the Order's reach and influence to new heights. However, his mental stability deteriorated in later years, leading to erratic attempts to alter the fundamental doctrines—until his unexpected death.
Official historiography attributes his demise to undisclosed and secretive Fisalia rituals. Yet, whether his fractured mind was a consequence of these rituals or the influence of other dark forces remains a compelling subject of discussion.

The Technocrat Primus, Vester the First

A visionary who placed great faith in scientific progress, Primus Vester the First spearheaded the continuous development of Common Echo technology.
His most enduring achievement was the refinement of frequency editing, which lowered the time necessary to bridge the residual frequencies of Tacet Discords and solidified the Order's control over the long-range aggregation technology. For the first time, all Order-operated Common Echoes within Rinascita were able to maintain a state of perpetual frequency aggregation.
This achievement rendered the routine recall and destruction of Echoes obsolete, except in special circumstances. It was a major leap in overcoming the spatiotemporal constraints on Common Echoes and greatly enhanced their stability.

The Carnevale Primus, Pettini

A ruler of extraordinary openness and tolerance, Pettini ushered in an era of unprecedented prosperity. Society flourished, marked by remarkable advancements in technology and philosophy. Yet, as the constraints of tradition fell away, the people plunged into recklessness. With their faith eroded, they started to question the Divinity. What began as enlightenment devolved into dissension.
Thus, Pettini became the architect of ruinous revelry. Over time, the reformists rose in opposition and stripped him of the Primus Seat.
Shortly before his death, Pettini uttered these heretical words: "The Order of the Deep is already a swamp. The statutes, the deeds, the words—they are all twisted. We are beyond salvation... so why not just laugh?"

The Reformist Primus, Podolisk

Primus Podolisk personally executed his predecessor, whose reign had descended into grotesque decadence. Through this bold action, Podolisk averted the fragmentation of Rinascita and guided the people back to the path of unity. He restructured the Council of Ten into the Order Tribunal and tasked it with mediating civil disputes, prosecuting political crimes, and overseeing public affairs.
In his twilight years, Podolisk enacted sweeping theological reforms that would forever alter some of the Order's doctrine. Where previous teachings had maintained that Sentinel Imperator held a high position among many divine beings, Podolisk declared Imperator to be the one true Divinity. As a result, He issued a decree forbidding Acolytes from venerating any other deities.
Annals of Past Primuses (Volume One, Excerpts)

The two great families diverged on the question of whether a formal faith should be established for the Sentinel.

The Fisalias argued that Rinascita must not retread the fate of the fallen archipelagos and could no longer endure fragmented governance. They advocated for a unifying faith to guide its people, with the Sentinel as the ideal deity. In their view, establishing this faith would also serve as Rinascita's expression of gratitude toward the Sentinel.

Contrasting sharply with this view, the Abrogati warriors held that the Sentinel was a rare and unrepeatable miracle that could not be summoned at will. To place one's hope in a Divinity whose presence is uncertain, they argued, was both foolish and cowardly. The Sentinel had already demonstrated immense benevolence by guiding the people of Rinascita to new lands. To continue praying for further intervention was inapropriate. Instead, they insisted that people must strive to become warriors worthy of standing alongside such a divine being, facing calamity not through supplication, but through strength.

The difference between the two forces steep in historical tensions eventually erupted into large-scale conflict. It was only when Tacet Discords attacked Rinascita that both sides realized their new land was far from a place where they could rest easy.

In the aftermath of the Tacet Discord Crisis and following lengthy negotiations, the Abrogati and their supporters moved westward into the wilds, where they founded Septimont. Meanwhile, the Fisalias led those who remained in establishing what would become Ragunna.
The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 1)

After the Fisalia family established the Sentinel faith and positioned themselves at the core of the religious structure, an increasing number of people in Ragunna began to dream of a fish imbued with divine presence. This phenomenon was especially common among the fishing communities who often went out to sea. When fishermen prayed to this fish in their dreams, their prayers were answered—sometimes with a more bountiful catch, other times by safely avoiding an approaching storm...

These accumulating small miracles over time gave rise to a new faith. While practitioners maintained their devotion to the Sentinel, they increasingly directed prayers to the dreamt fish, drawn by its tangible blessings.

Fearing crackdowns from the Fisalia family, followers of this new faith dared only to spread their belief within a limited circle among the lower classes. Yet as more discovered their shared worship of the same divine fish, a new clandestine group arose.
The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 2)

On the same fateful day, both leaders of the Order, Napoli the First and Napoli the Second, received divine revelations. After deliberation, they agreed that Napoli the Second would embark on a pilgrimage befitting the revelations, while Napoli the First would remain behind to lead the faithful.

In the third year of Napoli the Second's departure, Napoli the First suddenly fell ill and died, leaving the Order leaderless. When the Fisalia family caught wind, a war over authority to interpret the faith was inevitable.

Many believed this conflict would continue indefinitely, but a Dark Tide broke the stalemate. Inexorable in its advance, the Dark Tide indiscriminately overran the homes of all Rinascitans. The Tacet Discords, which surged from the Tides, were so relentless that both warring sides found themselves exhausted and forced into retreat. As each side prepared for a desperate final battle, Napoli the Second returned from his pilgrimage with a sacred lantern-shaped relic which a flood of Divine Envoys emerged, turning the tide of battle.

Following this event, Napoli the Second's prestige soared. Recognizing that their situation was untenable, the Fisalia family initiated peace talks with The Order. The precise details of the negotiation have been lost to time, as only a handful were present when Napoli the Second entered the gate of Fisalia castle, bearing a tightly bound sword.

Following these talks, Napoli the Second's coronation as Primus proceeded without opposition, and governance of Ragunna transitioned to The Order of the Deep.
The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 3)

Septimont—A City of Warriors Where Faith Runs Thin
 
In ancient times, Ragunna and Septimont were among the earliest settlements during the Age of a Thousand Islands. The conflicts in that distant age drove a wedge between the two, leading them down separate paths and shaping two distinct societies with their own customs and cultures. Unlike Ragunna, the Sentinel's blessings have not reached Septimont, for its people long ago abandoned their faith. "Excuse me... I'd like to read this book. Do I need to register here?"
 
Accompanying the timid voice before me was a biography, its cover bearing the portrait of the Blessed Maiden. I looked up from the desk and saw a small girl with pale violet curls. "You're free to read anything here. Just remember to put the books away when you're done," I said as gently as I could, worried the solemn atmosphere of the library might frighten her away.
 
She was clearly not an Avinoleum student, yet she began appearing regularly in the library in the days that followed. She wandered between the circular shelves, always quietly absorbed in whatever book she picked up. Sometimes she asked me to help her find specific texts. Some were dense theological books, while others were thick volumes on the ocean or pharmacology—not quite the usual interests for someone her age. We grew acquainted. I learned that she'd been brought to Avinoleum by her relatives. They had their own matters to attend to and left her to wander freely in this comparatively safe library.
 
Her departure was as sudden as her arrival. That afternoon, as if answering some unseen summons, she closed the book in her hands and slid it back onto the shelf. I remember it. It was a study of the traditions of the Blessed Maiden in Ragunna. In the slanting dusk light, a long shadow stretched across the floor. Her guardian, presumably.
 
"Thank you for looking after me these past few days." She stood in front of me, doing her best to smile. "Cantarella... I'm Cantarella Fisalia."
 
That surname explained a great many things. Her belated introduction. The sorrow hidden in her words. The flicker of bitterness as she looked toward the door. I rose and took her hand. At the very least, I didn't want her to feel alone on the walk back to the threshold.

[Overview] 
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords. 
These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition. 
As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

[Appendix: Echoes] 
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization. 
Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord. 
This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo — a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.

[Introduction]  

Huaxu Academy, a renowned scientific research center in Jinzhou, boasts a rich academic heritage and cutting-edge technology. 
As a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, it has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. 
The academy maintains a high level of independence in its research pursuits, while also actively engaging in academic exchanges with other institutions within Huanglong and beyond. In fact, it was once a key collaborator of the Court of Savantae. Comprised of four primary departments, each with its own specialized functions, Huaxu Academy conducts parallel and cooperative research initiatives. 
Ad hoc project teams are also formed to tackle major challenges as they arise. While the president oversees administrative affairs, the Principal Investigator serves as the academic leader of the academy.

Department of Anomaly Studies:  
The Department of Anomaly Studies researches and analyzes abnormal occurrences, constructs theories based on these events, and devises preventative measures. This includes the Resonance Beacon network model and Wutherological Climate studies in Jinzhou.

Department of Laboratory Evaluation: 
The Department of Laboratory Evaluation analyzes and simulates anomalies using different theories to find optimal solutions. They also design the internal structure of Resonance Beacon and Terminal for effective use.

Department of Safety: 
The Department of Safety researches and supports the elimination of Tacet Discord. They design models of the Tacetite Weapon for the Resonator and create countermeasure equipment for civilians.
Main Disciplines: TD Ecoacoustics, Resonology.  

Department of Resources:  
The Department of Resources primarily studies Waveworn substances, processes field materials for research samples, and contributes to the Department of Laboratory Evaluation and Safety.
Main Disciplines: Wuthermaterials, TD Ecoacoustics, Plant Ecoacoustics.

Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition) Many non-initiates misunderstand the Order of Deep and feel overwhelmed by words in the Codex such as "grace," "salvation," "mercy," and "faith." Indeed, never has the Sentinel Imperator revealed Their true form. So why then, are we to believe in Their existence? The chronicles of Rinascita record numerous battles of the Sentinel against the Lament. The ruins and wonders across Rinascita bear witness to Imperator's divine authority. Their destined path created a better world for mankind, leaving us to shape a new future, while They, silently watch over us. We are grateful for Their blessings. We honor Their teachings. We follow in Their deeds by disseminating wisdom that guides all towards good—such is the mission of the Order of Deep. Under Cassilin the Knowledgeable, we have compiled this introduction to elucidate upon the meaning of the Sentinel and our Order. This we hope inspires followers on the path of virtue. We begin with some frequently asked questions: 1. Who is Sentinel Imperator? Sentinel Imperator embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. It is important to note that we acknowledge other divine beings, for They have spoken of Sentinels in distant lands, with powers that control day and night, the flow of time, or all knowledge and wisdom. Without exception, all Sentinels selflessly guide humanity and shepherd civilization. As such, all Sentinels are great divinities. However We believe Sentinel Imperator holds foremost power to "Split." That is, They split the ocean, granting humanity land on which to "breathe." By right of Their providence, Imperator is elevated among all Sentinels. 2. What is the Order's doctrine? This mortal world is a boundless sea in which every soul must swim up to the divine. Life flows in waves, and only by reaching the shore do we reach the dawn of civilization. Our Sentinel is salvation from the gales and tides, is the unity from which Rinascita was born, and is ascension for our souls. The Order's doctrines are thus: “Salvation," "Ascension," and "Unity." - Salvation: By the grace of the Sentinel, Their followers must deliver salvation to others. Nary are we blind to injustice or suffering. We labor to save others from sin. To the wicked, the Order provides salvation, and for the unrepentant, may we exact penitence. - Ascension: To find salvation is to seek ascension. Members of the Order will not indulge Their favor in idle pleasures or desires. All must elevate their spirit through self-discipline or risk sinking into the abyss. - Unity: After granting us Their representation on earth, Sentinel Imperator left Rinascita in our care. Members of the Order are "brothers and sisters," who unite people of faith, regardless of origin or background. Only as one can we fortify ourselves from the perils of the deep sea. The first Primus, Napoli the Second, received a prophecy from the Sentinel: in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth. Those saved must "breathe," to "ascend" in "unity" on new land, just as we once answered the Sentinel's call and made landfall on Rinascita. 3. Is there evidence to support the doctrine of the Order? Theology is a science humanity has not yet fully understood in theory or practice. The Sentinel guides civilization, and we trust Their word. Throughout the generations, the Order has established the following philosophical precepts. Excerpts from The Philosophy of the Order: Sacred Knowledge (Volume 1: Water): On Origin: Genesis in "Water." In nature "Water" is infinite as it is universal. In the beginning, Sentinel Imperator "split" this world, once a formless ocean, into the realm of land and sea. On Motion: Movement through "Water." The motion of "Water" heats and cools, wets and dries the realm of land. From water, all life was created in the "First Wave" and will end in the "Last Wave." On Revelations: Refractions of "Water." Man's image reflected by "Water" is a strange reality unto himself. So too applies to all reality when water refracts the world unto the Sonoro Sphere. Through reforms by successive Primuses, we have come to emphasize the scientific and practical application of our philosophical understanding. Readers may visit Arito Well in the Square of Liberty to experience the mysteries of "water divination": toss a coin into the well, make a heartfelt wish, and answers you shall receive. We would be greatly honored if this Codex engenders interest in the Sentinel's teachings, and we welcome all to the Order's library, where supplementary literature is available to borrow. While words are a paltry means to express the Sentinel's grand purpose, we nonetheless hope to have adequately conveyed fractions of divine essence. Let miracles recorded in the Codex be "symbols" of infinite, communicable power. Through narratives of common understanding, we envision a world of unwavering faith. Even as the Lament threatens to return, we reaffirm our place and purpose. We pray that believers and non-believers alike will view the text herein as an invitation for communion and reflection. May these words offer insight to us adrift at sea. The paths are many, but with virtue in our hearts, we illuminate a way amidst the waves.

From that moment on, she seized every chance to pester the visiting Spacetrek Collective researchers with endless questions. It was also the point when the more conservative members of her tribe began to alienate her for her newfound obsession.

…In short, developing high-performance combat mechs had become a pressing need.

The project was assigned to a pair of twin researchers: an older sister who was bold and daring, and a younger sister who was quiet and steady. Their personalities shaped the Twin Nova series they created.

The melee model, Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade, engages with fast and aggressive actions, while its ranged counterpart, Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon, prefers to stay back and provide support. Their very names embody the Spacetrek Collective's mission: to descend into the unknown as they continue to reach for the stars.

The idea of building the mechs in pairs began as something almost poetic. The Threnodian of Void, Aleph-1, erases individuals from memory, and the twins couldn't imagine a world where they might forget each other. They hoped their creations, at least, would always have a companion and never face that silence alone. While Aleph-1's influence may not extend to inorganic matter, this sentiment became the emotional core of the Twin Nova project.

This philosophy also influenced their form. The Collective opted for humanoid frames to symbolize humanity's presence on the frontier. Rumor has it the design also helps them seem less intimidating when serving as security at Startorch Academy, and perhaps caters to a few researchers' personal tastes.

An autonomous tactical intelligence model was built for the units. However, with little combat data available in the Collective, the sisters had to pilot the prototypes themselves to generate the initial data. Their influence made the Twin Nova units move with a graceful, almost showy flair, a style that is sometimes more artistic than practical.

Now, with the accumulating real combat data, the models continue to evolve. The melee unit leads the charge and breaks through enemy lines, while the ranged unit coordinates with human teams, offering support fire and protecting the formation.

The sprawling, secret-filled lands of Lahai-Roi made it necessary for the Spacetrek Collective to establish mid-to-long-term field research programs. However, sustaining these operations in such dangerous terrain required dependable mobile bases.

After weighing its options, the Collective developed a versatile transport platform capable of handling logistics, storage, and emergency defense. They named it Spacetrek Explorer.

The Explorer's design is based on a wheel robot. Its massive tires provide exceptional grip, allowing it to climb smooth vertical surfaces and easily navigate the dense architecture of Startorch Academy, delivering cargo to otherwise inaccessible locations. The large storage container mounted on its top further supports fieldwork, enabling researchers to access supplies or auxiliary equipment directly on-site.

To defend against the Exoswarm affected by the Waveworn Phenomenon and attacks from Outcasts, the Explorer is equipped with a heavy electromagnetic cannon and a protective shield projector. However, due to its weight, frequent cargo load, and energy-saving design, it carries only small thrusters. These are useful for brief bursts of acceleration, but not for sustained flight.

In addition to field expeditions, the Spacetrek Explorer now serves as one of Lahai-Roi's primary heavy logistics vehicles. In its logistics configuration, its weapons are removed and replaced with expanded storage modules to maximize cargo capacity.

Operators must follow the steps below with strict attention to operate Route Constructors.

Step 1: Put in the required amount of Compressed Bedrock.
Note: Compressed Bedrock is processed material made of natural minerals. After refining native Lahai-Roi stone, the Spacetrek Collective produces a high-density construction medium. Once parsed and separated by the Route Constructor, it can be combined with other resources to form structural baseplates for various building types.

Step 2: Put in the required amount of Mechanite.
Note: Mechanite is a native Lahai-Roi mineral. After the arrival of the Exostrider, mechanical patterns and structures started to grow on it under the influence. The Collective has found that electronic devices made with this mineral exhibit increased computational performance, as if the Mechanite itself has processing capability.

Step 3: Put in the required amount of Constructor Cores.
Note: Constructor Cores are artificial power units designed for the equipment's operation. Since the Route Constructor's immense energy demands, remote deployment, and single-use nature make stable energy lines impractical, the Collective developed these cores to serve as portable, reusable batteries." They are charged by focusing the Reactor's light through a Solis Lens Array.

Step 4: Verify the construction blueprint.
Note: Blueprints are usually pre-loaded during setup. Only a simple confirmation is required.

Step 5: Ensure the construction area is fully cleared of any personnel, animals, or Exoswarm units.

Step 6: Activate the Route Constructor."

The Relay Station combines garage, warehouse, rest areas, and basic laboratory facilities in a single complex, providing support for arduous field research and logistics operations. One of its key services is vehicle rental.

The station primarily offers three types of vehicles:
- Hauler: A large vehicle designed for transporting heavy cargo.
- Pathfinder: A medium-sized vehicle for personnel transfer, with limited cargo capacity.
- Sprinter: A small vehicle optimized for rapid, solo transport.
 
Due to limited vehicle availability, all applicants must submit a formal request. The staff will review each application and assign vehicles based on demonstrated need.

'Lately, it seems like all the Haulers in Lahai-Roi are heading to the Spacetrek Observatory. Just how massive is that project?'

The Spacetrek Observatory stands as a monumental achievement co-built by the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya. Its mission is to map Lahai-Roi's various data points. Unlike the Cassettes that store personal data, the Observatory primarily captures and tracks the changes in Lahai-Roi's terrain, ecology, climate, and sky under the influence of Void Storms and Threnodian activity.

As our partnership with the Roya deepened, the Observatory grew to also document their architecture and cultural landmarks. But then, disaster struck. A devastating Void Storm swept through, leaving the structure in ruins. Although the Academy has started the reconstruction, progress has been painstakingly slow. The sheer number of ongoing projects across Lahai-Roi, coupled with the damaged roads leading to the site, has left this massive facility languishing.

That concludes the introduction to the Spacetrek Observatory. I trust you can now appreciate its importance. Despite the current challenges, its restoration is a necessity! That is why I am calling on each and every one of you to join me in this vital endeavor. We need your help, in whatever form you can offer. Every contribution matters.

My name is Rakosan. I will be here, at the Spacetrek Observatory, waiting for you!

Alienated by their tribes, openly rejecting tradition, or lured by an insatiable curiosity for a world they had never seen, a group of Roya set out on a path separate from their people. They began trading in Exostrider cell remnants and Exoswarm materials to fulfill their own desires.

Their actions were intolerable to the rest of the Roya. As a result, they were exiled and branded Outcasts. But they did not see this as a punishment, but a liberation, a chance to embrace their true natures. They spread across Lahai-Roi, becoming a force of unrestrained chaos. Their defiance was more than a simple rejection of tradition. They actively inverted it, mocking the old ways in every gesture, every object, and every action.

They cast aside ornaments drawn from nature, instead tearing skulls from the Exoswarm to wear as grisly masks. They reforged their Shepherd's Staffs into weapons.

But what exactly is their purpose? Some say they see themselves as the new, true branch of the Roya, striving to carve out a place in a changing world. These, however, are only rumors. In truth, the Outcasts demonstrate no unified ideology and voice no common demands. They appear consumed instead by the thrill of discovery and the hunt for the Exoswarm.

Panhua Restaurant
A store selling a variety of pharmaceuticals, various daily medicinal drugs you need can be found here.
Shifang Pharmacy
The Huaxu Academy's experimental project offers generous rewards. Conquer the tower's challenges for great prizes.

Dreaming Deep

Located in Huanglong's bustling city of Jinzhou, Mahe runs an honest grocery store. Despite being a practical worker, his insistence on using the best ingredients for tasty dishes has caused a rift with his wife. The couple now lives apart, their marriage strained by his unwavering dedication to quality.
Mahe's Grocery
Exchange offices found in major cities, where you can use Interferences to exchange for rare supplies.

This shop offers a variety of potions and essential medicines for daily needs.

The wind whispers, the water gurgles, the birds chirp. Each sound, a delicate note in the symphony of memories past.\nCollecting Windchimers and delivering them to Xian'ge will be rewarded with various gifts.\nGather the scattered Windchimers and let the melody resonate again.
Repaired Strings, Preserved Melodies

Mist rises over the sea, carrying echoes from all directions—songs, the creak of windmills, and the bustling noise of city streets. For sailors weary from the monotony of life at sea, these sounds become an irresistible siren call. Entranced, they steer their ships toward the heart of the mist, unaware they are sailing straight into the Tacet Discord's trap…\nBut as in every tale where despair festers, a glimmer of hope is bound to emerge. Even in these treacherous waters, someone will break the storm and waves and bring light to all.
Whimpering Wastes

An exchange run by KU-Money, one of the Black Shores' administrator droids. It offers high-quality services to Black Shores members and also helps to build the organization's wealth from around the world.
KU-Money Exchange

The Gondola Market drifts along the canals, laden with flowers, fruits, and ingredients, native and exotic. The gondalas arrive with goods and depart with stacks of Shell Credits. With each fair trade, they sing warm, cheerful tunes. Yet when deals turn sour, they weep and wail.
Gondola Market

In Ragunna, the old Monnaies have long been replaced by Shell Credits. At Averardo Bank, the dedicated teller Mercurio is always on the lookout to recover any remaining pieces of this historic currency.
Averardo Bank Counter

Rosemary's Apothecary is known for its artful blending of medicine and poison. The owner, Rosemary, is a skilled Fisalia pharmacist, yet whispers surrounding the Fisalia family have kept many Ragunnesi wary, leaving her shop particularly lack of customers.
Rosemary's Apothecary

A beloved restaurant in the heart of Ragunna whose offerings nourishes both body and soul. Margherita, the chef and owner, is famed for her mastery of the Echo Cooker, and no guest leaves without feeling well-fed and content—satisfaction is practically a rule here, after all.
Trattoria Margherita

In the quiet corners of Egla Town lies Vida's Stillwind Grocery. Once a traveling merchant known around Ragunna, Vida now lives simply but still keeps a special price list for trusted patrons, filled with rare, hard-to-find treasures...
Stillwind Sundries

For a taste of classic Ragunna, this century-old bakery in Egla Town is undoubtedly the best choice. Loyal to tradition, it serves Ragunna's most beloved recipes. Just be sure to respect the local culinary culture when you meet the owner...
Burrata Bakery
Remember, darling, that costumes and masks are mere florid facades. Beneath their elegance and beauty lie not refined ladies and gentlemen, but seductive and deadly perils.
Masked Reverie

A member of the Plushies Gang on a mission to restore the power of the morph painting. She trades the items she discovers for Sonance Caskets.\n\n"The day will come when every wandering Echo finds their own home."
Teensy Weensy

The Pioneer Association’s Ragunna branch is run by the Wutherium Film Studio, a division focused on visual documentation, aiming to reveal both the devastation and transformations brought by disaster.\nWutherium Film Studio captures these endless changes through the lens, encouraging humanity to look anew at the world around them.
Pioneer Association
A remarkable Common Echo with an innate talent for melody and rhythm, capable of conducting Notepoles to perform any composition as long as it has a score to follow.
Archive of Melodies
A Supply Station set up for Acolytes living in the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Butler, the store's Steward, is running low on Sacred Salt, and he's willing to trade.
Steward's Supply Station
Now, let us shine a spotlight on this unique chemical reaction!
Synthesizer

One of the comprehensive journal databases that requires the highest level of access clearance in Solaris. It serves as the portal to the academic resources of the Spacetrek Collective and Startorch Academy. The archive is managed by the Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System, known as I.R.I.S.
Spacetrek Archive

Resonator Nursing Unit is the Academy's infirmary, operating as an affiliate of Rabelle College. It is renowned for its specialization in Frequency Therapeutics. The facility is led by Head Physician Luuk Herssen, with the assistance of N.A.N.A., the Nightingale Autonomous Nursing Assistant.
Resonator Nursing Unit

An open-air trading hub between Startorch Academy and the Roya. During designated hours, Royan merchants arrive with local ingredients and wares, allowing students and faculty to obtain unique Lahai-Roi specialties.
Royan Market

This station is located within Exo Genesis Labs, an experimental field that uses lunar soil samples to create a microgravity environment. Here, prehistoric plants are induced to undergo mutation, enhancing their nutritional value and functional traits. The resulting ingredients are processed at this station to produce convenient "space food" designed to boost intellect, stamina, and Forte, suitable for consumption in any environment.
Culinary Station

The Synth Armament crafting facility under the Division of Tactical Development. It integrates Exoswarm biomorphic traits into Tacetite weapons, allowing automatic frequency adaptation and progressive performance improvement through repeated use.
Synth Armament Crafting Bay
Arsenio uses his device to purify their Voidmatter contamination, restoring the voices of the departed as proof of their existence.
Lahai-Roi: Tape of Last Words Collector

Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi.\nSeek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Soliseed Plains. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.
Monument of Returning Soliseeds

A parking lot for Academy students and faculty to station their Motorbikes. Mr. S.I.G.M.A., its administrator and traffic overseer, is committed to providing upgrades and maintenance services for every rider, perfectly safe and by the book.
Auto Parking & Engineering Xpertise

anh_en: Who’s that?

speaker: Thiển Sơn (Đang liên lạc)

speaker: Thiển Sơn (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: By the way. Take care of the dogs in the camp, because they’re sensitive to unfamiliar scents. Don’t get found out by them.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Am I seeing things, or did that giant bird just transform?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: There it goes again! It transforms the second it moves between ice and forest!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It's an animal in the forest and a machine on the ice!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Are we... are we flying? AHHHHHH!!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It flew off that way! What a total path of destruction. No wonder they ditched the facilities.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Huh? Someone's over there.

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Child of Sol… you have come home…

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Child of Sol, the eye through which the Roya behold the world… You are home at last...

speaker: NPC #750346

The one I just ran into?

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Yes… that is the one.

speaker: NPC #750346

speaker: NPC #750346

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Ever since it left the flock, it has lost its balance, turning volatile and easily enraged.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Until one day, I noticed traces of Void Storm contamination on it.
That's why it lost control…

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: No… I believe some of its consciousness remains.
What makes you say so?
Child of Sol?

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Unlike other rampaging Exoswarm, it didn't destroy everything in its path. And it kept moving in one direction.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: I decided to follow it further… and it eventually led me here.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: You now stand on land where the Roya ancestors once lived in ages past.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: In those distant times, the Roya lived within a flourishing forest known as the Upphaf Forest, and the Kronaclaws ruled the skies above.

speaker: NPC #750346

So you're saying...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So you're saying this Kronablight is trying to go home?

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Yes… I can think of no other reason for it to return here.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But it tried to attack me earlier…

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: I believe there must be a reason. At least, it has never harmed me.
The eye of Roya?

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: It seems that you, like me, still harbor doubts.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Then let us go to its side, shall we? I, too, wish to know what has truly happened to it.
Are you the one who sent the WavesLine message?

speaker: NPC #750346

speaker: NPC #750346

Why are you here?
What did your message mean?

speaker: NPC #750346

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Before ice and snow sealed this land, the Kronaclaws stood at the apex of all predators, and the towering trees were but their roosts.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: But just as the great trees were entombed in permafrost… the once-supreme raptors now survive only in bodies of steel borrowed from the Exostrider.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Child, why...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It can't hear you anymore.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: {PlayerName}, watch out!

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: No… this should never have come to this...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It got away! But looks like it left something behind…

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Upphaf Forest is awakening… It was that child's work!

speaker: NPC #750346

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: The elders of our people have long said that this frozen remnant of Upphaf Frost was once our homeland.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: All of this… was that Kronablight's doing. It was trying to restart these facilities, to recreate the forest.
Can it truly be restored?

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Before we entered this place, I met a researcher.

speaker: NPC #750346

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: The Research Institute must have drawn upon the Exostrider's power.
That does sound suspicious.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's investigate the facility.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, this thing smells like that huge furnace that fell from the sky.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: {PlayerName}, may I ask a favor of you? If you uncover any clues regarding its whereabouts, would you be willing to inform me?

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Even if it has been contaminated, I wish to see it one last time. Such is my duty, as a Shepherd, to the Exoswarm I once tended.
Of course.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: I do not presume to speak for the Exostrider. But for the Exoswarm, and for that Kronablight, I thank you from my heart.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Then I shall wait for your message… and continue my search for it nearby.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Until we meet again.
The scent's similar to the Reactor Drive...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Then this must be part of the Exostrider.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: That explains everything...

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: This facility was originally part of the Exostrider, much like the Exoswarm themselves. That is why the Kronablight could activate it.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: But it still attacked us!

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: That was because...
Because it was contaminated by the Void Storm.

speaker: NPC #750346
anh_en: Yes… I wonder where it has gone now…
You have received a message from an unknown sender. IP: Upphaf Life Chamber.

speaker: NPC #701085

speaker: NPC #701085
anh_en: I need to know what drew it to this place.

speaker: NPC #701085
anh_en: This place feels... magical. It's as if I have returned home.

anh_en: This is horrifying...

anh_en: Is that bird ever going away...

anh_en: This is horrifying... Is that bird ever going away...

anh_en: It allows us to research prehistoric life frozen beneath the ice.

anh_en: Because of staff shortages, it hasn't operated for years...

anh_en: The Research Institute recently launched a reconstruction project, and I was part of the first survey team.

speaker: NPC #750345
anh_en: But the moment I arrived, a Kronablight barged in…

anh_en: Kronablights are powerful Exoswarm. They resemble a kind of ancient raptor once native to this land.

speaker: NPC #750345
anh_en: I need to understand its behavioral patterns before the reconstruction can continue...

speaker: NPC #750345
anh_en: It's been four system hours… Why won't it leave?

anh_en: Message? What message?

anh_en: I may scare easily... but I wouldn't shirk responsibility. I don't call for backup unless absolutely necessary.

speaker: NPC #750345
anh_en: So no, I didn't send any WavesLine message! That said... if you're kind enough to offer help, I won't stop you.

speaker: NPC #750345
anh_en: One more encounter with that bird and I might lose it…

anh_en: Ahhh, stay back! Don't eat me!

anh_en: If you have a good solution, I'll make sure to thank you properly!

speaker: NPC #750345
anh_en: Are you a Startorch Academy student? Or… ugh, never mind.

What is this place?
What's a Kronablight?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Okay, I wasn't expecting this much space...

anh_en: Let's get you out of these nets. The sword should do.

speaker: NPC #850312

speaker: NPC #850312

speaker: NPC #850312

speaker: NPC #850312

speaker: NPC #850312
anh_en: 'Til death and glory find us...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...Iaen.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Was his last vision a dream, or a mirage you created?

speaker: NPC #850318
anh_en: *A deep, ambiguous roar*

anh_en: At least he found peace in the end.

anh_en: I'm over here! By the hole it flew out of.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Greetings, Dragon Savior. I'm Tulia, a traveling ecologist.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: My latest research focuses on the Scourgewings, so I'm following their trail.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Ah, my notes... You mean the draft I dropped nearby? Don't worry, I've kept copies.

speaker: NPC #850296

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Until we meet again, friend.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: But what we saw earlier proves otherwise. They do exist, and not just here on the Border Mountains. There were traces of them in the Mournfell Canyon too.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: <te href=850163>The Border Mountains</te> saw the first Dark Tide. I remember hearing the Scourgewing's cry back then.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I thought maybe it was sealed away by the Dark Tide growth in some forgotten cave like so many other creatures, but I never imagined...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: That it would fly out from the Crypt like that... That sight belongs in dreams.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Ah, I've rambled long enough. Might I ask your name?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Tulia, a traveling ecologist.

anh_en: Hey, you! I saw it. That was you, wasn't it? The one who freed the Scourgewing?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I'm over here! By the hole it flew out of.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Will you come and see them if I find them again, {PlayerName}?

I want to say hi to the dragons as well.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Okay. I'll be on my way, then. Hopefully my next search won't take as long.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: After this long imprisonment, they finally can reunite with each other.
I wish them both the best.

speaker: NPC #850312
anh_en: ...That's me. But I've retired.

speaker: NPC #850311
anh_en: I still remember that match with Flavio. Now that was a fight, haha! I even had my money on you.

speaker: NPC #850312
anh_en: Ah, sorry, I must've let you down. That match was my last.

speaker: NPC #850311
anh_en: Victory and defeat come to us all. But here you are, eh? You still have a warrior's heart. I can see it.

speaker: NPC #850312
anh_en: I...I came for someone. Flavio. I owe him a clean duel.

speaker: NPC #850314

speaker: NPC #850314
anh_en: Only those who seek true glory may step forth.

speaker: NPC #850312
anh_en: They are on the move. Better keep close and quiet.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This place is falling apart... Gotta move to solid ground ahead.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Is this the Scourgewing's specter? It's guiding me...)

speaker: NPC #850315
anh_en: This Scourgewing might have some history with Flavio's one, eh?

speaker: NPC #850315
anh_en: You think they're mates? Which one is this, the male or the female?

speaker: NPC #850315
anh_en: No, nothing like that. They're siblings, maybe even twins.

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: Teeny, Arctos, and everyone got away... no one hurt...

anh_en: Chunkie can go home now...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Arctos grasps the feather tightly.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Yes, Chunkie. Let's all go home now.

speaker: NPC #350087
anh_en: Chunkie can go home now...

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: This feather... It's from my old helmet.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: We thought it would be a glorious hunt, but little did we know, we were the ones being hunted by the Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: In the end, as the corruption crawled up my helmet, it was Chunkie who charged to save me, knocking aside the tainted helm and pushing me out of harm's way.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: But Chunkie...

anh_en: Arctos, Teeny hears Chunkie's voice—

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: That's what Chunkie would've wanted.

anh_en: Woo ta, woo ta ta, ta—

speaker: NPC #350081

anh_en: I added the feather Chunkie left behind to the Hornett's tail.

anh_en: Chunkie was a Gladiator worth honoring.

anh_en: Ugh, it hurts...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Every time I hear it, it strengthens my resolve to protect those around me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The new Hornett sounds amazing! It really gets the blood pumping!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No matter how many times the Dark Tide returns, we will rise to meet it, until the applause of triumph echoes through this land once more!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hey, don't get too eager. I'd prefer the Dark Tide never return!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Still, that Hornett really does set you up in the mood for work.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yeah! Let's rebuild this camp together!

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Hold a moment, young warrior...

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Before I fainted, I last saw my children running toward the iron gates.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: It shames me to ask this of you, but… I don't know who else to turn to.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Could you help me find my children?

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: The Dark Tide ravages everything in its path. So many innocent lives lost. And the ones who went mad turned the camp upside down.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: See the claw marks around camp? My friends, fallen. My children, missing. And I... I can't lift a sword with these injuries.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Sometimes I hate these old bones of mine... I don't even know whether it's the Dark Tide or just the weight of years that's made me this useless.
I'll help you find your children.
Don't worry. Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Thank you. Young people like you always have such courage.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I sense something dangerous...

speaker: NPC #750194
anh_en: What happened at that camp over there?

speaker: NPC #750194
anh_en: I can sense it. Something dark, filthy, and dangerous...

speaker: NPC #750194
anh_en: It feels urgent, but I've still got things to take care of here...
Don't worry. I'll go check it out.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmm... looks like the danger has passed.

speaker: NPC #750195
anh_en: Looks like the danger has passed. Did you take care of it?
Yeah, that was me.
I'm just a passerby lending a hand.

speaker: NPC #750195
anh_en: Thank you so much.

speaker: NPC #750195
anh_en: You're too modest.

speaker: NPC #750195
anh_en: I see everyone working hard to rebuild the camp.

speaker: NPC #750195
anh_en: They look full of spirit.

speaker: NPC #750195
anh_en: That puts my mind at ease. Now I can focus on guarding this place.

speaker: NPC #750287
anh_en: Woo ta ta... Woo ta... Ta ta!

speaker: NPC #750288
anh_en: Woo. Wootter sees no one. Very dangerous out there. Big monster!

speaker: NPC #750288
anh_en: Wootter and friends protect camp and search outside. Wootter hurt. Must stay here.

speaker: NPC #750288
anh_en: But Wootter's friends ahead. They help you!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Wootter plucks some fur from its body and offers it to you.

speaker: NPC #750288
anh_en: Follow the scent. It leads you to them!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abby, Echo interpretation service, please.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Roger that! Your five-star Echo interpreter, at your service! Ahem... Let's try out my new emotional-adaptive mode!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Beep—loading complete! Standing by for interpretation request...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Thanks to Abby, you can now understand what the Wootter is saying.

speaker: NPC #750288
anh_en: Woo! Danger ahead!
I'm looking for someone.
Have you seen any children come this way?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby relays your words to the Wootter. Its chubby face scrunches up in confusion.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Judging by the tufts of fur scattered on the ground, a fierce fight must've taken place here.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Sensing the urgency, you press on without delay.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Woo!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Ta! Ta ta!!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Ta ta ka!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Interpret that, please, Abby.

speaker: NPC #750289
anh_en: Too dangerous. No human children would play here...

speaker: NPC #750289
anh_en: Woo ta ta ta—! Teeny! Where's Teeny?! Teeny not with us!

speaker: NPC #750291
anh_en: Teeny... Arctos's Teeny? Did monsters get Teeny?!

speaker: NPC #750290
anh_en: Save Teeny! Help us! Pleeeassse!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (They said they didn't see any human children. Could this Wooter "Teeny" be one of the children Arctos is looking for?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Only one way to find out.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Okay, I'll go find Teeny.

speaker: NPC #750290
anh_en: Thank you, woo! You a good human!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Interpreting—

speaker: NPC #750289
anh_en: Woo! So scary!

speaker: NPC #750290
anh_en: Thank you!

speaker: NPC #750291
anh_en: Whew... If Dark Tide monsters hurt Wootter... Wootter will turn scary too...

speaker: NPC #750291
anh_en: No! Wootter no want to turn into big scary monster!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Excuse me, have you seen any children around?

speaker: NPC #750291
anh_en: Children? Human children? Wootter sees no children.

speaker: NPC #750290
anh_en: Only Wootters and monsters here. No human children.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Are you alright, Teeny?
Back at the camp, Arctos notices Teeny's wounds and tends to them.

speaker: NPC #350087
anh_en: No worry, ta! But... Chunkie still out there...

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: It's okay, Teeny. I'm just glad you made it back safely.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So this is one of the children you were looking for?

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Yes… But as long as "it" is out there, this isn't over.

speaker: NPC #350087
anh_en: Teeny found Chunkie! Chunkie looks strange… hiding in the cave behind big stone.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Young warrior, would you be willing to search this cave with us? I should handle this alone, but both Teeny and I are injured...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Just leave it to me. You two stay here and rest.

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: No… I must see this through and end it with my own hands.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A massive Hurriclaw stands in the cave, its body covered in dark, writhing growths that burst from its back.\nIts mind is corrupted. It stumbles, groaning in delirium. The cave walls bear the marks of its frenzied claws.

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: Aaarrrghhh—! It... hurts! AAAARRHHHHH!

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: It hurts... so much... Help Chunkie... End this...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You glance at Arctos. He meets your eyes and gives a gentle nod.

speaker: NPC #350087
anh_en: Wake up, Chunkie!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Hurriclaw sees Teeny and Arctos, and a spark of awareness flickers in its cloudy eyes.

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: Arctos... Teeny...

speaker: NPC #350081
anh_en: Chunkie... I'm sorry. I couldn't protect you from the Dark Tide... If only I'd been stronger...

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: Chunkie... wants to go home... with Arctos... and everyone... But Chunkie... can't control... Ngh—!

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: Chunkie looked for camp... but camp gone. Chunkie went to where Teeny, Arctos, and Chunkie played... but also gone.

speaker: NPC #350088
anh_en: Gone! The dark thing came... and all gone!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As if recalling the painful memoriees, Chunkie begins to thrash and roar in anguish.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Hey, no worries. It's pretty challenging. Even divine power can't nail it in one go.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Maybe you're a bit off today. It happens to everyone.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: I still have confidence in you. When you're feeling better, you should give it another shot!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: I'll be right here waiting for you.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Back again! Ready to fix those Sound Dampeners and tackle the TDs? Awesome!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Are you ready? We can start whenever you're ready.
I'm ready.
Not yet.
Alright, let's get started.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Okay, just take your time.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Hey, is it {PlayerName}? Mayday! Mayday! Help me!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Anyway, just come as quickly as possible. I sent the coordinates to your Terminal!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Somehow, we've detected a large wave of TDs appearing in the nearby area!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: I can't handle them alone, so I need your help.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: I'm sorry, but can you come here as soon as possible? It's really urgent.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: I'll pay you twice as much as yesterday!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Since the day I joined the Patroller, I've resolved to sacrifice my life rather than shy away from my responsibilities.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: So when there's a situation beyond my ability, I have no choice but to hire someone to help me. I must fulfill my responsibilities!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Thank goodness, you've finally arrived!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Let's hurry up. I've brought the car over, and we'll drive it to the destination.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: This one. Get in the car!
As you were about to get in, a sudden dull pain hit the back of your head. Your consciousness gradually faded away, and you passed out.

speaker: Ông Chú Từng Trải
anh_en: Are you awake?
{PlayerName}

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Okay, {PlayerName}. I'm Patroller Minghu. Pleased to meet you.
Minghu the Patroller?!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Yes. Here's my ID. If you don't trust me, use your Terminal to identify it.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: As for my clothes...

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Shh... Someone's coming.
Those red-clothed use the guise of high-paying jobs to lure people here. This is where they keep their victims.

speaker: Ông Chú Từng Trải
anh_en: The next time you encounter those ridiculously high-paying jobs, you need to think twice; there's no such thing as a free lunch.
As expected.
Stop talking all big, my dear cellmate.
Where am I?

speaker: Ông Chú Từng Trải
anh_en: Huh? Were you intentionally caught?
Yeah, I wanted to see what he was up to.
Hehe, your exceptionally huge curiosity for the truth would suit you well as a Patroller.
Yeah, I was tricked, so I'm trying to learn a lesson from it.
What happened?
Who are you?
This is where the red-clothed keep their prey. Glad to meet you. I'm your cellmate.

speaker: Ông Chú Từng Trải
anh_en: Long story short, you were tricked.
Just like you, poor kid, I was also tricked and brought here.

speaker: Ông Chú Từng Trải
anh_en: Well, since we're both stupid fools, let's exchange our names in case something happens.

speaker: Ông Chú Từng Trải
anh_en: What do you go by?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: That was fast.
Stop acting. I won't be fooled again.
Hey, don't panic. I think we can use the mechanism over there to unlock the door.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: Big misunderstanding! Once I tamper with the lock, they'll know. We're in the same boat, you know!
Don't panic. My observation tells me the laser gate can be opened once you solve the cube over there.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: Oh! Yeah, there's a mechanism over there. Looks familiar to the one {PlayerName} solved yesterday.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: But... I don't know how to solve it, and you're locked inside...

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Not a big deal. We can hear each other clearly from this distance. Just let {Male=him;Female=her} tell you how to solve it.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: You're right! Please, I'm counting on you, Teach {PlayerName}!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Relax. He's on our side.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: I'm so sorry. I was left with no choice but to kidnap you. Please forgive me.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: I'm here to make amends. Wait a sec, and I'll help you out.
Minghu took out a key and tried to unlock the door but failed.

speaker: Minghu
anh_en: Oh no, those bastards changed the lock to a laser one. The key doesn't work!
What do we do now?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Well, honestly, I'm more comfortable in this outfit.
So I was just an unfortunate victim kidnapped by you?

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Well, not exactly. Minghu told me to kidnap someone who's smart and strong. In that case, I would have a higher chance of escaping.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: That's why he lent me this outfit and told me how to activate those devices.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: So I found you! Someone who's smart and strong!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Sorry to have involved you in this because of my advice.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Sorry. But I know where they hide my money and they put your weapons there too!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: I'll take you there to get your weapons back. Oh! And please take my money as compensation. Sorry to have you involved.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Well, thinking back, it was obviously a fraud! How could one earn such a huge sum just by killing some TDs! I was blinded by greed and got carried away...

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Then I was caught by the red-clothed, and they confiscated all the money I earned from that TD-killing job... They even took away my savings!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Fantastic! Now we have time to get to know each other better. Let me reintroduce myself. I'm Xiaojue, an Exile.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: You know, us Exiles always keep our weapons handy, unless something unexpected happens. So the moment I spotted my friends' weapons, I knew they must be here. To save them, I had to...
Not a smart move.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: I was just out looking for my missing friends, but then I got lured by a high-paying job and ended up here.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: But it's not all that bad. When I got here, I stumbled upon the weapons my friends used to carry around.
So you ended up becoming their accomplice?

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Calm down, calm down. If I hadn't done this, I wouldn't have gained their trust, and I wouldn't be able to save my friends.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: So I joined them, attempting to earn their trust. Fortunately, I'm pretty smooth, and with my knowledge of the surrounding areas, they usually sent me on errands.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: ...It took me a long time before they completely trusted me. So now, they've started assigning me the task of kidnapping people.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: As long as I could kidnap someone, I would have an excuse to come to the prison.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: There we are! They have business to attend to, so no one's here.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: C'mon. Take your weapons.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hiring skilled experts to repair Sound Dampeners and expel Tacet Discords. Pays Good!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: C'mon, peoples! Don't let this chance slip by!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Oh no! How come there are guards patrolling at this time!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: No, no, no. They must've discovered that someone broke out from the prison!!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Relax. Now that we have our weapons back, we don't need to fear them. Let's take them down.
I plan to.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Wow! Impressive! With you two by my side, I don't need to fear the red-clothed.
Are you sure you two can handle this?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: To be honest, it'll be a bit challenging, but it's still within our abilities.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Besides, we don't want to further bother you with this issue. You were just unfortunately caught up in this thing.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: But... {Male=he;Female=she}'s resilient. With {Male=him;Female=her} on our side, our chances of rescuing the kidnapped will significantly improve. And... I can't bear to lose my friends.
Count me in.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Thank you. Your help means a lot to me! There are hidden treasures here, and I'll lead you to their locations!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: I really, really thank you for your help!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: The path's clear. It's not safe to stay here. {PlayerName}, you'd better get out of here before they find out.
What about you?

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: We still have companions to save! That's why Minghu's here; he won't leave unless he saves those victims.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: eah, there have been several cases of residents disappearing in my jurisdiction. My subordinates investigating the cases also went missing.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: So I pretended to be tricked and made my way here.
So you intentionally got caught?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Minghu, hurry up. "Huzi" is waiting for us to save him!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Why are there so many people here? They're talking about all this weird stuff.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: While they haven't noticed, let's take the initiative and get rid of them.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: *snort* Compared to these red-clothed folks, Patrollers are nothing to fear!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: My bad! My bosses used to say Patrollers are a bunch of fierce and ruthless guys stopping at nothing to achieve their ends.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: But after staying with Minghu for a while, I realized they lied to me!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Minghu didn't treat me poorly just because I'm an Exile. He even showed me the ropes on gaining trust and where to investigate.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Now, with {PlayerName} on board, our operation is bound to run smoother! We should be able to save them soon!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If only I had known... I should've figured out that earning a Terminal by buying a lottery ticket is downright impossible!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I feel like such a fool! How could I believe there were rich and handsome guys looking for companions? Clearly a scam!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Enough about that. We're already caught. It's too late to regret.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: By the way, have you guys heard those strange sounds lately? Like someone crying for help...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You got me thinking... There have been strange sounds for several days now.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Could there be something invisible around us?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 4
anh_en: Hey, cut the nonsense. Don't be afraid. We need to trust in science and Patrollers. Someone will come rescue us!

speaker: Phong Bách
anh_en: Patroller Minghu? Why are you here?

speaker: Phong Bách
anh_en: Dude, you probably don't know that the keys to these cell doors are carried by a junior leader.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Fengbai, did you find out anything about that junior leader?

speaker: Phong Bách
anh_en: From what I've observed, the junior leader should be in the room next door at this time.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Good, we'll be back soon.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: I'm here to save you, of course.

speaker: Gia Minh
anh_en: Patroller! It's a Patroller! We're saved!

speaker: Miêu Tam
anh_en: Xiaojue!!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Maosan! Are you okay? What about Gousi?

speaker: Miêu Tam
anh_en: I'm fine, but Gousi was taken away by those red-clothed people. Still no news from him...

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Don't worry. We have Minghu and {PlayerName} here. We're bound to leave together!
Xiaojue took out the key he used before and tried to open the door but failed again.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: This darn key! Could they give me the wrong one?

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Another annoying mechanism! Why are they everywhere?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Perhaps they hide something important ahead...

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: The junior leader's ahead! But why does this place feel so eerie? Dark, creepy, with so many locked apes.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: These apes might be of help... Let's find the switch and open the cages.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Phew, finally got the key. Just standing here gives me an uncomfortable feeling. Let's get out of here.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Wait. Look at this.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: That's an unexpected discovery.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: So these apes were injected with something?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Yeah, I'm afraid they were injected with the spore extract, which can control their behavior, making them bloodthirsty and aggressive.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: And now, those red-clothed people probably want to use the spore extract on humans...

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: What! That's bad. We have to rescue them as quickly as possible!

speaker: Gia Minh
anh_en: Thank you! Thank you so much for saving my life!

speaker: Niệm Thu
anh_en: Thank you. I thought I was going to end up in this dark prison...

speaker: Miêu Tam
anh_en: I wonder how Gousi's doing...

speaker: Phong Bách
anh_en: I remember the red-clothed took him upstairs.

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Okay, let's go up and save him!

speaker: Phong Bách
anh_en: Mr. Minghu, I'll take care of things here. Please go up and save Gousi.

speaker: Phong Bách
anh_en: If those red-clothed people come back, I'll protect them.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Alright, I'll leave this to you. Lead everyone to a safe spot near the entrance, and we'll join you after rescuing Gousi.

speaker: Tuần Úy nhiệt tình
anh_en: Hey, friend, I can see you've got some skills. Want to give it a shot?

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: It's been a while since they got damaged. There might be quite a few TDs to deal with, but I'm sure you can handle them well!
No problem.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Great! Give me your name, phone number, and details about your weapon. I'll assess it and get you registered.
(Provide information)

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: {PlayerName}, huh? That's a good name. Unique and impressive!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: You've also got a good weapon. That should do the trick...

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Alright, assessment passed! Let's dive right in!

speaker: Tuần Úy nhiệt tình
anh_en: Well, it might be a little risky, but, you know, fortune favors the bold!
If that's the case, why don't you do it yourself?
Alright, count me in.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: Honestly, I just switched from logistics, so I'm not great with this stuff... Oh, by the way, I'm Minghu. Nice to meet you.
So I have no choice but ask for help. Anyway, as long as I can get it done, it doesn't matter much if I'm the one doing it.
I admire your courage!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: See those Sound Dampeners? They were damaged by TDs in the last onslaught.

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: First, we gotta fix up these three Sound Dampeners, then activate them to take down the TDs that are drawn in.

speaker: Cẩu Tứ
anh_en: NO! Stay away from me!

speaker: Cẩu Tứ
anh_en: I don't want to become a zombie or something!!!

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Gousi, are you okay?

speaker: Cẩu Tứ
anh_en: Thank goodness you guys came in time! It's... it's too close. I don't want to be controlled like those apes!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: This place isn't safe. Let's get out of here.

speaker: Miêu Tam
anh_en: Gousi! You finally escaped! Are you alright?

speaker: Xiaojue
anh_en: Let's get out of here first, and we can talk later.

speaker: Người Áo Đỏ Mai Phục
anh_en: Do you think you can come and go as you please?

speaker: Miêu Tam
anh_en: You scammers kidnapped my friends, and I won't let you get away with it!

speaker: Cẩu Tứ
anh_en: We won't let you!

speaker: Minh Hổ
anh_en: We're safe for now. Let's hurry up and leave.

speaker: Miêu Tam
anh_en: If we hadn't been so desperate for money to repair our camps, we wouldn't have fallen for this silly trick...

speaker: Cẩu Tứ

speaker: NPC #700220
anh_en: Chulu, chulu? (*Curious cheeps*)

anh_en: Eee, eee... (*Hesitant chirps*)

speaker: NPC #700218

Smoked Meat Stew!

Smoked Meat Stew!

speaker: NPC #700219

anh_en: Ee, eee!
