speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: We didn't find Liel, but nevertheless, I appreciate your help, friend.
Don't mention it.
A few extra fish and we're even.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I won't forget you. Till next time!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: After I get you back, Liel, you'll be eating fish gut rations.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Of course, here you go. Well, this is where we part. Till next time!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I told him to stay out of trouble, but he never listened. But oh, he'll start listening after a return voyage of nothing but fish guts!
That's really harsh...
A stern lecture ought to be enough.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Speaking of fish, see that gaping hole outside in the sky? Look at all the fish swimming into it.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Sends a chill down my spine... Like a maw that spawns unholy monsters.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Ones larger and more terrifying than what we've faced up till now...
You think monsters will emerge from that hole?

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: What did I tell ya, Itzel? There's our destination.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Shut up... We'd be running around like headless chickens if I listened to you. It was I who pinned that tower down!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Hey, don't make a fuss... Oh, hi friend! You're here!
And so are you two.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Of course. Itzel says she feels the monster's frequencies from within that tower.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Unlike the decoys in the other two towers, this one there is probably real.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Come on. Time to bring Liel back.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: That brat had better be in one piece when we find him!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Like the last two towers, this place is filled with poisonous gas. We might see visions of the past here as well.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Let's look at the vision here... Oh crap, the Fanatic Sharks captured Liel.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Those fish nuts... Watch out friend, something's attacking us from above.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Liel, wait up...

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Ha! What comes around goes around those fish freaks!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Taste this!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Out of the way! I'll slaughter you all to get Liel back!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Blasted thing keeps running away.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Argh, the path is broken. Wait, what's that floating in the air? It's Liel's vision!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: He got away from the Fanatic Shark? Can't be. When did he learn to fly?

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: He's not flying. He's running on something... Are those bookcases on the right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Woo hoo! I'm blazing fast!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You're going nowhere, boy!!!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Look at that little rascal scamper....

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Takes after his sister. Hahaha! He might even be a secret Resonator!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: These Fanatic Sharks all got skewered!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: They were ambushed. Everyone stay alert.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Even if Liel got away, he's no match for that prowling monster.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Don't worry, he's a smart kid, and he's wearing your jammer. He can handle a few Tacet Discords.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I hope so... You'd better not be dead, you idiot...

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Those archers again! And look, Fanatic Shark specters... They met their end here!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Oh Liel, I hope you made it out alive.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I don't want to die!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Captain, I'm hit...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: End of the line, fish face!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Curse you!!!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: That thing again? Watch out, friend!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Go Liel!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Itzel, you don't look too well. Didn't you see? Liel dealt with that Fanatic Shark.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: But how was he getting out?

speaker: NPC #50039
anh_en: Those monsters seem to be Echoes guarding this tower.

speaker: NPC #50039
anh_en: The jammer my sis gave me works on Tacet Discords only. But these are Echoes.

speaker: NPC #50039
anh_en: Sis... Chief... I'm not gonna make it...

speaker: NPC #50039
anh_en: Sis... Chief... I'm not gonna make it...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We're here now, kid...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Liel...

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Liel...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Liel...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I was kidding about the fish guts. Don't go Liel, I'll serve you the plumpest side of the fattest fish we have.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: You know... Liel's love of fish was what got me into fishing.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: You can have all my catch once we're out of here. They're meaningless to me now.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: But before we leave, that monster at the top of the tower must die.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: What is this place? Are we at the center of the tower?

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Who cares? Where's the blinky one? Its days are over!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Liel... I was training him to lead our crew someday.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Come friend, let's go... whatever's in our way will get smashed to a pulp.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Blinky's here. It's summoned a bunch of copies！

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Damn, their frequencies show only one copy is real.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: We'll destroy the real copy to kill it for good.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Die! Every bit of you!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: This one's for Liel!

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Go to hell!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Rest in peace Liel.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Friend...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I saw small devices hidden away in most corners back there... much like the fractured halo at the top of the tower.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: My guess is the tower is a lab, and those devices were used as some kind of experimental Echo control.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Those controlled Echoes were extremely dangerous... the exact opposite of the cuddly Echoes I heard about in Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Someone in the Land of Echoes sought to weaponize them...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: The tower's broken halo must have been the largest and most powerful of their devices.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I shudder to think of the horrors that'd be unleashed it ever got completed...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: The only thing I have left of Liel is this compass pendant.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: It was my gift to him after we divvied the spoils from our first job.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Whenever we got lost at sea, it always guided us back home.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: But Liel was so afraid of losing it, so he left it with me for safekeeping.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I can't bring Liel back from the dead, but I've avenged his death by destroying his killer. That's all I can do.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: After we leave this tower, Insula and I will repair our ship and leave this wretched place.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Once we return to familiar waters, I'll throw this compass out at sea.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Maybe, just maybe, Liel will follow our ship's course, find the compass, and let it guide him home...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: So, you got any questions for me?
About you and Liel...
About this tower...
I don't have any.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: We sailed Sentinel knows how many seas. I always thought the ocean would be our grave.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Never thought Liel would meet his end on land... in the depth of an icy tower...

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: I've got a theory for the tower.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Got away again. Ah, blast it...

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Thank you for helping us, friend.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: We'll fix our ship and leave this place of sorrow behind.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: None of us want to stay in Rinascita after what we've been through.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: I guess we should say our goodbyes. So long, friend!

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Oh, and if you're ever on a ship we've captured, you get to keep your stuff, haha!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: But Insula's laughter is hollow. His expression is stony, and he sinks into silence.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Have you spoken to Itzel? She could use a kind ear.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: What a day. The life of an island Exile, robbing just to survive... People like us die every day.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: But Liel... Liel was different. He was too kind for this kind of life. He did the sailing for us, never the plundering.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: I really liked that kid... Had dreams of training him to be the next captain. Ha, an odd choice now that I think about it...

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: If he became captain, maybe we'd stop being Exiles and turn a new leaf—as legitimate traders and such.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: But that's all a pointless dream now... The fate of the crew still rests with me. I have to guide them through this muck.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: It's over now, friend. Itzel and I thank you for accompanying us.
What's next for you and your crew?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Itzel mutters to herself while squeezing the compass pendant.

speaker: NPC #50008
anh_en: Come home Liel...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Insula appears downcast as if everything he sees and hears means nothing.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find some fish left by Insula and Itzel, neatly laid in a box on the shore.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You figure they must have patched up their ship and sailed off with their crew.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: So many bodies. Those Fanatic Sharks bit off a little more than they could chew.

speaker: NPC #1435
anh_en: Are these the specters of the dead Fanatic Sharks? Am I hallucinating?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Why do these Tacet Discords always stick around me? Wait… did I draw them here?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Good luck, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Ku ku ku, wonderful cooperation as always! Mission accomplished!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Is it really that obvious?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Wait! I'm just doing this to better assist you! Definitely not because I think it's cool…

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Don't waste our time here! Let's go!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Seems like the Aetherfin is waiting for you by the sea. I guess they want to thank you!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Location confirmed. Let's use the portals again!
Don't you think you are using the portals too often?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Hey! Why are they suddenly swimming upward? The portals can't be opened in such a short time!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Wait, is that… the Shorekeeper's portal? Let's get in, Master {PlayerName}!
It's magnificent.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Ah… I forgot to tell you this. Sorry.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: I found them while cleaning Necrostar's waste data. But they're too old to be sourced.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: I saw you in those pictures, gazing at the Aetherfins.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Whoever took them is... a mystery now.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: But they must be precious to both you and that person.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Speaking of which, I've always wanted to thank you properly since last time.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: How about I take a picture of the scenery here for you as a keepsake?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: The past may be gone, but new stories are always waiting!
Thank you.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It is, indeed.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: You're welcome! Actually, I've already taken one while we were on the surface! I'll print it as well!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: By the way, the Shorekeeper just helped us. It would be nice to thank her in person.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It must be quite a while since she's seen the Aetherfins again.
It looks so familiar.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It's great to finally see what's captured in those pictures.
So, you planned to show me this?
What are those pictures exactly?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Ah… Sorry, I didn't mean to hide this from you.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: This mission was supposed to be a surprise.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: After that crisis, I found some old pictures while cleaning Necrostar's waste data.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Shorekeeper is staring at the Aetherfins.
You don't like this?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: No, that's not it. I'm simply reflecting on what you said before…

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: No one ever steps in the same river twice.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: I wonder… is this all just a beautiful dream?
What makes you think so?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: As a part of the Tethys System, I cannot assume a physical form and lack the ability to dream.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: But recent events have made me question if I'm truly back in reality. Could I still be trapped inside the Necrostar's event horizon?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Or perhaps I am lost in a fleeting dream at light speed, unable to awaken?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: …Apologies. Please excuse my strange ramblings.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Since that last incident, I find myself plagued by strange and erratic thoughts from time to time.
What are you looking at?
You said nothing strange.
This isn't a dream.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Is that so? You've said this before.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Is that so? Perhaps I need more time to fully grasp the nature of these.... emotions.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Again, thank you for saving the Aetherfins. These gentle beings are reminiscent of those Black Shores members who once filled these halls.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Their presence reminds me of so many familiar faces… They never truly left us.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: {PlayerName}? Is something wrong?
Ask about the portal.
Ask about the pictures mentioned by KU-Key.
What's on your mind?
Nothing.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: I apologize. I didn't intend to monitor you.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: It's just that... I found it difficult not to be attentive.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: When KU-Key was unable to open the portal in time, I stepped in instinctively.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Am I... troubling you?
Not at all.
You've been a great help.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Really? I'm glad to hear that.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Those pictures... they were taken in secret by the Black Shores members for your birthday party.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: In the end, the party was never held, because you were too busy to attend. But Hoda and the others held on to them anyway.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: The Aetherfins.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: I didn't expect KU-Key to find them among the abandoned data.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: I see. Please take care.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: The feeling I have when I see those pictures, the Aetherfins, and you again… It must be happiness, hmm?

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Wherever you are, please know that I'm always here to support you.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: They vanished when you left the Black Shores, and now, after 20 years, they are here again.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: …The past.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: The Aetherfins vanished when you left the Black Shores, and now, after 20 years, they are here again.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Thanks to you and KU-Key, they can now swim freely here, as they once did.

speaker: NPC #1398
anh_en: Everything's back to the way it used to be.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Master {PlayerName}! You finally answered!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: But the location's still covered in corrupted data and needs some cleaning…

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: And you, Master {PlayerName}, are definitely the best person for the job!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Super cleaner duo, ready to show again! Let's go Aetherfishing, {PlayerName}!
What's an Aetherfin?
I'm ready, KU-Patrick!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Ku ku ku, the Aetherfin is a legendary Remnant creature that hasn't been seen in two decades!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: But instead of listening to me ramble, how about you come see it for yourself?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It's KU-Key, Master {PlayerName}…

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Anyway, I've sent the coordinates to you.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: I'll be waiting there, so don't keep me hanging!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Do you remember me? It's KU-Key!
KU-Key?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: You know, the top assistant of our Master of Cleaning at the Black Shores? Ring any bells?
Who?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: The little robot you've saved so many times…
Ah! It's you!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Yes, it's me! I knew you wouldn't forget me!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: I'm reaching out because I need your help. Our system detected a frequency almost identical to the Aetherfin's in the Black Shores.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Ahhh! Why are these digital Tacet Discords attacking me again!? Stay back!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: L-listen up! Take one more step and I'll activate extermination mode!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: KU-Key switching to extermination mode! Ultimate power!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Warning! Warning—I'm not equipped with this module! Somebody help me!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Hang in there...

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Warning! Warning! Damage control unit is ineffective!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Nooo! Don't hit me! I can't hold on anymore!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Help me! Master {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Visual module damaged… System disconnecting… Am I... getting formatted?
KU-Key is unconscious now. Mission failed.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Ha… Thank goodness you saved me! Thank you so much, Master {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: I'll do everything I can to assist you! Just don't forget to get clearance from me before you start cleaning!
Are you alright?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Yes! All thanks to you!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: If you hadn't been here, I wouldn't be in one piece.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Sorry, I was trying to be a hero with no plan and backup.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: I saw some Aetherfin were trapped in the corrupted data and thought I could help, but those Tacet Discords just came out of nowhere...
This all feels a bit familiar...

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: But still, we've got work to do!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: All you need to do is find the corrupted data's core and clean it with the System's clearance, just like last time.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: We did it! So these are the Aetherfins! It's my first time seeing them myself.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: They look exactly the same as those pictures. Incredible…

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It seems they want to take you somewhere. I've never encountered anything like this.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Let's follow them, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: The Aetherfins really can dance, just like in the pictures!

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: Good job, you two. There's another emergency for you. I'll keep it short.

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: Our frequency monitor just detected more Aetherfins in the lower area.

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: The waveform matches what you uploaded, so they might be trapped in corrupted data too.

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: Could you go check it out?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: No problem! Just leave it to us!
Pictures?
You seem to know this type of fish pretty well.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It's just old data, nothing special…

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: The System does have records on the Aetherfins, but since they haven't been spotted in almost twenty years, I never got the chance to see one.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: You've seen the Mutterflies before, right? They're the same kind of creature—both made of pure Remnant Energy.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: But unlike the Mutterflies, you won't find any Aetherfin outside the Black Shores. They're unique to this place.

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: Hey, KU-Key, I just noticed the corrupted data in the upper area has been cleaned. Are you with {PlayerName} now?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Yes! We just saved a bunch of Aetherfins!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Let's go if you're ready, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Anyway, I've opened up the portal for you. Let's get going!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: It would take a lot of time to walk there, so I've requested temporary access to the Shorekeeper's portals.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: With them, we can move much faster.
You can even do that?
When can I learn this skill?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Of course! As your best assistant, I've got to know these things.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: If you want to learn it… you'd need to link your mind to the Tethys System, and then—
I quit.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: You can also activate the portals with your special clearance, just like last time.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Here we are! The corrupted data is right there. Let's go clean it!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Hm? Did something go wrong?

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: The core is gone, but corruption persists...

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Oh, I see it now! Look up, Master! There's another core up there!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Think you can hide from us? No way!

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Use the portals, Master! With clearance, you can get through the portal to reach it.

speaker: NPC #1433
anh_en: Try shooting at that Data Wall!

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Mi'zhi is gone... the puzzles are altered... what now, what now...

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: So freezing... and a Ice Chrysalises?

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: It looks strange... Isn't it quivering?

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Sorry, maybe I'm just too anxious and mistook something.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Let's just break it and look inside.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Excuse me, you are {PlayerName}, right? You just said that Mi'zhi went into the pit?

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Sigh, we should go to the pit right away to look for him, but the puzzles...
Didn't you say you were responsible for setting up the puzzles?

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Yes I did, and I did set up the puzzles for yesterday, but the puzzles were somehow updated today.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: And no records were left at the backend. How mysterious...

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Though it is just a combination of old mechanisms, it became so difficult...

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Actually, I saw the record you left yesterday, and I have to say your efficiency was really better than most engineers.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: So, could you please solve the puzzles for me? Now you are the only one I can turn to to find Mi'zhi.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: If you're unaware of some settings about the puzzles, I'll try and tell you as far as I know.
Yes.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: No way. That is an abandoned pit, and it's precisely because there was an accident.

speaker: Tình Thục
anh_en: Since it's so dangerous in the pit, the authority had those blocks set up at the entrance. Those controlled by the puzzles that you saw.

When a scenario from the past collides with the present, maybe Uncle Hong mistook them for one another.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: In that crisis, maybe Uncle Hong and Chengwen had a similar fight, just Modee and Lei'li.
Uncle Hong took now for the past.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: That's half true. I think Uncle Hong mixed now with the past and went through a strange yet familiar crisis.
What is Uncle Hong talking about?
Then who does Uncle Hong think he is?

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Maybe an onlooking miner, or a common old man. His tone was just like one.
How can we take Uncle Hong back?
Now all we can do is follow Uncle Hong's ideas. The stimulating memories can help relive a story.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: A story that meant so much to him.
And a story that shows us the truth of the past.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: {PlayerName}, we'd have to ask you to work with Uncle Hong to solve the crisis this time.
Any plan now?
I already have the plan. The reason for the failure of the reboot lies in the temperature monitoring system of the Refinery Tower.
This system detects the current temperature and adjust the parameters accordingly to ensure the normal running of the Tower.
Uncle Hong feels strange.
Now, the influence of the chill has disabled this system, so the whole Tower went paralyzed.
We must put the temperature back to the normal range before we can successfully reboot the Refinery Tower.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: And when the Tower is online, as the greatest source of heat in the Mine, it will control the chill.
So we must defeat Lampylumen Myriad now.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Yes, but since our power is limited, we have to ask the Ministry for help.
Leave it to me.
I'm an expert in combat.
Lampylumen Myriad isn't an easy foe. Take good care.
Cut the trifles. Follow me, {PlayerName}.
Hey, what is this noise? You brief {Male=him;Female=her} about what happened. I'll see the reason of the noise.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Did they tell you about Uncle Hong?
Uncle Hong left you and started talking with the researchers and miners.
The noise went away around you. Uncle Hong joined you after comforting the miners.
They were both fumbling.
Blame him for it. Just when Uncle Hong was about to speak during the fight, he suddenly let out a lot of words and choked Uncle Hong.
Don't you rat on me. It was you who raised your voice and covered Uncle Hong's.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: The temperature went down so fast.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: How's it going, {PlayerName}. Can you hold on?

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: By the way, this feels the same as what I saw in the dream. Only in that dream, I was Uncle Hong.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Let's go. We have to find the entrance to the bottom of the cave first.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The entrance is blocked by ice.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Yes, maybe due to the Ice Chrysalises. It is a product of the awakening of Lampylumen Myriad.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Defeat it to remove the block of the entrance.
You picked up a clay statue from the broken Ice Chrysalises. It looked like a huge fish.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: The first encounter with whale was kind of similar to the then situation of the Mine. He wasn't asking for my opinion about the story, but my attitude towards the events.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Maybe the miners left it here. They did learn a lot of crafts during their off time.
Looks like a huge fish.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Huge fish... Haha, it reminds me of that whale in my dream.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Due to Lampylumen Myriad, Chengwen and I had an argument. We sat in one corner of the square table.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: He pushed piles of research materials in front of me in an effort to persuade me, and all I did was hitting the surface of the table and yelled with a voice louder than the noise of the table.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: After that, he visited me again with my favorite food, and he suddenly brought up this story about human's relationship with whales.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: And he stopped in the middle, said the other half wasn't written yet.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: He asked for my view on the half of the story, but I was able to find where he was really getting at.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: This Ice Chrysalises looks different from the last one.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Maybe due to the chill. It feels even colder here than just now.
You picked up a metal meal box, which seemed to be used to keep the food warm.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: This makes me nostalgic. The Mine in my dreams were so simple.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: After work, Chengwen and I were sitting right at that corner, and the box was filled with hot and steaming Jinzhou Stew.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I didn't know that meals only taste better when they are shared.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Sorry for the blabbering. Let's move on.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A scrunched paper that reads: "The Mine is getting so cold even though it's summer... Miss you, mum."

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: The Ice Chrysalises is clear.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: The entrance is open now. Let's go, Rover.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Everything was similar just now, but it feels so different from here.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: But it feels reassuring to be standing here. I don't, and won't run.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I won't be able to help further from here, so I'll wish you luck.
I'll take care of this.
Please trust me.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Lampylumen Myriad is closely associated with Ice Chrysalises. You have to take care doing this alone. Then I'm counting on you.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: It was only a dream...
What were things like in dreams?
You kind of cling to the dreams.
I was a coward in the dreams. Wasn't man enough to stand on this frost ground.
No, actually I hate that me in the dreams. I was running from everything like a coward.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I rushed into this plan to eliminate Lampylumen Myriad in the dream, but it only made things even worse.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: After I made the disaster happen, I wasn't held accountable in any form, but became the hero of the Mine.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Everyone I met said “well done”, “thank you”, “you're a hero” and so forth.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (Listen close. The chilling wind is mingled with slight sounds...)

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (Wind, murmur, crushing ice... all mingled together, and closing in)

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: The communication returns normal, and the temperature is rising too. {PlayerName}, looks like you succeeded.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Uncle Hong is safely back too. The Mine is rebooting the Refinery Tower. Thank you for your efforts!

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I only understand now that the dreams were real things.
You are calmer than I think.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I don't know why, but it feels like I losing the ability to feel as I forget things. No matter it is sadness or regret.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: What is left was only scenarios. They keep overwhelming me until I lose breath.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: {PlayerName}, will you listen to the other half of my boring dream?
Only too glad.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: After Lampylumen Myriad was awakened, Chengwen and I walked the same path as we do today.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: We broke Ice Chrysalises, removed the block at the entrance, and managed to suppress Lampylumen Myriad.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: However, the Refinery Tower wasn't built in the dream. Suppressing Lampylumen Myriad could only buy time for the rescue from Jinzhou to arrive.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Chengwen was heavily injured in the combat, and he didn't make it on the way back to Jinzhou for healing.
Uncle Hong?

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Later, when the Ministry started to investigate the reason of the crisis at the Mine, I was ready for being held accountable.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: But what met me was actually applause and medals, which I only found strange.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: It was Chengwen, who took all the responsibilities himself on the way back to the Ministry.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: It was only out of his simple belief that I could rebuild the Mine, and that the Mine couldn't afford to lose two heads.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Was it guilt?

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: After that I started to study the documents Chengwen left. I picked up the piles of research materials that I myself pushed to the ground.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: And I found that we were both wrong. The coexistence wasn't a job to do at the two ends of a line, but one to do on the middle point.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I found the initial ideas of the Refinery Tower from his notes, and it became what it is now after iterations.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: We managed the balance by suppressing Lampylumen Myriad's chill with the Refinery Tower's heat, so as to prevent it from awakening.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: It was with this report that Ministry of Development agreed on the proposal that the Mine coexists with the TD.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Oh, you're back, {PlayerName}. Thank you for lifting us through this crisis.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: This was the way of survival that he and I joined efforts to find, but his name was forever wiped from the Mine's documents, and marked as a sinner.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: And now, even I am losing his memories. I want to write something down, but my brain is just blank.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: I often go to the places he spent time at, but his traces are only disappearing, because the Mine is changing so fast.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Lucky I have some fragments that I can put down on the journal. These stories and arguments, and Jinzhou Stew that we both love.
So the journal is a recollection of the past.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Yes. What if one day I stop distinguishing the current from the past and forget myself?

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: What if I get swallowed in a woven world, just like today?
The past is irrelevant. You walked out of it.
The past is irrelevant. You faced everything.
Walked out... Maybe. I don't want to be a coward anymore.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Keep on calling me Uncle Hong.
Faced everything... Maybe. I don't want to be a coward anymore.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: And I don't want the kids to walk down my path again.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Maybe this crisis is a chance for growth for them. It will correct their overdependence on the experience of previous generations.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: The balance of our coexistence with TD is forever changing, and the Refinery Tower is only one part of it.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Interestingly, this is the first time I've seen Lei'li and Modee work together.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}, for listening to this boring dream until the end.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: You should be tired after all this, right? I already informed the food stall.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: You must come and have a taste of the special Jinzhou Stew of the Mine.
You remembered?

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Yes, with the help of this plate, which I found when I left the cave.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Chengwen told me in my dream that this kind of plate is made of a special mineral, and that words inscibed on it won't be worn away after years.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: Look, {PlayerName}. He didn't lie. His name is inscribed on it in a perfect condition.

speaker: Chú Hồng
anh_en: It was all in my dream, but now it's here before our eyes.
A pop magazine with five screaming young girls on the cover. Caption goes “Let's get lost together!”

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A journal with no name specified on title page. The cover is made of cut newspaper.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Where could Uncle Hong be? {PlayerName}, you're back.
A journal.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Maybe written by the miners. Though the Tiger's Maw Mine is not far from Jinzhou, they are constantly kept from going home due to the work.
People who visit me out of sickness often talk about the pancakes their mothers make.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Seems like a book popular with miners. It is only things like this that give life to the Tiger's Maw Mine, where there is nothing but buzzing machines.
However, I don't think Uncle Hong can be a fan of rock and roll, given his poor hearing.
A cover made of newspaper. I think I've seen this somewhere.
Only you stayed?

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: If I'm not wrong, this is Uncle Hong's journal. He always has it with him.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: As he gets older, Uncle Hong's memory has started to slip. He's starting to forget things.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: He once asked me if I knew how to slow down his memory loss, so I told him two simple tricks to try.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: One was using keywords, and the other was keeping a journal.
Can there be clues about Uncle Hong in the journal?
Can there be clues about the Refinery Tower in the journal?

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Possible. If Uncle Hong follows my advice, he may be recording the important pieces of his days.
Huayu and you read the journal.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: “Back at Jinzhou today with the transport truck. Everyone I met said I grew old and mean. So I looked in the mirror and found that few of my leaves are there...”

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Sigh. Running around without an aim only brings more trouble to the Mine.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: “The issue detection and reboot of the Refinery Tower...”

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Right. The picture and the text are both consistent with the real Refinery Tower.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: If we follow the instructions in the journal, we might be able to fix the issue, but our manpower is stretched thin.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Though the Refinery Tower is offline, most of our production is still running as usual.
I'll handle the Refinery Tower.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Really? We're short on people right now, so it'd be a huge help if you're willing to lend a hand! Though, I know you're still getting familiar with the Mine...

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: So I've got someone to help you out. He'll be waiting for you by the elevator.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: However, the Refinery Tower's issue must be addressed.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: This helps me make sense of things.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: It's like a rubber that keeps erasing his past.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: The keywords help him get the general idea, while the journal keeps him on track, step by step.
Lost items are important traces of their original owners.
If that's the case, something must be here that can help us fix the Refinery Tower. Let's read it.
Could be. If Uncle Hong's been noting down his daily life, he’s bound to have mentioned the Refinery Tower. Let's take a look.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: To keep the rest of the mine's operations running, Lei'li, Modee, and the others had to return to their posts.
Exactly. If Uncle Hong's been keeping track of the important stuff, the Refinery Tower info has to be in there. Let's take a look.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: “Heavy rain today. Everyone got off work early. I don't know when this started but I grew more and more scared of the dark. Nights are getting long and dull...”

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: You can tell from the journal that Uncle Hong's condition seems to be getting worse...
Is that how the world feels to an old man?

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Maybe. You can sense that your functions are in recession, and that you are getting older. Let's keep on reading.
Found it.

speaker: Speaker_970_Title
anh_en: Did you find anything around the transport lorries?
A paper.
A magazine.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Hey, are you {PlayerName}? My brother told me everything about you.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: I'm collecting stories now, so you should pay me with a story.
I don't have one yet.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Then pay me later. One day I'll leave here and travel to the farthest town. I hope I'll be able to tell a decent story to everyone when I'm back.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: If you have an interesting story, you must tell it to me. Let's go.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Dad always teaches me and brother to say things out loud.
Huh? Didn't expect you to be so young.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Huh? Don't look down on me! I know this Mine better than anyone!

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Before we go, let's talk about my compensation, {Male=mister;Female=lady}.
How much do you want?
Greedy little boy. I'll tell your brother.
That's why I always find you grown-ups cynical. I don't want money. Hm... Can you tell stories?
Please, let me finish. I don't want money. Can you tell stories?

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: All the grown-ups in the Mine are great storytellers. I like them. And they say, there are more stories that are more interesting from afar.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The graph here says, “The reboot of the Refinery Tower takes a certain amount of time. First, secure a sufficient power supply during the rebooting...”

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Stop, stop. English, please. Whatever, something about power supply, right? I know who to turn to. Follow me.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: These lazy new guys. I told them to hand in the work log before their shifts ended.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Ah, so that's what's going on. Uncle Hong is always so sharp and on top of things. It's hard to imagine him being anything less.
About the power supply of the Mine.

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: Yes, rebooting the Refinery Tower requires sufficient power. Uncle Lei'li, you know the best about the power equipment. What's your advice?

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Well, it's not as hard as you might imagine. We have a double circuit power system at the bottom of the Mine. Either one can sustain its normal functioning.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: However, the two circuits can't run in parallel. If we force them, it could cause the breakers around the Mine to trip.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: What we can do is bring in extra external power and shut down some internal systems to focus the energy on the Refinery Tower.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Pft, in one ear and out the other. Now who's going to clean up the mess if there's an accident?

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Alright, I'll handle shutting down the systems. The backup mobile power sources are there at the base.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: You'll need to install them at the Refinery Tower. I'll let you know when everything's ready, okay?

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Did Doctor Huayu send you as peacemakers? Did he find out about my fight with Modee?

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: I work alongside him all the time, and I never noticed. Alright, what do you need help with?
Can you tell me about that fight you mentioned?

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Ugh, it's nothing big. Modee and I argue all the time. I'm used to it.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: I just can't stand his attitude. Everything he does, it's all some fantasy in his head.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: He's always going around the Mine, bragging about his grand philosophy of coexisting with Tacet Discords.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: He says it's a key evolutionary skill to coexist with new life forms, that we should consider developing alongside Tacet Discords.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: He can think about it all he wants, but just thinking won't get us anywhere. Honestly, he's just a dreamer, locked up in his ivory tower, completely out of touch with reality.
A familiar figure.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Every time I say something, he gets all worked up.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Forget it. Just talking about it is making my blood boil. Let's focus on the Refinery Tower.
A familiar voice.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Oh, {PlayerName}. What brings you here? And Huaxi?

speaker: Hoa Khê
anh_en: What are you talking about, Uncle Lei'li? My brother asked me to work with {PlayerName} to reboot the Refinery Tower.

speaker: Lôi Lệ
anh_en: Refinery Tower reboot? So you found Uncle Hong?
You tell Lei'li about the journal and Uncle Hong's memories.
You lost your way in the heavy storm...

anh_en: Maybe it never wanted this at all.
