anh_en: But in that message, besides the research data, there were also a few words of advice.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: This work proved to be a very dangerous one. Should you continue, you risk losing your loved ones, friends... and everything you hold dear till this day.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Looking back from the end, the data you worked so hard to obtain is but a candle in the wind, always on the verge of being extinguished.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: If you still decide to carry on despite knowing all of this.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Chán Nản
anh_en: You there, kind {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Please, I’m in dire need of assistance...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: An engineer was supposed to report in for duty today, but he hasn’t even shown up yet...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Ugh. It’s my last assignment, too. I can’t screw this up...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Just my luck. How did I get myself into this mess?
Want me to help you find him?
You’ll end up in a deeper mess if you don’t chin-up...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: But you’re right... There are TDs running wild all over the place as it is... Can’t have my bad luck passing on to others...
What’s the matter?
Enough. Let’s go.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: All right, all right... Guess it’s the only thing I can do for now...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: By the way. I haven’t caught your name...
{PlayerName}.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: {PlayerName}... Got it. I’ll keep that in mind.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Also, once my shift’s over, remind me to get you a good luck charm to make up for all this jumble.
All right, all right... Guess it’s the only thing I can do for now...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Well, it can’t get any worse than this...

speaker: Binh Sĩ Chán Nản
anh_en: *sigh* The Tacet Discords busted our radars again...

speaker: Binh Sĩ Chán Nản
anh_en: I don’t know what’s got into them lately. It’s like they’re on a rampage. We’ve lost count how many times the radars’ gotten totaled...

speaker: Binh Sĩ Chán Nản
anh_en: Fix, smashed, fix, smashed. Rinse and repeat... With our brothers going out like flies, even the engineers hightailed it. When is this ever going to end...?
Brothers?

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: My squadmates. Ah... excuse me. Forgot to introduce myself. I’m Hé Chou, <ano=Rearguard>Midnight Rangers</ano>. I’m from the unit stationed in this area.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: With all the mess the TDs have been giving us, everyone’s... ran off left, right, and center.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: And now I’m the only one that’s left... plain old useless me... with nothing I can do...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Long time no see, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Yeah, after I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Now that I've decided to stay here, I can’t be complaining all the time have to get my act together.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: I mean, Qiuwang was able to develop such an amazing tech. I can't lose to him!
How’s Qiuwang?

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: After he made sure that everything were the way they should be, he moved on to the next place.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: He mentioned there are still more data that needs to be collected, and even more advanced technologies that need to be researched...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: From that moment on, I knew that someone like him is destined go even further along the path he had chosen... There’s nothing in this world that could stop him.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: And my job is to safeguard the Desorock Highlands and fulfill my duties as a soldier.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: That is the path I have chosen.
How have you been?
How are you still here?
You are...?

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: I’ve been doing much better lately, thanks for asking. The number of TD attacks has dropped, and the radar’s been in top shape.
After I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
After I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: It’s me, Hé Chou. Don’t tell me you forgot about me already? We were on the radar repair job last time. I was the one that always had my head hanging...
You've changed so much I almost didn't recognize you.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: The Tacet Discords over there surrounding the sentry tower...? Kind of strange...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: ...Ah! There's a man trapped in the sentry tower! Let's eliminate those Tacet Discords and get him down!

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: You still in one piece?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: The risk of danger increases each minute the radar isn’t operational. As I was entrusted with this task, I am obligated to fulfill these duties.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Besides, there is something I wish to pursue...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: The way you put it reminds of the old me who volunteered to come to the Desorock Highland.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: I used to be full of ambition and eagerness to try out something new...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: But after you get beaten down over and over again, those close to you disappear one after another...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: And all you can do is just watch... standing there helplessly...

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: I’ll see if you can still keep that enthusiasm and high spirit of yours when the time comes.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: When the time... Well, only time will tell!

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: All I know is that there is a task at hand, and repairs must be done at the surveillance station.

speaker: Người Được Cứu
anh_en: I’m okay. Thank goodness you guys came in time. Almost thought I was a goner!

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Phew... Good to hear. Can’t have any more people get hurt. Not on my watch...

speaker: Người Được Cứu
anh_en: Wait a sec... Your uniform. You're a Midnight Ranger? And who may this be...?

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Yes, the name’s Hé Chou. Rearguard, Midnight Rangers. And this is {PlayerName}, a friend who’s got quite a few fighting skills under {Male=hs;Female=her} sleeves it seems like.

speaker: Người Được Cứu
anh_en: Ahh. Greetings. I’m Qiuwang. Engineer. I received orders from the Defense Division to report my new assignment. I have been briefed on the recent incidents regarding this area. Thank you for your hard work thus far.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Yet, regardless of how difficult the situation may be, we cannot put aside our tasks. Without further delay, let’s head to the surveillance station.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: You... You do realize you were just attacked by TDs, right? Aren't you afraid? You sure you don’t want to rest up a bit?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: I’m a bit frightened, yes. But rest won’t be necessary.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Hmm... The door seems a little strange...

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: The rocks must’ve smashed the supporting beam, so the wall tilted inside and jammed the door.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Indeed. The roof has been punctured cleanly through by a large rock.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: I wonder if we can repair it... *sigh*... Everything's breaking down all over the place lately...

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: It would seem repairs are unnecessary. Better to tear everything down and rebuild.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Well, things breaking down isn’t necessarily a bad thing. No construction without destruction. Don’t you agree?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Astonishing, {PlayerName}! Aren’t you just full of surprises?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Well... Let's see here. This Induction Cell seems to be intact. Once we install this back to where it belongs, all it takes for me is to adjust some settings to restore the station’s data.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: You work fast, {PlayerName}. You’ll make for a great engineer. Have you considered becoming one?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Which is also the ultimate goal of my assignment... Performing constant repairs is simply unfeasible long-term.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: As you can see, all three surveillance stations are currently damaged. It will take a significant amount of time for even the most skilled engineers to repair and have them fully back and running.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Not to mention the numerous dangers they may encounter along the way...

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Ahem. In short, our work at this station has concluded. We should move on to the next one.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: I shall entrust you for protection if we come across anything unexpected.
I think I’ll pass.
Why not.
Ahh. That’s a shame. But I agree that one should decide their own path and walk it on their own free will.
Haha. You were quick to answer. Why don’t you give it some more experience before you come to a final decision?
Qiuwang utters as he continues to adjust the Induction Cell.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: It is done! Data link complete... We now have access to the Tacet Discord incursion on record.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Incursion records? I thought restoring the data was all we needed to do?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Restoring the data is only a temporary solution. With this record, we can study the TDs’ behaviors, in order to better formulate measures to strengthen our defenses and eliminate future problems.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: There's not a door to block us this time, but the Cell is missing.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: *sigh* It's either one problem or the other. I can't even hand over my shift properly. How useless I am...

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Err... This isn’t really your fault, is it?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Constant moaning about these matters won't do you any good... You are familiar with this place more than any of us. Why don't you try recalling where the Cell may be?

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Come to think of it... Nearby Exiles sometimes come here to steal things.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: But they usually go for food or scrap metals, stuff like that. They don’t have the guts to try and take something like this... What happened this time?

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Hmm... It's a clue at least. Lead the way. We should talk with the Exiles nearby.

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Hello there. Are you the ones who’s taken the cell?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Ngông Cuồng
anh_en: Caramel? What caramel? We be eaten all the caramel if we had them!

speaker: Thu Vọng
anh_en: Err... Not caramel. Cell.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Ngông Cuồng
anh_en: Caramel, cellamel. They be the same.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: It’s just an act. I’ve seen it all before.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: You try talk sense to these airheads and all you’re going to get is a dead end.

speaker: Hà Trù
anh_en: Some good-old beating is the only way to deal with these clowns.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Here's your entry pass. Now you can come and leave the camp freely.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: By the way, before the match kicks off, we need to contribute items to the prize pool.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Rover, do you have anything valuable?
I don't.
I'm flat broke.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: No worries! I'll throw in my stuff. I have faith in you!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: I've staked everything I own, even a 20th-anniversary limited-edition comic book with the author's autograph.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: It's the prized issue number 0001.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Did you find out any useful information?
Are you serious?

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Hey! Are you undervaluing them? They cost me a great sum!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: I'll hand them over to the organizer. You go register with the receptionist. I'll be your biggest cheerleader during the match!
They're not friendly.
They're aggressive.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Well, all the participants are elite members of their factions, and the competition only fuels their aggressiveness with each round.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Hello, are you here to register for the Seaside Arena?

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Due to the enticing rewards, many incompetents try to sneak in, wasting everyone's time. That's why we've set up this rule—to ensure only the truly powerful can participate.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Participants in the Seaside Arena have always been the cream of the crop.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: To earn these badges, you'll undergo three basic trials. Are you ready?
Bring it on.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: The first trial tests your courage. A weapon is placed at the highest point in the camp.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: If you can retrieve it safely, you'll earn the first badge.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: There's a new rule to follow. If you want to register for the match, you need to collect three badges first.
What badges?

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Excellent. Overcoming inner fears is the first step to climbing to the top.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: You've earned the badge of courage.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: The next badge represents speed. Wait a moment; someone is challenging it now.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Alright, your turn. See those shooting targets?

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Your task is to hit those targets within two minutes.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Only those who react fast and make swift decisions can pass.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: If you're the one we're expecting, I'm sure you can breeze through it. If you're ready, let's get started.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Efficient and clean. Come take your badge of speed.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: The final trial is the most challenging.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Here you are. It's your second badge. As for the final badge…

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: You'll undergo a comprehensive trial.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: However, the examiner's schedule is reversed from ours.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: You'll find her only at dusk.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: The food lately is getting worse and worse. What's up? Need something?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: The last badge represents strength, so you need to take me down to get it.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Easy, right? Okay, give it a try, kid.
You're the final examiner?
I'm here to get the final badge.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Another foolish challenger from a foolish faction, huh? If you don't want to lose everything you have, head back now.
Regret is still an option. We can pretend we never saw you. Hurry up and leave!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Want the last badge? Look at how weak and fragile you are. Just leave if you don't want to get your faction in trouble.
I promised someone I would win.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: My ears are tired of hearing such promises. Anyway, I've already given you a chance.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Take it. It's the last badge. You're indeed strong.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Later, I discovered it was a trap set by those high-ranked factions, waiting for the innocent to jump into it.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: In this survival-of-the-fittest world, only strength speaks.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I no longer have the power to change it, but maybe you can. I've seen countless challengers, and I have keen observation.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: With your strength, maybe... I'll forge a report just like they do this time.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Will you be my last resort?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: The three trials you just passed not only screen out the unqualified but also give them a chance to precisely assess the strength of the participants, gathering information.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: In this case, they can be well-prepared in the official match. And, we examiners are responsible for submitting the assessment reports to those factions.
Can I trust what you're saying?
Believe it or not. Honestly, I see hope in you. I think you can help me regain my freedom.
Forge a report?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Do you new participants really think the Seaside Arena is a place for you to hone your skills?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: To be frank with you, the Seaside Arena is now a steering wheel held by those high-ranked factions.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: They can ensure they're always at the top of the leaderboard. Even this rule is one of their tactics to maintain their positions.
Why are you telling me this?
Because I see hope in you. I think you can help me regain my freedom.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I was once a challenger in the Seaside Arena. However, my obsession with victory led me to lose my own freedom.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Congratulations on collecting all three badges. An Exile claiming to be your friend has already completed the registration form on your behalf.
Can't wait.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Wish you good luck!

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Before entering the match, please familiarize yourself with the Seaside Arena rules.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Your friend forgot to provide Echo information for you. Unfortunately, once the registration form is submitted, no changes are allowed.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: According to the Seaside Arena rules, challengers who haven't registered Echo information will be provided with an assistance Echo in battle.
Is it strong?

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Hahaha, unfortunately, it's Zig Zag, an ordinary Tacet Discord. To avoid affecting the match, we can only provide the basic Echo.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Here are the rules.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: The Seaside Arena adopts a single-elimination system. Participants are allowed to use any fighting styles in battle. The winner automatically advances to the next round.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: When you win all three rounds, you qualify for challenging the previous champion.

speaker: Lễ Tân
anh_en: Are you ready, Rover?
Let's get started.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Oh no, TDs are swarming in… This isn't what the Great Inventor said.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Farewell, Teach Qishan, Teach Xiaochun… I may never get another chance to read your works.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: …I can't bear to part with you and your creations… HELP! IS ANYONE THERE!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to tonight's electrifying matches at the Seaside Arena!
I know who wrote this.
Was I summoned?

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Ladies and gentlemen, our first match tonight features Rover facing off against the renowned and skilled participant. Please join me in welcoming Mira the Danger!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Now, before we dive into the action, do either of you have any words for your opponent?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nguy Hiểm
anh_en: One word.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nguy Hiểm
anh_en: I'll either dominate or endure.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Direct and to the point! Rover, how about you?
I'll be the winner.
Act One: Target, Champion!
I'm wondering who my next opponent will be.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: The energy in the air is palpable; I can feel your enthusiasm building up!
Confidence stands tall as the challenger's mightiest weapon. Who will emerge victorious in this opening round? Ladies and gentlemen, hold your breath and watch!
That's a robust response. Who will emerge victorious in this opening round? Ladies and gentlemen, hold your breath and watch!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Confidence stands tall as the challenger's mightiest weapon. Who will emerge victorious in this opening round? Ladies and gentlemen, hold your breath and watch!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Tonight, we have a brand-new challenger stepping into the pit!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: As a fresh face in the arena, {Male=he;Female=she}'s about to embark on an exciting career. Let's delve into {Male=his;Female=her} introduction!
Wait, did he say self-introduction?
I don't recall writing that for myself...

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: The collective beliefs in this arena will manifest into a resounding courage, piercing through the sky and lighting the way forward.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Introducing the new blood from The Hyenas! The spotlight of tonight's showdown! Let's give a roaring welcome to Rover, the Dark Envoy!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: It's the first time I've delivered such impassioned opening remarks. Anticipate an unforgettable performance from {Male=he;Female=she} tonight!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Ladies and gentlemen, what an exhilarating showdown! In the opening round, Rover demonstrated incredible prowess, triumphing over Exile the Danger.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Now, brace yourselves for the second round, featuring none other than Wildwolf, hailed as the Dream Crusher among challengers, accompanied by his loyal TD, "Hornet"!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Wildwolf, facing a fierce newcomer today. Any fiery words for your opponent?

speaker: Sói Hoang
anh_en: Fortunate for you to survive the initial round, but your luck runs out here.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Rover, your chance to respond!
Eye for an eye, tooth for a tooth.
Act Two: Prepare for Defeat! Hornet.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Ohhh! The tension between these two contenders is palpable. Keep your eyes glued to the action, as the second round is about to unfold!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Making a debut but conquering two prominent challengers, Rover is just a step away from clinching the ticket to the championship!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Both competitors are in high spirits. It looks like we're in for a thrilling showdown!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Will it be a legendary defense of the championship ticket, or will the dark horse emerge victorious? Let's wait and see.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Now, let's introduce the opponent for the final round. Can she thwart Rover's relentless march forward?

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: A frequent finalist, renowned as the "Echo Master" in the Seaside Arena, let's welcome Crazy Tif!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Tif, any words of wisdom for this emerging dark horse?

speaker: Tiv Điên Cuồng
anh_en: HAHA... HAHAHA...

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Did everyone catch that? The commanding aura of Crazy Tif is apparent even before the match!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Confronted with such a formidable opponent, how will Rover respond?
I'll carry no regrets!
Act Three: Keep Composure! Victory is Mine.

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Three!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Two!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: One!

speaker: Người Dẫn Chương Trình
anh_en: Let the match begin!

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Impressive, snagging a ticket to challenge me on your first attempt. Well done, well done indeed.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Looks like I'll need to give it my all. The final is tomorrow at noon. Don't back away in fear, okay?

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: I'll demonstrate what true strength is.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: By the way, Rover, there are a few things about tomorrow's final that I haven't mentioned yet.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Since it's your first participation, there are some variations in the rules compared to regular matches. You should familiarize yourself with them before the final.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Meet me at the elevated platform at the camp, and I'll fill you in.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Rover, you made it. How's your experience with the Seaside Arena so far?

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: No rush. How about you return and gather opinions from other members? The right choice will become evident.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: You have until tomorrow noon to think it over. Take your time.
Quite lively.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: The matches aren't just competitions; they assist in resolving conflicts and distributing resources among factions.
It's just your excuse for exploiting others.
It's not an excuse for exploiting others.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Alright, no beating around the bush. To keep the Seaside Arena running smoothly, I'd like you to forfeit the match.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: The matches can proceed seamlessly because of our management.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: However, you've become a threat to our control over the matches.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: The Hyenas call this place home, so you should understand.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Besides, with two victories under your belt, you should be in for some substantial rewards. If you agree, we'll consider granting The Hyenas more privileges in the future.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: No need to think about it. Rover must has {Male=his;Female=her} own answer.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: I'll settle things in our match tomorrow. Don't worry; I'll ensure you accept your defeat without any complaint.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: The Seaside Arena has completely lost its integrity. It has devolved into a means to fulfill your insatiable greed. I refuse to be manipulated like a mere puppet.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: It's just another trap set by you. Am I right?
Yeah.
I'll take you down.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Hahaha, I was curious why there's a formidable participant stepping into the Arena without prior notice.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: It seems you've tampered with the reports.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I merely bided my time for the right moment. As Rover pointed out, it's nothing more than your pretext for exploiting the vulnerable.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Alright, given the circumstances, it appears that a showdown between us is unavoidable.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Impressive! Just like the main character in a comic book, you handled them with just a few moves.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: I have one too. Ahem, attention, please! Wail! Shatter! Let me exile this world! I am the judgment of the Fire God! I am the Flame Envoy that laments in the darkness!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: How about that, not a bad name, huh?
I have things to attend to. Excuse me.
Ten out of ten for your action!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Hey, don't go, Rover! Since you're so skilled in battle, can you please do me a favor?

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Hehe, it gives more vibes this way. Rover, since you're so skilled in battle, can you please do me a favor?
What do you need me to do?
I don't work for free.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: You're as straightforward as expected. And! Don't worry. I'm not gonna let you work for free!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Yeah, sure. I won't let you help for free. After it's done, I'll give you your payment.
As long as you're not hurt.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: If… if that's not enough, then... I can give you my limited-edition Babylonia Squad figurines! From the Hero Plays!
Okay, okay, but wipe your tears first.
Here's the deal: besides being a Fire Envoy, I'm also the representative Exile for The Hyenas in this year's Seaside Arena.
It's a competitive event organized by various exile factions in this region.
With more factions joining, there are now even foreign factions participating as challengers.
In the Seaside Arena, you can fight against your opponent with your own body.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: But you can also use powerful Echoes to fight on your behalf, offering a chance to explore the abilities and techniques of different Echoes.
Sounds meaningful.
Seems like a place to help participants sharpen their skills.
I do what I can. No need for thanks.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: At the beginning, yes. However, as time passes, everything's slowly changing.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: The desire to win among participating Exiles is growing stronger, and now, participants are required to pay an "entry fee."

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Both parties need to wager items of equivalent value, and the winner takes all the bets from the loser.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Then these bets have shifted from personal belongings to faction interests.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Now, if there's a conflict between factions, they just need to come to the Seaside Arena to settle it.
It's now an negotiating table.
I AM the main character of a story.
That's right. It's supposed to be an event that helps people hone their battle skills, but now it has turned into an negotiating table focused on bets.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: What's worse, the bets now even involve faction territory and resources. Therefore, winning the match means having more power.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Factions in this region are ranked based on their victories and defeats in the Arena, determining their territory size and the amount of resources they can have.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: My faction, The Hyenas, used to be one of the biggest factions in this region. The old leader maintained faction relationships under the principle "one thrives, all thrive; one declines, all decline."

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: As the Seaside Arena changed drastically, many members abandoned the old leader's principles. This split our faction, leading to its slow decline.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: One day, those factions took over our camps and turned them into a new arena… Now, The Hyenas is broken. Everyone in the faction is laughing at the old leader's "foolish" principle.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Living in this world is like living in a jungle. It's all about survival of the fittest, and only the strongest can set the rules.
They have a point. So the only way to realize the old leader's wish is through battle.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: If I were you, I could definitely win the match… So, please! Please help me!
We need to bring the Arena back on track.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Even the way you speak sounds like a main character.
I need to think it over.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: So, you agreed? That's great. I'm heading back to the Arena. Once you're ready, come find me there.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: It's okay. Take your time. When you decide, come find me at the arena camp.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: How about temporarily joining The Hyenas?
What's the Seaside Arena?

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Higher-ranked factions can seize the resources of lower-ranked factions.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Many small factions grew stronger under the influence of The Hyenas.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: I was preparing for the Arena just now, but I'm still too weak to be the final winner.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: It's really important to me!
Even the way you speak sounds like a main character.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Haha, you're so interesting! I told my friends in the faction that someone exactly like a main character from a comic book surely exists, but no one believed me.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Oops, almost forgot to ask for your name.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: They also tease me that I'm as childish as a little kid…
Call me Rover.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Rover… I see! The great ones always have impressive nicknames, right?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: It's almost the time. Rover, can you meet me under the tree near the camp?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I'd like to discuss our strategy with you.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: The final's approaching. I'm still not sure how they manage to defeat their opponents.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Rover, you'd better focus on your opponent's movements during the battle.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I'll be watching. If anything goes wrong, I'll help you.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Hmph, you came.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Hope you won't disppoint me, Rover!

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: I knew they wouldn't be enough to defeat you. How about this one?

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: A special surprise for you, Rover! Prism Knights! It's your turn!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Rover, he enhanced the Echo by forging some data in the Terminal.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: But it won't last long. The Echo will become vulnerable after the enhancement fades!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Rover, pick the right time to attack!

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: How… IMPOSSIBLE! How could I lose!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Rover, can you add an additional condition?
What condition?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Have the defeated party publicly declare the victor's terms to everyone in the camp.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Why go through the trouble?
It's worth a shot.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Alright, I'll take him to the center of the camp. I'll catch up with you shortly.
Everyone ought to listen to our terms.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Since you've lost, it's time to fulfill your promise according to the rules.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Shoot. What do you want? Power, money, or your faction's status?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Rover, you're the winner, so it's up to you to answer.
You tell Zeyuan and Exile Examiner's wishes to him.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: One thrives, all thrive; one declines, all decline. The Hyenas is still as naïve as ever.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: If my memory serves me right, your faction received assistance from The Hyenas, correct?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Without such naivety, would your faction have attained its current status?

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: As promised, I've granted your requests. It won't be long before the Seaside Arena reverts to being an arena for participants to sharpen their skills.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Wolves in the forest always prey on sheep, even if they are aware hunters might shoot them. It's their nature, unchangeable.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Here are the spoils of your victories. All yours now.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: If there's nothing else, I'm taking my leave.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: Can't wait to see the day when it's once again exploited as a negotiating table, hahaha!
What do you mean?

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Hehe, you were amazing in the matches! That's the Rover I know!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: After this season, The Hyenas will slowly reclaim its status.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: On my way here, I encountered several high-ranked factions that seemed ready to leave. They eyed me with disdain.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Haha, don't give me that look. Can't you tell it's just a joke?

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: I'm so excited to share this good news with the old leader!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Now it's their turn to feel the pain I've endured!

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Here, Rover, is your payment. Hope to see you again soon.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: All the chaos has come to an end. Why the long face?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: It's no longer your concern, so don't dwell on what you did. Let's wait and see what answers they'll give.
How do you know what I'm thinking?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I've been stuck here for so long. It's time to break free and stretch my stiff bones. See you, Rover.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: You helped them not to boost their status or gain more advantages but to restore the Seaside Arena to its intended purpose—a place where everyone can enjoy.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: You played a part in changing the twisted rules of this region.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Your gave the weak a chance to survive, and that's commendable.
I think I understand what you mean.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: Let me guess. You fear that the one you helped is actually a fierce and greedy wolf.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: This region is on the brink of a new wave of changes. Whether they're positive or negative depends on the response of the people here.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: I can tell from your expression. You're not an Exile, huh?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thử Thách
anh_en: It doesn't matter if they're wolves or not. Think carefully about why you chose to lend them a hand.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: Rover, here you are! Seems like you're ready.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: You can find Exiles from various factions here. To maintain order, we're required to have an entry pass to prove our identity.

speaker: Trạch Nguyên
anh_en: I'll get an entry pass for you. For now, you can explore around the camps. Maybe you can find some information about the opponent.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Mỉm Cười
anh_en: Hi there? Are you here to participate in the Seaside Arena too?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Mỉm Cười
anh_en: One more competitor here, and my heart is just breaking with guilt.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Mỉm Cười
anh_en: I've never, ever lost, you know? Best of luck to you, though. You'll need it, trust me.

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: A new face, huh? You skinny, twig-like figure understands the real deal about fighting?

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: You didn't drag yourself all the way here to play babysitter for that outdated principle of the old fool, did ya?

speaker: Quán Quân Đấu Trường
anh_en: You still have the chance to back out, heehee! Don't come crying like a little baby in the pit.

speaker: NPC #100066
anh_en: Latest log: Ash

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: They think a stolen ID will let them waltz into the vault, but as I said, each depository has its own security module. When the vault is in lockdown, it's impregnable.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Not even a single Shell Credit can be taken, let alone any of the vault's artifacts and collections.
Amazing, but we've got work to do.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Let's head up to the monitoring room on the top level and check if the old lady we saw in the surveillance footage is "Ash."

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Some of the defense systems have been activated. We should tread carefully from here on out.
Zani mentions rumors about a "secret cache" inside the Averardo Vault and suspects it's what the thief is after.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So, it seems this "Ash," whoever they are, messed around with the display cases, took the module, and triggered the lockdown that trapped us here.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Does each display case have its own log?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ah, you know how it is. Some thieves have made "sneaking into the vault" their sole purpose in life.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's hope this Ash isn't after the "secret cache."

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What's that?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Ah, I've heard rumors that the Montelli vault holds the most valuable treasure in all of Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I doubt it. Not even the most senior Montelli employee knows anything about this so-called treasure.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But that ridiculous tale still draws in idiots trying to break in—hundreds of them every year.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: How beautiful... but why was it covered?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Uh... What?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: According my interpretation of the Codex, I don't see how this painting implies anything untoward.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Maybe not to you or some of your fellow Acolytes, and certainly not to the Montellis or the painter. But there are others who don't share that view and their voices are often the loudest.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That's why this painting is covered—to avoid stirring up trouble.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Very prudent, but it's still a shame people can't admire its beauty anymore.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What about the risk of people slandering the Order? Doesn't that bother you?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Just like some will appreciate a piece of art, others will hate or misinterpret it. The same goes for the Order.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: People's views are shaped by their backgrounds and experiences. What's precious to one might be another's poison.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Everyone is entitled to their opinion. As long as they genuinely believe it, I don't see a problem.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Locking this painting away is perhaps the best option for now, but I believe it will eventually return to where it belongs, for everyone to see.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Really? You don't know this painting?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If more people thought like you, we'd see a lot less trouble in the world.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Isn't it just a landscape?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Be my witness, {PlayerName}—what I'm about to say is purely to satisfy our Acolyte's curiosity. No hidden agenda.
Why the sudden suspense?
Alright.
What's so special about this painting?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This piece, titled "Ballad Beneath the Stars," may appear simple at first—just a shepherd tending his flock under a vast sky. However, the pattern on the shepherd's clothes resembles the Order's emblem, only flipped upside down, and the number of stars matches the recorded blessings bestowed by our Sentinel Imperator.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What's more, the number of sheep is the same as the Sentinel's wings. Given that some fanatics claim the Sentinel's divine messages are fabrications, when you connect the dots, doesn't it seem like this shepherd is hinting at something?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: There's a covered vase here. What's the story behind this one?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Beautiful or ugly, what do you say?
Beautiful.
Ugly.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Montellis think so, which is why they don't want to share it.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Montellis disagree, but they keep it hidden for people of your taste.
...Hello.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: She doesn't look like she could be a thief's accomplice, either.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That thing you're carrying seems to disagree.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: The Order's relics are kept a secret from everyone, including an Acolyte like myself. I can't say what it's reacting to.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: But... I do have a strange feeling about Ms. Lily.
We shouldn't leave her here.
We should bring her with us.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: She could accidentally trigger something dangerous if left alone. That's the last thing we need.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Agreed. And if she is somehow involved, we'd save a lot of effort by taking her with us.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'm sorry, ma'am, but you'll need to come with us.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Excuse me, ma'am, do you work here?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I understand your hesitation, but with the vault sealed, you'll be safer with us.

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: Alright, I'll come with you.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Good. Time to use your clearance, {PlayerName}. Let's find out what's really going on in this vault.
You encounter a vault employee who claims to be Lily, but she can't remember why she is there. Although you find Lily's identity suspicious, for her own safety, you invite her to accompany you.
Sorry, if this sounds odd, but... I'm a bit confused. I don't remember why I'm here.

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: All I know is that I do work in the vault, and my name is... Lily.

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: But this isn't the section I oversee. Why am I here... Why are you here?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Lady Carlotta has tasked us with a special delivery. May I see your ID, Ms. Lily?

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: I only have this card.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Thank you. Hmm... Confidential Researcher? The vault does have that position, but a researcher shouldn't be in this section.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The ID is real—the anti-counterfeit features check out.
Camera View I

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ma'am, does the name "Ash" mean anything to you?

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: Old Ash? He used to say he wanted to sleep among the Echoes to study their behaviors. What a stubborn man.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So the real Ash did exist. As for that man hiding over there... he might have stolen Ash's ID and gotten stuck here.

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: Ash's ID was stolen? Outsiders couldn't have done that—we've been in here for at least twenty years. Even with my fuzzy memory, I know that much.
Twenty years?!
Is this a vault or a prison?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Twenty years in this vault... Sounds like a living hell...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If it were me, I could maybe last... Well, ten years tops.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: But... no one should be working in such awful conditions, Ms. Zani.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yeah, well, personally I just hope to live long enough to make the most out of my retirement someday. Anyway, we've got an imposter on our hands posing as "Ash."
Camera View II

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's take the train to the Echo depository. We must find this thief and retrieve the security module. After that, we can decide what to do next.

You use your access to review the surveillance footage, while learning from Lily that she has been working at the vault for at least twenty years, and the "Ash" you encountered earlier was actually an imposter with a stolen employee ID.\nIn order to recover the security module, you decide to take the train to the Echo depository.
Camera View III
Camera View IV

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: More guards are gathering.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The longer the vault stays in lockdown, the more defense systems and Echo guards get activated.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Someone's hiding over there!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Stay alert, everyone. During training, I was told to avoid the Echo Depository unless absolutely necessary.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Each Echo is unique, and trust me, you don't want to know what happens if one gets damaged.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Don't worry about us, {PlayerName}! Just focus on operating the train Echo!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hold tight! It's just the safety mode kicking in!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Are you alright, Ms. Lily?

speaker: NPC #100031
anh_en: I'm fine. Be careful.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ha... I didn't expect this fella in the vault.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Thank goodness, everyone's safe.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Am I early? Where's that person Carlotta sent...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: An opportunity like this doesn't come round often.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The family's favor is more precious than money. Remember to use it on something worthwhile.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Now about the job—Lady Carlotta must have briefed you in her letter. I'm curious what the Order is thinking stashing their relic in the Montelli vault.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: At any rate, my job here is to keep you safe. Take this pass, it's the only one that allows visitors access to the vault's interior.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Time to go. The Order's rep is waiting for us.

You receive a letter from Carlotta inviting you to Averardo Vault as an intermediary for an escort mission.\nAfter accepting the request, Zani gives you special security clearance prepared by the Montelli family upon your arrival at the vault.

speaker: NPC #100063
anh_en: We can clock out now? I didn't know Treasurer Pacino had taken up charity work!

speaker: NPC #100064
anh_en: Yeah whatever, it's a paid day off. I could do with a nap anyway...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ah, there you are. It's been a while since we last worked together.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I was not expecting you to take this job.
Carlotta said it's paid.
I expect a favor in return.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Carlotta promised a generous reward once it's done.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ah, well worth the trip then.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Tsk, the imposter just ran away.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: There's a book. What is this...

speaker: NPC #1475

anh_en: ...Professor Mornye, I know you're against restoring the prototype because of what Professor Warren did.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Yeah, he was ruthless. Dealt with the Fractsidus. Betrayed Spacetrek. All to get what he wanted.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: But... I studied under him for years. I know this tech better than anyone, and how valuable it is.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Lenie, forcing a result through the wrong means isn't what we do.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: But isn't that how we got here? The New Federation. Spacetrek. Everything they built came from trial and error. From pushing forward even when things went wrong.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I've... never forgotten it.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: That's not a fair comparison, Lenie. You can't let the ends justify the means.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I know. I know my reasoning sounds just as ugly as his. But Professor Mornye... I just—I can't let it end like this.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I followed his research for years. I'm convinced that something he was willing to betray everything for can't be worthless. Please. Just give me a chance.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Let me finish restoring the Helios prototype. After that, the Collective can take it all. I just want to prove this technology has a reason to exist.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Hm... Professor Anselm was right about you. You really are just like Warren.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: As a researcher for the Collective and as the director of the New Solar project, I simply cannot approve something this risky.

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: But as a professor from the Department of Engineering, I know you're the most capable student in this field.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: So here's what we're going to do. Lenie, your task will be to investigate, log, and recover past research equipment.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Under that scope, you're authorized to perform any necessary maintenance on that equipment during the recovery process. But if anything goes sideways, the Collective takes over immediately. That's not up for debate.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: It's the whole reason why I HAVE to try! Please! I'll take full responsibility if it fails.

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu! Chulu! Chulu!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Understood! Thank you so much, Professor Mornye! I owe you one, big time!
Professor Mornye?
What brings you out here?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Ah, Mentor—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mornye subtly gestures toward the prototype and Lenie, giving you a look that says this situation is a bit delicate and might need a "delicate" touch.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: {PlayerName}, in your opinion, if we were to restore the prototype and reboot it here, what are our chances of success?
Hard to say.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Mentor... was I being too harsh on Lenie just now?
Not really.
Maybe a little.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: I see... Good to know.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: So it was a little harsh... but I had to be serious about this.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The moment you mentioned Lenie in your messages, I knew I had to come.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Anyone who worked on Helios knows who she is. She was Warren's star pupil.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Driven. Confident. Brilliant. Incredible imagination. People always used to say she was "the genius most like Warren."

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: And that's exactly why we worry. She's so driven. We're afraid she might go too far down the wrong path. And not come back.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: {PlayerName}, we have a survey team member in the Twilight Woodlands who needs backup.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: If it weren't for you and Mornye stepping in when you did, the situation might've...

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: Anyway, Lenie was Warren's student. People have always called her "the genius most like Warren."

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: But I believe you can guide her, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: Also, if you could... Don't mention anything about these messages to her.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: She's a student with strong initiative and pride. Give her the right guidance, and she'll find the right path on her own.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: Her name is Lenie, and she's wearing a Rabelle College uniform. Mind checking on her out there?
Why me?
Who are you?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Why me?

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: It's not something a Spacetrek member can be seen doing. You're the best option we have.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Who are you?

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: Someone who isn't worthy of guiding her.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: I'm sure you still remember Warren, the man who betrayed the Collective and tried to sabotage Helios during the New Solar Ceremony.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Right on time, {PlayerName}. I'm almost ready here.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I came to Startorch Academy because of what it said on my admission letter: "We are here to strive for the future of civilization."

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Growing up in the New Fed, I saw plenty of geniuses grinding themselves to the bone. Nine times outta ten, it wasn't anything noble driving them.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: President Lucilla once told me that everyone who chooses science starts with a great ambition.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: But with so many brilliant researchers out there, how many actually get to see their work push human history forward? Even by a single step?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: So since I've caught a glimpse of that hope… I can't just look away. No matter where that hope came from.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I understand. And I trust you, Lenie.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: As long as you hold onto that, we've got nothing to worry about.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Hah. Getting the {PlayerName} seal of approval? That's a real honor. Alright, framework's fixed. Boot sequence is ready.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: You three—remember, no overdoing it! We just need a spark to get this fire going. No unnecessary sacrifices. Got it?

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu! Chulu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Chulu!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Great! Now let's get this started!

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu! Chulu!

anh_en: Haha, thanks! You know... I didn't think Professor Mornye would actually give me the green light. Now I really can't screw this up. Gotta prove her trust wasn't wasted.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Lenie, about your mentor... Professor Mornye and I were worried the connection might be weighing on you.

anh_en: Yeah, maybe. Hah. Guess even she could tell, huh?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Everyone says I'm just like him. But honestly? It doesn't really bother me.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: System rebooted! We made it! The micro Reactor Drive is back online!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Tacet Discords incoming. Let me help you, Mentor.

anh_en: All cleared. But the Voidmatter contamination hasn't fully disappeared...

anh_en: The prototype's energy levels are dropping. We should head back and check, Mentor.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: The valve?

anh_en: Isn't that just a standard part of the transmission system? The structure looked intact, so I didn't open it up and check...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Look at the parameters. The material they used back then is different from what we use now.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Even with the same design, high-intensity Voidmatter exposure will cause a massive drop in transmission power. It was a flaw in the material technology back then.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: In other words, the reason you can't maintain the ignition isn't because of the "Augmented Resonance framework." You already fixed the original design flaws.

anh_en: If it's that valve failing... then the energy deficit isn't from lack of power. It's from the liquid core leaking. Which means...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Your project isn't over yet, Lenie. Please continue with the prototype recovery.

anh_en: {PlayerName} and I will go underground to check where the core's energy has been leaking. We'll take the Soliskin with us to provide the jump-start from below. You coordinate the surface activation. Clear?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Clear!

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu... Chulu...

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: No, no, you three did great! This is on me. I must've missed something... I messed up somehow.

speaker: NPC #200042

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Lenie...

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Professor Mornye... I...

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Please, just give me more time and I'll definitely—

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Don't let your emotions cloud your judgment. Look at this. Did you check the prototype's energy flow valve?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The Soliskin can help us move faster... This way, Mentor!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Mornye, what's your take on this Augmented Resonance tech?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: My research in this field is limited, but based on Professor Warren's theories...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: If the conditions are right, the Augmented Resonance framework could actually shield instrument signals from any electromagnetic interference from the Etheric Sea.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I see... By the way, how did you know about the valve issue?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Professor Anselm mentioned it to me on Wavesline before I left.

speaker: NPC #100099

anh_en: Watch out. There are Threnodian creations lurking nearby.

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu! Chuchulu!

anh_en: Mentor, the Soliskin say we can use these Lumescribe Components to drive it off!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Enemy done. Ready for the ignition.

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chuchulu!

The Soliskin hand you a heavily scuffed, dented metal box.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Remember: take it to WARREN'S OFFICE. Do not give it to that idiot Anselm! He's far too slow for a lead researcher and wouldn't know what to do with the data. My design is flawless! The Collective's true goals can only be achieved through the Augmented Resonance framework!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Is this the black box for the work logs? I didn't expect to find it down here.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Someone even tucked a note inside...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: If this black box is being opened, it means the prototype experiment failed. Whoever finds this, deliver it immediately to Professor Warren's office on the second floor of the Spacetrek Collective. I need to verify the logs right away!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The arrogance... That's exactly how he sounded when I first joined the Institute. There's no doubt he wrote this note.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: These logs verify that the Augmented Resonance framework was stable during the experiment. The cooling system failed, and that interfered with the anti-Voidmatter system.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: So that disaster really was just an accident... If only someone had actually managed to get this box to him...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...History allows no "ifs", Mornye.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We should signal Lenie to start the ignition.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Tch! That all you got, you damn Threnodian creations?!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I can handle you just fine, even without the Exostrider!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name

speaker: NPC #100099

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu, chulu?

anh_en: They're not gonna just take it away, okay?

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu!!!

anh_en: I understand! Thank you, Professor Mornye. That's really the best option. But... there's actually one more thing I wanted to ask you and {PlayerName}.
About what really happened during the prototype's experiment?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: No... I don't really care why it failed anymore.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: It's just... now that it's running stable, does that mean the original theory was solid? Isn't it proof that tech created using the Augmented Resonance framework actually has value?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Aw, don't mention it, little chuuballs! Piece of cake. Just doing my duty as a Synchronist.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Yes, Lenie. It has immense potential.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I see.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: At first, I really wanted to bring it back. Wanted to show everyone who keeps slapping Warren's label on me that the tech itself wasn't the problem.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: But ever since the prototype's first launch, it never lived up to what its creators wanted. Never became a "sun."

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: And yet here, in the Dimmr Plains... it finally did. The Soliskin live alongside it. Built a home around it.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: If I took it back now... what would it even accomplish? Just to end some pointless argument?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Leaving it here is the real win. After all, the future of this technology... isn't it already in my hands?

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The genius most like Warren. Professor Anselm wasn't wrong.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Professor Mornye?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Nothing. You did well, Lenie. One day, you'll be an excellent Synchronist.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: But for now, you're coming back to the Institute with me. We need a statement regarding your... creative interpretation of exploration protocols.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Between the solo operation, the unauthorized entry into a hazardous zone, and the unapproved use of dangerous equipment... You're going to be writing reflections for a while.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Oh no... {PlayerName}, save me!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Uh, actually... they're asking if you can leave the prototype here.
With Abby interpreting, Lenie finally understands what they've been trying to say.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Sorry. My task was to fix and recover it... Where it goes isn't my call to make.

speaker: NPC #850477
anh_en: Chulu?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: This was a Helios prototype. A piece of the Collective's history. The only machine in the world that has validated the Augmented Resonance framework.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: The prototype data and Lenie's Terminal logs have been forwarded to Spacetrek Collective.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: Thank you for your work, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: You too, Professor Anselm.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: How did you know it was me?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: You're the one who tipped Mornye about the flow valve. Only person who knows that prototype inside out, besides Warren himself, is the one who ran the research back then.

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: Hah. Guess there's no hiding from you... {PlayerName}, if you've got time, stop by the Institute?

speaker: NPC #850472
anh_en: I'd like to talk about all this in person.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: Take this, {PlayerName}. Please make sure it ends up in Lenie's hands.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This isn't your fault.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: It's just such a waste, {PlayerName}. He had the kind of talent I could only dream of, and he threw it all away. What a joke.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: Lenie is so much like him. Brilliant. Sharp. Confident to a fault. Stubborn as hell.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: But after seeing how this all turned out, I'm finally at ease. With you and Mornye looking out for her, I know she'll put her talents to good use.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: Anyway, I believe President Lucilla was looking for you. If you have a moment, do stop by her office.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Anselm hands you a notebook filled with cramped, messy handwriting.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What's this?

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: Notes and experimental data from when Warren and I were researching Augmented Resonance.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: Lenie... She's going to carry his work forward, I know it. This should help her.
Why don't you give it to her yourself?

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: Sorry, but I... I'm not the right person to guide her. I can't even bring myself to face what happened back then.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: As the person in charge, the responsibility for that accident falls on my shoulders. I was the one who pushed for Warren's proposal, but I couldn't find enough evidence to back him up when his theories were questioned.

speaker: NPC #100094
anh_en: That man... he was different from me. Arrogant and selfish, no question. But a genius. If that lab accident hadn't happened... Maybe—

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Ah, there you are, {PlayerName}. Lenie.
(Tell her the truth.)
(Tell her a white lie.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...By then, he'd thrown away his dignity and his ideals as a member of the Spacetrek Collective.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I see... I never thought he'd fall that far. The President was right... it is a harsh lesson.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: He regretted what he did at the very end.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Really? If he managed to find his way back to his original path in his final moments... then at least he didn't die a total disgrace.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Lucilla simply offers a small, knowing smile, giving no further hint. It seems the choice of how to frame it is entirely yours.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You take out the notebook Anselm entrusted to you and hand it to Lenie.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Anselm wanted you to have this, Lenie.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Yes, I—

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Professor Anselm? But... wasn't he always at odds with Warren?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Lenie, no one at the Collective wants to see you become the next Warren.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Talent is a double-edged sword. The sharper it is, the easier it breaks.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: I may not be a research genius, but as the President of this Academy, it's my duty to ensure your potential is guided the right way.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: President, I...

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: That research application for the Multi-Turret Club? Approved. Time to spread your wings, Lenie.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: But don't forget what happened today. And don't forget the trust everyone's shown you.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: That's our promise, okay?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Yes! Don't worry, President. I won't let you down!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I should thank you, {PlayerName}. For everything!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: If you and Professor Mornye hadn't been there, and it was just me out there... I think I'd...
You had me come just so Lenie could thank me?
No need to be so formal.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Well... Lenie, I believe you had something to ask {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I do. So, {PlayerName}...

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I need to know. My mentor, Professor Warren... In his final moments, what was he like?

speaker: NPC #701081
anh_en: Thank you for everything, Mentor.

speaker: NPC #701081
anh_en: Looking for the core's energy together actually reminded me of our school days...

speaker: NPC #701081
anh_en: You were the one who put me on this path to begin with.

speaker: NPC #701081
anh_en: ...If you're ever free, let's go out and spend more time together?

anh_en: Thanks for backing Lenie up, {PlayerName}. You went out of your way.

anh_en: You did, too.

anh_en: Let me buy you a drink sometime.

anh_en: Is that even allowed at the Academy?

anh_en: Absolutely. This is what we call "adult discretion." Perfectly above board.

anh_en: Chulu! Chulu!

anh_en: Chulu! Chulu!

anh_en: Isn't it better to just live your own life here? You've got a chance to start over. That's something.

anh_en: Phew... thanks for the backup! Wait, I've seen you before... You must be {PlayerName}, right?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: And that thing in the distance? That's why I'm here. Its structure looks a lot like Helios, doesn't it?
The device from the New Solar Ceremony?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Exactly! I'm here to research it. People rarely set foot in the Dimmr Plains, so there's a real chance this thing still works like a Reactor Drive.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Whaddya say, {PlayerName}? Wanna join me? I have a hunch it might be the key to cleaning up the contamination here too!

speaker: NPC #200042

speaker: NPC #750088
