anh_en: There's a Soliskin under attack!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Let's move, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: By the way, why did you get the name Cher?

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chulu? Chu?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Mm-hmm... You do seem like a Soliskin of action.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Cher explained its name to me just now. And what about you, Amaro?

speaker: NPC #850475
anh_en: Chululu! Chulu.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Aha! So that's why you two don't always see eye to eye...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Doesn't look like the thing the Soliskin described... I should search somewhere else.

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chulu! Chulu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh, Cher said the prototype's ignition is what brought the Twilight Woodlands back to life.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: They've prepared some gifts for us in that underground cave we went to before.

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chululu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It said the view down there is incredible. They want us to bring Mornye and Lenie back to see it sometime.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Chu! Lu!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chu! Lu!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Chuchu! Lu!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Chulu?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chulu!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Chuuu—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Luuu—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Soliskin gather around and break into a clumsy, joyful dance.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Voidmatter's gone, so... looks like this place is their playground now.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The light source is cut out. Gotta find a way to rekindle it.

speaker: NPC #850442
anh_en: Chulu, chulu!
Abby flies out from your Tacet Mark looking half-asleep.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ugh, don't wanna think about... TARD-E, TARD-E, the more you do, the less there'll be...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I heard Zahira just refilled her dessert stock.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hello, hello! This is your personal interpreter Abby speaking! Live simultaneous interpretation, ready to go! So, let's hear what this cute Soliskin has to share with us!

speaker: NPC #850442
anh_en: Chulu! Chulu, chu, chulu!!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby listens to the Soliskin and nods thoughtfully.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: This is Cher, {PlayerName}. It came with its friends to fix that "micro Reactor Drive," and it needs our help.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It got lost while trying to disperse the dense Voidmatter around here. The other Soliskin are still trapped in the contamination zone.
Cher... That's its name?
Soliskin know how to disperse Voidmatter?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Huh? Don't mention it. Cracking a few Tacet Discords is nothing for a Synchronist.

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chulululu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Sounds like there was this pink-haired girl who used to come here all the time. Helped clear out the Voidmatter. She gave them names a few years back.

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chulu! Chulu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: This way! It said Soliskin energy can activate the components left behind by the Exostrider. We can use that to disperse the Voidmatter!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: But if you really want to thank me, will you tell me where this giant metal chunk came from?

speaker: NPC #850442
anh_en: Chulu? Chulu, chu, chulu!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Wait, give me a sec... Yeah... Mm-hmm.
What did it say?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: ...Yeah, I uh... don't actually speak Soliskin.
...Good thing I brought a senior interpreter along.
Time to work, Abby!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like the only way through is clearing out these monsters.

speaker: NPC #850475
anh_en: Chuuchuu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: The Soliskin just gave your Hoverdroid a boost. Give it a go!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Looks like this isn't the real target... Let's move on, Senior.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's attracting that TD contaminated by Voidmatter again! Let's take it out fast.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The frequency flunctuation spikes. This must be the real target!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It worked! Now, we just need to eliminate it.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: It worked! That power... could it be from the Exostrider too?

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chulu... chulu.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: The Voidmatter we dispersed came back? Let's try it again from a different angle, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: After expressing their gratitude, Cher and its Soliskin friends share what they know about the "micro Reactor Drive."
Maybe we should contact the Spacetrek Collective.
You're right. Let's do what we can to investigate first.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: By the time they approve anything, it'll be too late. Let's try handling it ourselves first.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: Great minds think alike!

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chulu... chulu!!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: They're not the only Soliskin living in this area. Cher is worried that if we wait too long, the others will end up trapped in a contaminated zone too.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: I get it. But don't you worry, little chuuball. You've got two Resonators right here! Leave it to us!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I'm an engineering major. Used to work on Reactor Drive projects with... Anyway, I know what I'm doing. I'll take care of this side.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: You're better in a fight than I am. Take Cher and go find the other Soliskin? If anything happens, let's message on WavesLine.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: You mean this thing was running stable before the Stridergate incident?

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: And you think rebooting it could clear the contamination here?
How do you plan to reboot it, then?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Soliskin power comes from the Exostrider. Cher and the others want to channel that light back into the device.

speaker: NPC #850474
anh_en: Chu... Chulu.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It said... it's similar to returning to the Solistrees.

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: What?! But that would mean... Besides, that little bit of power won't even be enough! No way. We just beat the Threnodian, we can't let them sacrifice themselves like this!

speaker: NPC #200042
anh_en: {PlayerName}, we need to study this device. There's gotta be another way!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Lenie's right. This device does look similar to the Reactor Drive. Just in case, I'll take a photo and send it to Mornye.)

speaker: NPC #50110
anh_en: My sword stands ready! The gods blessed it, so it will always be sharp. By the knight's code, I hereby challenge you to a duel!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The boy playing knight seems to have nothing but dueling on his mind. You have no choice but to walk away.

speaker: NPC #50110
anh_en: ...No, no! That sounded weak. Let me try again!
(Clap.)

speaker: NPC #50110
anh_en: A black armor, a well-crafted sword in hand... and a flying servant. Are you the foreign knight and the sword spirit passing through Egla Town?

speaker: NPC #50110
anh_en: Care for a duel?
Hold it there...
Easy, easy...

speaker: NPC #50110
anh_en: Ah, say no more. If you want to prove you mean no harm, we must duel! A duel settles everything!

speaker: NPC #50112
anh_en: Greetings, honorable chevalier from afar. I presume you wish Egla Town to be your starting point to distant horizons?

speaker: NPC #50112
anh_en: Well, you're in luck! I offer a range of... services that might just pique your interest.
Services?

speaker: NPC #50112
anh_en: Oh, you know—sharp blades, swift steeds. A promising knight like yourself deserves only the finest gear for the road ahead.

speaker: NPC #50112
anh_en: Is this little flying fellow your servant? Well, it could certainly use a more dashing ensemble. Perhaps I could have something tailor-made...

speaker: NPC #50112
anh_en: Hey! Don't leave just yet...

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: The craftsmanship of this wax seal is simply exquisite. And is that a floral scent?

speaker: NPC #50114
anh_en: Don't get too cocky. You're not the only one with an invitation. It seems like one of those Ragunna nobles is hosting a banquet to recruit new knights for their household.

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: A banquet... That means plenty of nobles will be attending. Perhaps...

speaker: NPC #50114
anh_en: You might want to polish up on your basic etiquette first. I wouldn't want to see you make a fool of yourself in front of all those fussy Ragunna nobles.

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: Fine, Fine. It's just... a matter of remembering how it goes, right?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Ah, outlander. You're up rather early in the hour, aren't you? What can I do for you?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Hmm, there's a line missing. In the name of Korlacchi, I will remain true to all that I love and protect until my last breath.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Where did you learn those words? Was it from Carlow?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Carlow? No, no, we only met him yesterday. It's from the night...
Ahem...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh, it's from... it's from a knight who loves the night. He was the one who told us.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: This knight you speak of. Where did you meet him? Is he still around town?
Uh... he's already left.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: ...So, Carlow really did meet a knight. It's just like the day he came dashing over to me, reciting those same words you did.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: I thought he read those in a book. But he insisted that he heard it from a knight passing by.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's about a knight, Mr. Cosimo. Have you ever heard an oath that goes like this...

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: I had a feeling that Korlacchi might be a family name and that the knight's oath reflected his path of service, so I asked Carlow about the knight's livery.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Carlow described how the knight dismounted from a weathered warhorse, clad in silver armor. He removed his helmet and laid his hands on Carlow's head.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Then he pulled a ring from his pocket and told Carlow he would continue his journey into the depths of Whisperwind Haven, seeking distant horizons.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: He asked if Carlow wanted to be a knight and gave him this ring as a keepsake, telling Carlow to rewalk his path one day.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: To reach the end where he had arrived, and then... to journey even further.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: But this ring is made from coarse steel. Nothing like what Carlow described.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: So I had my doubts about Carlow's tale. I thought he'd gotten lost in those knightly stories and made it all up.
Where is Carlow now?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: He... At this hour, I imagine he's roaming the outskirts of town, searching for the knight's trails.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: In the name of Korlacchi, I pledge to show mercy and kindness to the weak. Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all...

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: He intends to find the knight and the family he serves to complete the knighting ceremony in Korlacchi's name and finally become a true knight.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: There's a large tree not far from town, where he said he found the first trail. Do you plan to go after him?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Do you think you can catch up with that knight? If you can, please help the poor boy find the knighthood he's been dreaming about.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: That tree... I remember you can see it from the highest point in town. That may be your best bet. I'll leave Carlow to you, then.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You observe Cosimo closely as Abby delivers its spot-on impression of the Mad Knight. The slight dilation of his pupil gives away the answer you need.
Mr. Cosimo?
Mr. Cosimo?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Sounds like something is going on between the Mad Knight and the knight Carlow met as a kid. But one of 'em is a TD while the other one's a human. How are they...?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Mad Knight's trails may lead us to the truth. Let's keep it between ourselves for now until we find Carlow.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Why's he just sitting here like a statue? Hey, Carlow! Can ya hear me?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abby, there's something strange about this floating Echo...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Where am I...? I—it's you...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The knight told us he plans to travel further and hopes we can follow his trail to meet him one day.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Exactly! He spoke those very words to me. Maybe he's traveling to uphold his family's values of chivalry and recruit new knights!

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Are you also here to look for him? If you seek his trail, you're standing on it.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: You were stung by a Primordia Bloom hidden in this Echo and were in hallucination.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I see. That explains why I was seeing... Thank you! You are the outlanders from the inn, right? I'm sorry you had to witness my embarrassment again.
You should also thank Ms. Margherita...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: In the name of Korlacchi, I...
Express my sincerest gratitude.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: You... you know these words. That means you've met the knight!
(Nod.)

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: With humility, justice, and bravery... I vow never to use force against women, children, or the defenseless. I will stand against injustice until my last breath.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I... forgive me. But... Mr. Cosimo, tell me the truth. You don't really believe I saw a knight when I was a child, do you?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: How's that, Mr. Cosimo? I didn't miss a word. Can we start the knighting ceremony now?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Well, you recited it perfectly, but... I'm no longer part of the Order. What you have before you now is only a simple innkeeper. I'm afraid... I've no right to knight you.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: I do have some old friends still in the Order. If you can wait a bit longer I can...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: No right? I can't wait any longer! Every time we get this far, Mr. Cosimo, you always come up with one excuse after the other to delay the ceremony.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Watch your words, Carlow! Accusations like that betray everything you just swore to uphold. And to say such things in front of an outlander?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: This must be where he made camp. I can see signs he was here.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: This was just one stop along his quest. Since you've come here to find him, will you join me for the rest of the journey?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I still have more leads we can follow. By the way, we haven't been properly introduced yet, have we?
Call me {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, what about me? You can call me Abby. {PlayerName} here is pretty tough and all, but...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, I wasn't finished! Wait for me...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: See, he must have passed through here too. These traces suggest he was doing high jump training.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: They say your journey is also part of your training. I guess he didn't waste a chance to hone his skills.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: {PlayerName}, what do you say? Shall we give it a try ourselves? The only problem is, how do we jump that high?
Oh, I have an idea!

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Sorry, I was just... stunned. Back at the camp, I started to see the resemblance of the knight in you.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Just like the knights of legends, you charged forward... with humility, honor, and bravery.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: But you're different from the knights I've met in town. They don't venture far into Whisperwind Haven, nor do they dare set up camp in the wild. They loiter around town before heading back to the city...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: What kind of knight should I be? I catch myself asking that question from time to time.
But you've made your choice.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: My choice... I-I don't know... We... Let's keep going.

Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. The name Korlacchi... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Just a bit further and we'll reach Windmill Lodge. That's where all traces of the knight vanish.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I must have overlooked something! This time, I swear I'll find what I'm looking for!

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Let's get going.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Mr. Millkeeper, it's been some time. You seem to be in a good mood today.
They aren't from Egla Town?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I can't say for certain. Stories about them vary. Some say Windmill Keepers are a mysterious part of Egla Town's history tasked with maintaining the Windmills.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: It's also said that the Windmill Keepers are outcasts—people who have nowhere else to go after returning from the sea. They choose to make their homes in the abandoned windmills.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Whichever the case, their presence never disrupts the peace in Whisperwind Haven. I doubt anyone would want to be the troublemaker.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Abby? You... What's the matter?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Huh, that's a familiar smell...
Keep Mr. Millkeeper safe, Carlow.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Wait. Where are you going? {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Let me introduce my guests from a foreign land. They also had the pleasure of encountering the knight...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Hmm...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Don't worry, {PlayerName}, Mr. Millkeeper doesn't mean to be unfriendly. He's been acting like that from the day I knew him.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: He's not much of a talker, but he always laid out tea and snacks for me during my search for the knight.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Never mentioned his name. Seeing that he lives right here, I began to call him Mr. Millkeeper considering the townsfolk call people like him Windmill Keepers.
Are they also outlanders?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: We're gettin' close. What's the matter, {PlayerName}? Run out of gas already?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I don't know. I feel like after leaving Egla Town, the Mad Knight's Echo became... restless.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Restless? The knight... Right, maybe it's just following its oath? I remember Cosimo and Carlow both said a true knight would never betray the path of service he swore.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I mean, wouldn't they fight TDs out of instinct? Maybe if we used its power in the right way, it could help us out...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Whoa! I knew it be strong, but not that strong.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Does this mean it really is...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Hey... {PlayerName}, Abby...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Phew... We finally caught up with you. You move too fast. What happened just now... Was it another TD?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: You mean there were others? I don't think I've ever seen any besides you, Mr. Millkeeper.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Of course there were. Some choose to move on, and some... well, they just aged out.
Who were they?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: The so-called Windmill Keepers in today's language. But back in the day, I... We were called knights too—though more accurately, we were considered fake knights who excelled at deception.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: We were outcasts, people in distress, and many ordinary folks who were drawn in by the legend. We'd find an old horse and cobble together some makeshift armor, and fashion a sword.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: We clung to our notions of the knight's oath, laughingstocks wherever we went, dreaming of exploring Whisperwind Haven and even venturing beyond its limits.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Legends of knighthood continued to spread, but over time, the knights in these stories grew more noble and refined with every retelling...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: When the people of Egla Town finally realized that there were newcomers settling in Whisperwind Haven, the nameless knights had already become the Windmill Keepers.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: S-So what you're saying is… the Windmill Keepers weren't protecting the Windmills. They were watching over... Whisperwind Haven.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: It wasn't till we arrived that we realized the many dangers lurking throughout the land. Moving forward wasn't as simple as we thought.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmph, that's right. But {PlayerName} and I took care of it with the old one-two. No biggie.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Then a knight tossed a ring made of rough steel onto the table and said briskly, "Let's carve out a path ahead."

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Soon enough, others will follow and reach the same place we have...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: My younger self wouldn't dare believe words spoken so lightly. A new path meant risking everything, even our lives.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: That knight might have noticed my hesitation. He came over to talk to me and recited his oath.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: In the name of Korlacchi, I hold fast to humility and justice... Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: He was right. This was the path we all swore to... and he stuck to it until the very end, right here in Whisperwind Haven.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: B-But how were you so sure that more people would come? What if...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Ha... Remember the ring? We were knights skilled in deception, so why not make it all one grand performance?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Well, aren't you two sharp...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: He would travel far and wide with those rings, and in the name of Korlacchi, preach the knightly way to anyone who dared dream of becoming one.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Regardless of wealth, title, or position...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: So who was he?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Funny you ask. Despite his vigor, he was just an ordinary farmer from the countryside...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: An ordinary farmer... A knight of deceit... Korlacchi. Never really existed...
Carlow!
Abby, stop him!
Carlow runs away in a hurry. As Mr. Millkeeper looks confused by Carlow's outburst, you explain that Carlow has been chasing after the knight.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Yes, they sure are... Huh? Mr. Millkeeper... did you just say something?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: ...Are you both warriors drawn here by the knight's legend?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Haven't seen such fools in a long time. Watching you two charge in like that... exactly like the ones that came before you.
The young man politely bids you goodbye and leaves in silence...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: ...I see. That must be a bitter pill for the boy to swallow. All this time chasing after a dream only to find out it was an illusion all along.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: You mean the Mad Knight?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Mad Knight? So that's what the townsfolk call him. Not bad... At least he's got a title now.
What exactly is it...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: He appeared around the same time as the Windmill Keepers. There's no doubt "he" is a Tacet Discord.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: But the swordsmanship, the way he speaks, and his stance against other TDs all remind me of him.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: People say that TDs can absorb lingering frequencies...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: I believe he exists because the essence of knighthood has taken root deep in Whisperwind Haven.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: He swings his sword against enemies to protect the things he loves. When he points his sword at the common folk he meets, I think he's challenging them to a duel... He hopes someone will accept his challenge.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: He is showing that to be a true knight, one must abandon uncertainty, confront fears, and wield their sword with courage.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: This wasn't where he lost the knight's trail. It's where his journey ended.
Can you tell me your name, and the others?
I'd like your name to remember you.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Names... Hmm, no one's asked that before. What's wrong with using a common title?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh, I know. {PlayerName} is great at picking names. Come on, do your magic!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Nameless... Windmill...
Let's call you Whisperwind Knight.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Like the wind, it leaves a trail that's difficult to trace, yet it journeys to distant lands...

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Whisperwind Knight...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: People love to romanticize the past, don't they? The knight in shining armor we saw as children was really just an ordinary farmer in tattered rags riding a frail old horse.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Please, apologize to him for me. We are liars, nothing more. But... once he's cooled off, he will come to understand. He's been seeking what we once sought, after all.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Everyone who made it here left their marks. The trails they walked, the words they spoke, the tales of the ones who explored the furthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven...

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: These things shine brighter than any life and are more genuine than any knightly title.
Have you... ever felt lonely on this path?

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Haha, perhaps this path of chivalry we uphold is always meant to be walked alone. Besides, "he" is always there.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: You must have met him, right? The Echo that you used in the battle just now was displaying his sword skills.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Carlow has probably made it back to town by now. What are you going to say when you see him...?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: He should have had enough time to think things over. Let's go speak to him.

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: What do we have here? Our little pretend knight isn't out chasing footprints today. Just standing there like he's lost his spark.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I will remain true to all that I love and protect until my last breath.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all...

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: What's got into you? Reciting your little fantasy knight's oath now?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Right here, I, Carlow, swear to the knight's code and challenge you to a duel.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Do you know which part of the fish is the best? Can you practice your sword skills with just a simple wooden pole? Do you know the best path deeper into Whisperwind Haven...?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Have you ever truly helped someone without expecting anything in return, or charged toward a giant with no thought for yourself?

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: This duel... it all comes down to an apology. The loser must apologize to the victor...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, check it out. I think Carlow's got that wannabe tough guy acting all scared.

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: By the way, have you received the invitation? We're just about to buy the attire for the ceremony. Why don't you join us?
Let's go.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Huh? What if Carlow gets bullied...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let knights handle their own matters. In the name of Korlacchi...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: So, what does Korlacchi mean anyhow?
Someone needs to visit the library more often.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Huh? No way. Not happening. Reading makes me nauseous. Just tell me the answer already!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Korlacchi, in the Rinascita language, means courage.

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: Not every day you get to have a "real" knight be as your guide, after all...

speaker: NPC #50114
anh_en: Come on. We've wasted enough time here already...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey... Those are the two we met earlier.
Shh...

speaker: NPC #50113
anh_en: Forget it. You may as well be a rock if you've nothing to say. Off we go on...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: ...(Breathes deeply.)

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: In the name of Korlacchi, I pledge to show mercy and kindness to the weak...

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Aw, don't worry, Abby! Just follow these steps and {PlayerName} will wake up in no time. See?
A strange knight?

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Yep, and he wasn't like any knight I've ever seen in the city. He was handing out these knight rings to everyone and asking if they wanted to be a knight and explore the depths of Whisperwind Haven.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: But being a knight was never my dream, you know! Since I was a child, I wanted to open a restaurant in the city. Nothing makes me happier than seein' the smiles on my customers' faces!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: After I told him that, the knight took the ring away and plopped his helmet on my head, sayin', "Maybe you don't need this ring after all."

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Oh... I'd better be off now! I came to Egla Town to find some inspiration for new recipes. Something with a knightly twist, I think...

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: I'm glad I could lend a hand! As for that chipper young lad over there, he's been in it longer than you, so it might take him a wee bit to come around. But don't fret, it's not serious!
As Margherita waves goodbye, you both wait patiently for Carlow to wake up from his hallucination.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Hi ya, it's been a while. Do you remember me? Or... do you still know where you are?
This is Whisperwind Haven...
You're Margherita...

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Right as a nut! That means you're A-okay! Just sit tight and get some more rest.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Good, you still remember my name! That means you're A-okay! Just get some more rest and you'll be up and at 'em again.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: You really scared the crap out of me, {PlayerName}! You froze up like Carlow when you touched that thing. Luckily, Margherita came by and snapped you out of it.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: You must have touched a Primordia Bloom that hid itself under the Echo. They bring weird hallucinations to anyone who touches them.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: I touched one when I was little, and a strange knight taught me how to break free from it.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: What a boy... Sorry about the ruckus, outlander. Are you checking in? If not, it's getting late. You wouldn't want to be caught out there during the Night Reveries.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Knights from far and wide would gather here before setting off to the depth of Whisperwind Haven in search of the legend's origin.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: As more knights filled our streets, an odd one emerged. These days, folks like to call him the "Mad Knight."

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: He only shows himself after dusk. Folks say he roams the outskirts, hunting down Tacet Discords. Get too close, and you might find yourself on the sharp end of his blade!

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: That's how he became the "Mad Knight," the talk of the town. We reckon he's cursed now from wrestling with those wretches for so long.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: To placate this restless soul, the town created the Night Reveries—endless dramas of the knight enacted by the Echoes. Townsfolk and visitors alike were advised to stay indoors at night.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: But... there's one lad who stands apart. Fancies that the knight isn't mad at all. He believes a true knight would never betray their oath, no matter the cost.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: For him, every swing of a knight's sword must carry meaning. To prove his theory, the boy is hell-bent on becoming a knight and challenging the Mad Knight to a duel.
The young man from earlier?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Yes, Carlow. We all thought it was just another childhood fantasy, but he's held onto that dream to this day.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Becoming a knight doesn't sound too bad. Hehe, you get all the cool points plus who can resist that suit of armor?!

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: True, but those are knights who have earned their reputations. Maintaining <ano=purity>"knighthood"</ano> is a thing of the past now.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Oh, look at the time! Apologies for rambling on, traveler. If you need a place to stay, just let me know.
Night Reveries?
(They say he's cursed...)
(Could it be a symptom of Overclocking?)

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Yes. You probably noticed the graffiti, statues, and signs all scattered across town, no?
They all feature a knight.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Now that you mentioned it, we did see a bunch of kids running around with wooden swords and bedsheets for capes.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Ah, those youngsters are just reenacting the knight's play. The Night Reveries are a kind of a performance, too. They can be traced back to the legend of a brave knight who slayed a giant in Whisperwind Haven.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Since then, the legendary knight has become an irreplaceable symbol of humility, honor, and bravery for the town. The oath the boy just recited is one of the legacies the knight left us.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: So you're thinking that knight-guy's Overclocked, huh? I don't know, but one thing's for sure I'm picking up a bunch of familiar smells all over this place.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Come on, it's not far now. The Echoes are getting ready for their opening act, all set to welcome the star of the night.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Sheesh. Look at 'em go! They look like they're gearing up for a loony party instead of a proper knightly display.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A Tacet Discord... To its credit, that's not a bad knight impression.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: What's all that about? Is it challenging us to a duel?

speaker: NPC #200052
anh_en: In the name of Korlacchi...

speaker: NPC #200052
anh_en: Across the rivers of time, wherever my path may lead, I vow to uphold justice and fairness for all...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That voice just now... Did you hear that, Abby?
No one will believe it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's ask Cosimo about those mumblings in the morning. He might know a thing or two.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Sure thing. Come to think of it, I feel like we're being pretty knightly ourselves right now, don't you think?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I, Abby, and the great knight {PlayerName}, two heroes who solved a legendary mystery with humility, justice, and bravery... Heh, a knighting ceremony would make it even cooler.
It's a ceremony, nothing more.
Titles don't hold much value for me.
You and Abby wait until the morning and decide to ask Cosimo about the mumblings.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And also... What was that in the end...?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: TDs usually mumble the stuff they're trying to say. It might've learned it from somewhere, or maybe the frequencies it absorbed had strong emotions and desires.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: In the name of Korlacchi... seems like something a knight might say before charging into battle.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I can't wait to see the townsfolk's faces when they find out the legendary Mad Knight is actually a TD.

speaker: NPC #50043
anh_en: Come. Fight me, and fall before me.

speaker: NPC #50042
anh_en: Eek! Who are you?! Leave me alone!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are you hiding from something?

speaker: NPC #50042
anh_en: Plushies! Hordes of them, with pointy horns!

speaker: NPC #50042
anh_en: You look like a mighty one. Could you drive them all away, please?

speaker: NPC #50042
anh_en: Please, I beg of you! Chase away those Plushies and I'll give you everything I have, even my sword!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: What is this? An empty sword pedestal? There are more of them nearby.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The swords are all missing.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: So, we need to find those swords to get things moving, huh? But where are we gonna find them?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: On the pedestal, there's a tale about a knight called "Silver Moon." Maybe we can discover something at the places recorded.

speaker: NPC #900338
anh_en: On the ninety-fifth full moon of my knighthood, I managed to gather fifteen crates of donations. After giving dues to the Order and the family I serve, only five remained. Even with the three crates I donated... No, it's not enough. It's nowhere near enough! O Sentinel, please enlighten me: why do the greediest souls always hide behind the banner of generosity?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's fine... We won't get spotted here... We can just get it back after they're gone...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's too close! They're gonna see us!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: (Are we walking on water now?)

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I smell something weird, right under our feet!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (Could there be something hidden under the water? I should look around.)

speaker: NPC #50042
anh_en: Please, I beg of you! Chase away those Plushies and I'll give you everything I have, even my sword!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: When the scorching sun falls, the silver moon shall rise again.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: When the scorching sun falls, the silver moon shall rise again.... What does that mean?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: When the sun falls... It should mean the time around sunset. But why "rise again?"

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: The sun's setting soon. We'll wait and find out!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: That knight's truly somethin'! But what happened between him and the five knights we met before? And why did they take his swords?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I see! So if we keep facing every challenge, our names will have a lot more worth as well! Alright then, we've got a long journey ahead!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: My guess is that the five knights represent the trials this knight once faced. After he died, those memories transformed into Tacet Discords.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Aha, that adds up!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Then… did this knight pass his trials or not?
Maybe only the "Silver Moon" himself knows.
The truth behind the legends can often be misleading.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Maybe. Being a knight sounds super exhausting, one challenge after another...

speaker: Rover
anh_en: It's those challenges that made his title truly worthy.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Woah! All these Fractsidus fellas lying on the ground... Was it that big guy's doing?

speaker: NPC #900258
anh_en: Force... is justice... Force... is mercy!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Mine... all mine...

speaker: NPC #50044
anh_en: All those who profess to be generous… give everything you possess!

speaker: NPC #900259
anh_en: Now I understand... I understand it all...

speaker: NPC #900259
anh_en: There's no need for thinking whatsoever! I'll simply do whatever they command!

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: It was a hollow duel. My old rival had been bribed by the House, and in the end, handed me the victory.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: The glory of the arena belongs to the spectators and the House. Never to me.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: The old story mentioned how the warden of this tower once won the championship. But he refused the title. For that, his House cast him out.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Because his opponent threw the match?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Yes. For most Gladiators, glory matters more than life itself. Failure you can live with. But a false victory? Never.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Those threads stretch upwards. I can feel it... Isth, the Scourgewing, is up on that platform.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It has endured across the ages, and now, it's truly here. Within sight, within reach.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Blocked again. Why are there barricades everywhere in this tower?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Figures. Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Hm? There's another painting downstairs... Let's go take a look.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: The Border Mountains, where trials await—

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: I sought glory in the wilds. Never defeated, yet never truly fulfilled.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: I challenged every kind of power, until I forged a pact with the Dragon. Yet it never yielded. It never gave up its freedom.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: …This must be the moment the tower's warden faced the Scourgewing. He invoked the ancient rites of dueling to earn the dragon's respect and claim it as his own.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: After that, they kept challenging each other. It's... hard to understand, really.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I suppose this is the way they chose to be with each other.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It's Isth... Wrapped in those strange threads. It looks unconscious, like it's trapped in a nightmare.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We'll have to cut through the mess to get to it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This place… it feels like a Sonoro.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I want to see it fly free in the skies again, not locked away in this... shadowed cage.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Of course. There should be more frequencies in the lower area. Let's search for them.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: If we can recover more of these frequencies for Isth, it might be able to wake from its nightmare.
For a moment, you feel the helmet dissolve into a frequency, merging with the dragon's own.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Like the weight of all the frequencies inside the tower has warped the space itself.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Wait, the helmet... Its frequency is being absorbed?

speaker: NPC #850300
anh_en: *A roar echoes, heavy with meaning*

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It's trying to say something... it's like a broken, mournful whisper.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Fla...vio? That sounds like a name.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Could it be the tower warden's?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Likely so. And that helmet we found might've been his. That would explain Isth's reaction.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: ...I hate to ask, but can you help set it free?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Those specter-like platforms just solidified out of nowhere...

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It's like Isth is using the scattered frequencies to restore the crumbled platforms.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It's helping us. Now we can take the stairs to the lower level.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: The Eye of Ananke, ancient and enduring. The Dark Tide stirs, and Tacet Discords continue to manifest.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: This tower stands as a joint effort between the Black Shores and Septimont, built to monitor the Eye and provide early warnings of impending disasters.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: But over the years, it has done nothing but gaze silently at the sky, as still as death itself.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: Tower Guardians: ████, ███, Archid, Flavio.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This tower… was once a Black Shores' observation facility?

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: Archid, Flavio, and Isth.

speaker: NPC #850297
anh_en: In memory of a fleeting friendship—born in the wilds, and ended there as well.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I can't get in... Need to find another way...

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Isth… you're nervous. Something's coming, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: …I know. You and Iaen have always had a feel for when something's about to go wrong.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: But it's not the Eye this time. So… what could it be?

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Well, whatever it is, that's why this tower was built. That's why we stayed all these years.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: …Is it finally my turn, Archid?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Are we seeing... what happened right before disaster strikes?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: …Come on. Let's go find Isth.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Okay. Let's give it the frequencies we found in the armor and weapons.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Isth's power has recovered a little, but those threads have coiled around it again... These corrupted frequencies aren't so easily dispelled.

speaker: NPC #850303
anh_en: *A resolute roar*

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: You… You want to witness… my moment of glory? Just as I once witnessed Archid's final stand?

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: He couldn't speak anymore… but when I took the Blake Bloom from his hand, he smiled like a hero. No… he was a hero.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Hah… Haha… So this is what it means to die with purpose. I've finally found it… my own kind of glory.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So that's how it was… Isth, you held your ground until the very last moment.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: No wonder the hatred and grief spawned by the Dark Tide still bind you so tightly.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But we're here now.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: To set Isth free, we must eliminate the remaining Dark Tide remnants at the top of the tower.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: That thick black fog on the horizon… the all-devouring Dark Tide. It's been preliminarily identified as a new form of Waveworn Phenomenon.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: All our defenses failed, but I managed to sound the alarm in time. The signal should have reached all of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Tch. Just brushing against that thing… feels like a thousand voices clawing through my skull. This arm's done for.

speaker: NPC #850303
anh_en: *A low, sorrowful roar*

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Thanks. That feels better. Ah, Isth… After all the duels and clashes between us, it's finally over.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: I'll stay. Someone has to send this observation data back to Tethys. This is where my journey ends.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Go, Isth. Fly away before the black tide surges in. Our pact is over.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: …Why are you staying? Wasn't it your dream… to reclaim your freedom?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Those new stairs… they lead to the top of the tower.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: That pavilion outside the tower wasn't there before. It must be a clue Isth left for us.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I can see the pavilion clearly now, but the path ahead won't be easy...

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Oh, it's Isth's specter... It's here to help us!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The frequencies nearby are converging on this blade. Whatever it is, it's carrying immense power...

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Kind stranger... Return the sky to Isth, and the freedom I once took from it.

speaker: NPC #850302
anh_en: Take up this sword. I, Flavio, will bear witness to your great deed.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Rest assured. I'll see it through.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I think I understand its last roar.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Thank you... Farewell, Flavio.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Wait, something dropped from it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's go check.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This is what it left us… the Blake Bloom.
Are you disappointed it has flown away?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: No... I just never expected to uncover a story centuries old.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Thank you for rescuing Isth and giving this the ending it deserved. From now on, it won't be just a story anymore.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: By the way… I've not even asked your name.
Just call me {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Understood, {PlayerName}. I'll remember. I'll continue seeking traces of the Scourgewings across Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: As the tower's records show, Isth isn't alone. The <color=YellowD>Border Mountains</color> still bear their traces.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Perhaps… we'll meet again.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So this was the keepsake shared by Archid and Flavio? Isth has guarded it all these years. Look, time has taken nothing from it.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Now I see... Perhaps the Dark Tide didn't destroy this tower because Isth protected it. Not just the place, but the memory it held… of them.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It spent its life seeking freedom… and still, in the end, it chose to stay.
Isth had long bonded to Flavio.
Isth wanted to bear witness to his glory.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Their bond defied simple labels like "master and servant"...

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Isth stood by Flavio in his final moments and honored his sacrifice.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It's moving. I thought this would be just a rare chance to study a subject...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Oh? Did that roar bring you here too?
Is it trapped in the tower?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Well... there's an old story I once came across. Centuries ago, the warden of this tower tamed a Scourgewing and became its master.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Then the Dark Tide hit and swallowed everything, sealing the tower away. If the story is true... then the dragon might've never left.
Are you trying to get into the tower?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Yes. I've spent years searching for any sign of the Scourgewing, and now that I'm this close, I can't just walk away.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: But as you can see, the entrance is sealed by some kind of fibrous growth left behind by the Dark Tide. There's no way I can break through it on my own.
I might be able to help.
Not to brag, but breaking into dangerous towers is my specialty.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: That would be wonderful. Here, take a look at these strange threads along the gate. I think they're important.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So you're experienced, huh? Here, take a look at these strange threads along the gate. I think they're important.
What roar?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Hmm, it's a bit hard to explain... but introductions first. I'm Tulia, a traveling ecologist.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Have you ever heard of... Scourgewings?
Can't say I have.
The name... sort of rings a bell.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: They are extremely rare, usually dwelling in high-altitude regions way off the grid. For years now, there've been no sightings. Most just write them off as folklore at this point.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Is that so? They are extremely rare, usually dwelling in high-altitude regions way off the grid. For years now, there've been no sightings. Most just write them off as folklore at this point.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: But not long ago, I heard something right here. A roar of a Scourgewing echoing from that tower...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This is what it left us… the Blake Bloom.
Are you disappointed it has flown away?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: No... I just never expected to uncover a story centuries old.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Thank you for rescuing Isth and giving this the ending it deserved. From now on, it won't be just a story anymore.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So, turns out the one trapped in the Border Mountains is actually Iaen. This pair has been sealed and separated for centuries.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: After this long imprisonment, they finally can reunite with each other.
I wish them both the best.
May they never be caged again.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I'll continue seeking traces of these siblings. My instinct tells me that they will linger in this area for a while.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Will you come and see them if I find them again, {PlayerName}?
Of course.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Is this the keepsake once shared by Arcthid and Flavio? Isth has guarded it all these years, barely a blemish marking its surface.
I want to say hi to the dragons as well.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Okay. I'll be on my way, then. Hopefully my next search won't take as long.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So this was the keepsake shared by Archid and Flavio? Isth has guarded it all these years. Look, time has taken nothing from it.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It spent its life seeking freedom… and still, in the end, it chose to stay.
Isth had long bonded to Flavio.
Isth wanted to bear witness to his glory.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Their bond defied simple labels like "master and servant"...

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Isth stood by Flavio in his final moments and honored his sacrifice.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It's moving. I thought this would be just a rare chance to study a subject...

speaker: Giọng Nói Đàn Ông
anh_en: The arena… the wilds… the observation tower… I've spent my entire life chasing elusive glory…

speaker: Giọng Nói Đàn Ông
anh_en: No more regrets… right?

speaker: Giọng Nói Đàn Ông
anh_en: Ha... Isth...

speaker: Giọng Nói Đàn Ông
anh_en: How I wish I could see the blue skies with you once more…

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So it can be severed, after all… Good. Now we finally have a way in.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I just found traces of Iaen and Isth.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: If you're free, would you like to come and see them?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Ah, took you long enough to get here.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Look—the echoes from the Ashen Dragon's Crypt are spilling out, painting everything around us.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: This wasteland, once swallowed by the Dark Tide, is blooming with new life.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: There they are.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I saw something like this when I was a child. Back then, I lived with my family at the Gladiator's encampment right during the onset of a High Tide season.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: When the Tacet Discords came... everyone shouted for me to run. Don't stop. Don't look back. I ran. But I tripped on a hillside.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Hundreds of them were closing in. I was so scared I shut my eyes. And then, I heard it. A deafening roar right above me.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: When I opened my eyes... the monsters were gone. All that remained was a glimpse of brilliant wings disappearing into the clouds.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: …Seeing that Scourgewing was the first time I felt true wonder.
Where will they go this time?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Back to some ancient roost? Or to where the next tragedy waits to unfold?
Where are the Scourgewings?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: They've stood beside Gladiators in their final moments. Now, they carry those memories forward.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I have a feeling... As long as we share the same sky, we'll meet again.
Where are they? Where are the dragons I saved?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Isth and Iaen… they circled Capitoline Hill a few times before returning to their old trial grounds.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Maybe they wanted to see how Septimont looks now, after all these centuries.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I wonder if they were pleased or disappointed with what they saw.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Only they would know. Although judging from their roars, I'd say they were happy.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: After all, the night sky they soar freely beneath is just as beautiful as ever.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: I'm heading home for a while. To rest. To write. Isth and Iaen have given me more data than I ever dreamed of.
Safe travels.
I can't wait to see what you discover.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: …{PlayerName}, meeting you on this journey has been a gift.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: To you, this might be routine. Just another rescue along the road.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: But to me, it means everything. I want you to know…

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: …I will always… remember you.
Then add my name in your acknowledgments.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Yes, I wouldn't dream of leaving you out.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Ah, it's you again. Did that roar bring you here too?
Are you trying to get into the tower?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Yes. If the Scourgewing in the Border Mountains could be freed… then maybe this one can too.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: But as you can see, the entrance is sealed by some kind of fibrous growth left behind by the Dark Tide. There's no way I can break through it on my own.
I might be able to help.
Not to brag, but breaking into dangerous towers is my specialty.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: That would be wonderful. Here, take a look at these strange threads along the gate. I think they're important.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So you're experienced, huh? Here, take a look at these strange threads along the gate. I think they're important.
What roar?
You mean the Scourgewing?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Not long ago, I heard something right here. A roar of a Scourgewing echoing from that tower...

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Yes. Not long ago, I heard something right here. A roar of a Scourgewing echoing from that tower...
Why is it in the tower?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Well... there's an old story I once came across. Centuries ago, the warden of this tower tamed a Scourgewing and became its master.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: The two lived in the tower until the Dark Tide hit and sealed everything off. That must've been when this Scourewing got trapped, similar to what happened to the one in the Border Mountains.
