And that name, Isth"...

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It might be the name of the Scourgewing in the tower. And one of the Scourgewings from the painting!

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: So the bond between them… wasn't as noble as the old stories made it out to be, huh?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The path ahead is blocked. We'll have to go up these platforms.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Those threads again… they've sealed the way forward.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We'll slash them, same as before.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Another piece of new info. What happened next for the knights?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Sounds like whoever kept this journal was losing it. Dueling his own student? Ugh...
They held very different ideals.
They could have just talked things through.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The journal says "north"... There's no way we turn back now.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So this is the northern ruin. It's much larger than the others.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Stay sharp! I smell danger in the air.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm? Did the TD drop something different this time?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This is...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A weapon schematic?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh, so this was the end of their quest. Did they really find the relic after all?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: {PlayerName}, why are you looking up like that?
It's nothing.
We witnessed the final fate of those knights.

speaker: NPC #50154
anh_en: Seeker… This place is not the beginning of your quest…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Something about these ruins feels oddly familiar… What's that lying over there?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It doesn't feel right.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, look! Someone carved a message here on the ground!

speaker: NPC #50134
anh_en: Beneath the firelight, shadow loses its refuge.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Huh? Is this some sort of riddle?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Firelight... Maybe it's related to the torches around here? And the "shadow" could be—

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Did you see that? Something just fell off that spooky knight!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It seems to be a scrap of paper.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wait a minute... You think the TD you fought was the same one in this journal?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Ruins in the southwest, let's check it out.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's the same kind of knight TD. These ruins must be connected.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: And here come more bits and pieces!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Things were really going downhill for them! What relic were they after that was worth all this?
It's still too soon to tell.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: There's a mark on the map for a third ruin. Let's continue following their trail.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey, remember how those Fae Ignises lit up the torches at the other ruin?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Maybe we can use that to our advantage.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Hey, aren't you that Rover? You awake?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: So you know about it. That'll save me the explanation.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Incinero Petal is not a kind of plant, but an animal Tacet Discord. The flower-like structure is actually the end of its limbs.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: To eliminate the Incinero Petals themselves is pointless. To stop the pollen from spreading, we must destroy the Tacet Mark at its core.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Initially, we were thinking about blowing that thing up...
...But the Inferno Rider came along.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Technically, it didn't "come" to us; it was "discovered". That Inferno Rider seems to have been in the depths of Sea of Flames since that crisis many years ago.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Launching a direct assault on the Tacet Mark core deep within the Sea of Flames was already a daunting task, and with this Tacet Discord in play, our mission now seems nearly impossible.
Why don't you leave it to the Midnight Rangers?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: The special properties of the Sea of Flames make it safer for solo missions, so I've posted the wanted posters, hoping to recruit some skilled Resonators to defeat that TD.
By the way, who rescued me?
Professor Woodrow. Why are you here?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: We don't know either. You should ask the guys from Lollo Logistics who brought you back. They're right outside the observatory.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: This is the weather observatory in the Port City of Guixu. You passed out during a battle with the Inferno Rider. Some guys from Lollo Logistics brought you here.
The Inferno Rider?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Oh, that's the Tacet Discord you just met. It looks like a rider on a motorbike, so I named it the Inferno Rider. A good name, isn't it?
And that's the TD you put a bounty on?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Hahaha! That’s right. There’s a reason why we must put it down.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Our detection shows that the anomalous gravity field here is giving birth to a giant storm, which will sweep the pollen of Incinero Petal to the upper air.
Just like the crisis years ago.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sob sob... Waaahhh...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: All right, all right. Stop crying.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Thank goodness you both made it out safe this time. If anything had happened, you'd have not only gotten yourself killed, but also one of our customers!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: She got lost and wandered around until she bumped into me. I managed to get her out of there.
So that's why the touchpad ended up there...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Yeah, it must've been blown there by the Gravity Storm.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The Incinero Petals weren't too bad, but I didn’t expect such a powerful Tacet Discord to be lurking there...
How did you know? Did you rescue me?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Oh, was it really you who saved {Male=him;Female=her}?! That's... amazing!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Ugh... I wasn't always a manager, you know. I used to be a top courier, and getting people out of danger was just part of the job.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Wait, seriously?! I always thought you were just some old guy who coasted through the company long enough to land the manager gig...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Hey, watch it...
Did you witness the crisis from years ago?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Sob sob...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I dread remembering it, but that TD... I think it was saying... "Charge... till the end..."

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Back then, the Midnight Rangers who attacked the Tacet Mark core ended up creating a Tacet Field when they Overclocked. That Tacet Discord might've come from that.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I was one of the couriers who delivered the Explosive Spears. I saw it all happen.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The determination of those soldiers has now become the biggest obstacle to destroying the Tacet Mark. It's tragic.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: So this crisis... it's kind of tied to Lollo Logistics, isn't it?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: What are you talking about...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I mean, this could be our chance to redeem ourselves!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: If we can help them neutralize that Tacet Mark core, it could make up for our past mistakes and fulfill the promise we failed to keep!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: What are you rambling about? No way.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Come on, let me take care of this!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I swear, if anything had happened to you two, I'd never forgive myself.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Stop. Lollo Logistics can't get involved anymore. We need to stick to our business principles.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Even if I agreed, headquarters would never approve. It's not profitable and it risks our employees' safety.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: If we can't stop the spread of the toxic pollen, no place will be safe. Lollo Logistics won't be able to deliver goods to those who need them!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Isn't this a huge threat to our brand?!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Ugh... I said no, and I meant it!
What if I can make this profitable for you?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Huh? What did you say?
I plan to defeat the Inferno Rider and claim the bounty.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Listen, I've heard about {PlayerName}. If they're involved, then we definitely have a shot at defeating the Inferno Rider!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: That's a hundred thousand Credits! How many orders do I need to deliver to make that much money...
Mimika, are you okay?
But I can't do it alone.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: If even someone as strong as {PlayerName} can't handle it... Mimika, you should probably give up.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: How could this be...
I want to use the bounty to hire Lollo Logistics.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Wh-what?!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Wait a minute, now it's not just 'not profitable'! Even the headquarters can't say no to this!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: A hundred thousand Credits... That's a pretty substantial order.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: That's it! We have to take this order now!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Hmm...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Alright! We at Lollo Logistics will take the order. We'll do everything we can to support you!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Oh, you're awake!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Terrific!
There's still one crucial problem to solve...

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: You've brought some fantastic news. Didn't expect Lollo Logistics to get involved.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: With their transportation, our researchers should be able to navigate through the Incinero Petals with ease. This is a huge help.
But it's not enough to defeat the Inferno Rider.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: But if even a Resonator like you, {PlayerName}, can't beat it...
That barrier is impenetrable.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: You raise a good point. We still don’t have a way to break that shield.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: If we can't take the Inferno Rider out, we won't stand a chance closing in on the Tacet Mark core.
[A notification rings on Woodrow's touchpad]

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Oh, sob sob... I-I'm sorry, I really am...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Woodrow, I have the results for the issue you asked me to look into.
...Mortefi?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Ah, Mortefi. You finally deign to respond to my calls, eh?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Sorry for the delay. Even for someone like me, digging up old records takes time. Your request is from years ago, after all.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Here's the short version: we still have some spare parts from the Explosive Spears used in the last battle, stored in the Port City of Guixu. They should work if we assemble them.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: With such a weapon, you should be able to breach the Inferno Rider's shield and deliver a powerful blow to the Tacet Mark core of the Incinero Petals.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: I'm curious—how do you know so much about what happened back then, being so young?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: I just came across some records while researching Tacetite weapons. The spears were developed in collaboration between Huaxu Academy and the <ano=CSC>Court of Savantae</ano> back then.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: They were obsessed with making weapons with overwhelming firepower, completely disregarding practicality and safety. Typical of those savants.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: The CSC were known for their wild ideas, but the "Orange Box" group was the most outrageous of all.
I'm fine. But where have you been, Mimika?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: According to the records, the spare spears were split into three parts and stored in three different research centers, for security reasons.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: After all these years, I'm unsure if they still work. But if you can find them, I can guide you on how to assemble and recalibrate them.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: We'll arrange for someone to clear a secure path. {PlayerName}, please help us retrieve the spare parts with the Lollo Logistics couriers.
Sure. I'll inform Lollo Logistics.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: By the way, Mimika, the courier, was looking for you. She's waiting at the Resonance Nexus.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Sob, I...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Let me explain. While she was tracking down the person who placed the order, the touchpad she grabbed got swept away by the Gravity Storm.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Ah, here you are, Rover! Actually, I wanted to make a sincere apology to you.
Could it be just your imagination?
Looks like someone really is trapped there.
No! Please believe me... I really heard it, even though it was faint.
Yes. Considering when the order was placed, she must have been stuck there for a long time.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Fortunately, my manager found me and rescued me just before I passed out from the toxins in the air...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I know I'm being naive, but there is someone out there in need of Lollo Logistics' service. Someone who believes that "We Promise, We Deliver"...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: And that's why I still want to fulfill this order!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: But my manager is right. I can't do it alone... So I'm asking for your help. Please, will you come with me to the coordinates and help search again?
Alright, but promise me that if we can't find her, we'll turn back right away.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Thank you! I understand. You can find the coordinates on your Terminal now!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: My willful actions almost got you killed. I'm very sorry for that. Please accept my apology!
You don't have to blame yourself.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: It's just... I still need your help on another matter. I think you're the only one who will believe me...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Like my manager said, no one would place a delivery order in the Sea of Flames... Honestly, I started regretting it the moment I went in.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I began to doubt myself, thinking, “Maybe it's just a misplaced order. Maybe nobody actually needs me.”

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I hesitated, and my touchpad got blown away by the Gravity Storm.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Well, I even felt a bit relieved... I thought, "Great, I won't have to risk my life searching for a customer in the Sea of Flames anymore."

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: But then I heard someone calling for help. A girl's voice... It must've been her who placed the order!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Look! Someone is there!

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: I don't know. I woke up here, surrounded by toxic pollen with no way out. I was starving and parched, barely hanging on.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: The Gravity Storm was messing with my signal... I tried calling everyone in my contacts, but only Lollo Logistics' number went through.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Hehe, of course it did! We've invested in strengthening our signal so that anyone can place orders with us anytime, anywhere.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: I was worried about losing the signal, so I used your automatic ordering service to send out the request. I didn't expect you to actually deliver it here.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Absolutely! At Lollo Logistics, we always deliver on our promises, no matter what!
So, shall we escort you out of here?

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: No need to trouble yourselves. I can move around now. Thanks so much... I'll never forget your help.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Wait, remember to spread the word about Lollo Logistics! We have discounts for new customers, you know!
Haha, I will. Goodbye for now!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Great, the order is finally done. It feels good to wrap this job up.
Hey, are you all right?
You honored your slogan. You delivered on your promise.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: To be honest, I once thought it was no more than a publicity slogan, too. No one would really take each and every order so seriously, right?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: But I changed my mind when I received a package delivered by Lollo Logistics. It was something my late father left.
Your father?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Yes. He was a Midnight Ranger. I was told at a young age that he passed away at his post, and that his body was not even found.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: The delivery guy said my father was injured in a battle against the TD Outbreaks. He was trying to protect his friends when he fell into a valley.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: A Lollo Logistics employee found him, but they could not save him.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: They told me that until his dying breath, he didn't stop thinking about me, saying that his daughter was about to turn ten, and he... he couldn't even see her one last time.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: He hoped that Lollo Logistics would deliver the doll he carried with him as a birthday present to his daughter.
So that was the package you received?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Cough... water, water... Please...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Yes, but it was far more complicated. Father passed before he could say the address and identity, and no identifications could be found with him by then.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: However, couriers from Lollo Logistics didn't give up. They kept asking and investigating while they delivered other goods.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Finally, after all those difficulties, they found the girl. That girl was me.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: But by the time I received this present, I was already over the age of playing dolls. It was my 18th birthday.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Lollo Logistics inspired me. I wanted to join and stick to the motto: We Promise, We Deliver!
You will.
This order is the proof.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Hehe, thank you.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: One order done. Next up, we have a bigger order to deliver!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: My colleagues and I will go with you to the research centers Mr. Mortefi mentioned. We'll try to find those spear parts and bring them back.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Aah, right here. Drink, please.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I got the coordinates from him. Let's move.
(Fast Travel to the location)
(Travel to the location yourself)

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I... I thought it was the end.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Did you place an order with Lollo Logistics?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Yes, I did. I'm Yuni. I didn't expect Lollo Logistics to really make it here. Thank you so much.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: You're welcome. Maybe I should apologize... for not delivering your order on time.
Why are you here?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: Hey, who are these people? How did they break in?
Mimika tells Yuni why you need the spear parts.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: ...Are you sure? Just a short exposure to that place left me paralyzed, unable to move a finger. And there's a powerful TD in the center?

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: I can't believe you're planning to take on such a monster. Impressive.
This is why we need the Explosive Spears.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: We do want to give you the parts for that spear, but the warehouse is locked, and we can't open it ourselves.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: We know the lock is linked to a mechanism, and you have to complete a... um... small test to unlock it.
What test?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: It's pretty simple. Just use the shooting machine over there to hit all the <color=Highlight>yellow targets</color> that appear. That's all.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: The rules are straightforward, but actually passing the test requires some precision... We've tried countless times and failed. Maybe you can give it a shot?
Okay, I'll try.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: I knew it. They're those damn newcomers! Get rid of them!
Didn't know the Exiles have taken over this place.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Wait, we are...

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: Stop, please! They saved my life!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Yuni? This is where you've been staying, huh...

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: Yuni, you said someone saved you from the Sea of Flames. Are these the people you were talking about?

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: Yes. Now put away your weapons. Nobody attacks them!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Right, we won't fight you today. We are on an important mission.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: D-did you drive all those people away?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: ...So says the manual we found in this research center.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Why don't we simply turn the flamethrower on?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Unfortunately, the <color=Highlight>pipeline</color> connecting the fuel cans and the flamethrower has been deliberately disassembled. We need a way to fix them.
I'll give it a try.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Yes. They've been dealt with. You're safe now.
I'll open the gate now!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Phew... Finally, we are safe. Thank you so much! We thought we were doomed...

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Oh, Yuni told me why you're here. There's a little problem though...
Another Court of Savantae puzzle to solve?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Yes. There's the fuel can—the tall thing over there.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: The fuel will be pumped here for the <color=Highlight>flamethrower</color>. It will spray an upright blaze when ignited.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: To start the fire thrower and open the warehouse gate, we must connect three fuel cans. This will provide enough fuel for a strong blaze that will activate the sensing device on the gate.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Look, the pollen <color=Highlight>filter</color> should be right here.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo
anh_en: You wanna take the <color=Highlight>filter</color>? You're not leaving here in one piece.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Hello! We're back with the <color=Highlight>filter</color>!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: I guess... You'll have to go get those barrels yourselves.
Do you have the coordinates?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: Yeah, I'll share them with you.
Almost thought we wouldn't make it... I'll get the <color=Highlight>filter</color> installed right away!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: I can't thank you enough... We would have all died without you.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: I know why you're here. Yuni told me all about it, but the spear parts are...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I can guess it. We'll need to solve another puzzle made by those weird geniuses.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: Um, actually... When those thugs attacked us, they messed around with the device in the lab, and some... accidents happened at the warehouse, where the spear parts are kept...
Accidents?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: Yes, all the Spear <color=Highlight>barrels</color> were launched into the Sea of Flames, with some landing quite deep inside.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: Sigh... I feel ashamed to admit this, but we can't get them out from there...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (What a weird wanted poster... I wonder why.)

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: A powerful one like yourself must have imagined this...

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: ...A one-on-one showdown with a wanted criminal on a deserted land of death. Then you claim the bounty and leave as people cheer for you. That is the romance of the wild west!
What? West...?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: [A notification rings on Woodrow's touchpad]

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Sorry, I've got a message...

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Yes, it’s me... All right, I see.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Sorry, got some emergencies back in my lab... If you're interested in this poster, find me at Donglu Research Station in Port City of Guixu.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: All right. {Male=Young man!;Female=Young lady!} Till we meet next time!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (He was unexpectedly friendly... Not what I'd expect from a professor.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You suddenly receive a strange piece of mail.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Hm? Aren’t you that Rover? Are you interested in this poster?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (A mail from... Lollo Logistics?)
No. I was just taking a look.
Yes. It's rare to see something like this.
Stop pretending. I can sense that you’re interested.
A showdown with a wanted criminal always attracts real experts. I knew it! This is the most effective recruitment trick.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Oh, I almost forgot. I am the head of the Center for Wutherological Climate Studies, Huaxu Academy. You can call me Professor Woodrow.
Did you post it here, Professor?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Yes. Doesn't it get your adrenaline rushing to see an old poster like this, made with real ink and paper like in the old days? Hahahaha!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Mimika! Are you all right?
That’s the spirit! I've set up some Spear generators near the Sea of Flames. Follow me.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: We're fine, but why are you here?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: We were trying to take all the parts out of the Port City of Guixu and find somewhere safe to do the assembly...

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: ...But we were running out of time, so we’re reduced to assembling on site right now. Besides, without the help of dedicated equipment, we couldn’t guarantee the reliability of the Spears. Haha.
Will this work...?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Honestly, I'm not sure. The assembly worked, but it's a replica of an old CSC design with outdated information.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: I can't guarantee there won't be any issues. It's probably a good idea to test the Spears before counting on them for your main objective.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Good thing is we happen to have installed Sound Emulators here. We can use them to attract the TDs from the Sea of Flames.
Let's test the Spears on those TDs.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nam
anh_en: Hey! Fork over your cash and food or die!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nam
anh_en: Despicable? Hahaha, we'll show you real despicable. You've got a Resonator on your side I see, but {Male=he;Female=she} won't stand a chance against us all!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nữ
anh_en: Wait, they came from that research center. We can't let them leave alive.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nam
anh_en: Is that it? Wasn't gonna let them live anyway, ha.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: These are the Exile thugs Yunni talked about, {Male=sir;Female=miss}.
I can tell. They don't look very friendly.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nam
anh_en: So you know that bitch. A dye-in-the-wood idiot.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nữ
anh_en: I only sadfished a little bit, then she fell for it and followed me to the Sea of Flames.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Bạo Nữ
anh_en: The plan was to knock her out, then throw her into the Sea of Flames to lure her cohorts out of the darned research center for a perfect wipe out. Didn't see you saving her, though.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Ugh, how despicable...
That's some spectacular explosions. Don't you think, Mortefi?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Of course not. We are left with no other choice... Right? Please, let me try to do this!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Umm...
We should try it, now that there's no other ways.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: If that's our customer's wish, Mimika, you should try it.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Okay, thank you everyone!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: So, what's your plan?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: We don't have time for briefings. Ready yourselves first.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Yes. I shall need some time with my co-workers to get ready, and I might need the help of Mr. Mortefi and Mr. Woodrow.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Then we'll meet at the overhead bridge in the central Sea of Flames. Then we'll talk about the plan.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: {PlayerName}, please get to the destination. Lollo Logistics and we will handle the preparations.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: The power isn't an issue. It should be more than enough to break through the Inferno Rider's shield, which is made from condensed Incinero Petal pollen.
(Fast Travel to the location)
(Travel to the location yourself)

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Assuming it functions properly and has not been physically damaged, that is...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: In the past, we failed because Lollo Logistics didn't properly protect the Explosive Spears during transport.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Tang Manliu...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The Spears are too big to deliver safely past the TDs to the heart of Sea of Flames. This delivery might end up like last time.
Do we not have other ways?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Actually, I got one!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: What? Another pie-in-the-sky solution?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Mimika, as you requested, I ordered a fully equipped team to get ready at our branch.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I-I didn't expect that!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: If we can catapult the Spears at the maximum power, and correct their trajectory while they fly over the Sea of Flames, they should land right at their destination.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Won't this trigger immediate explosions upon landing?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Rest assured. Mr. Mortefi said an initiation is needed for them to explode.
To ensure everything goes smoothly, Mr. Mortefi has calculated the trajectory, and Mr. Woodrow has confirmed that the path won't be affected by the Gravity Storm.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Hey, Mimika. The catapult is all set.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: All right. The rest is yours, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. This time, we will put an end to it all!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: That spot is like the epicenter of the Gravity Storm. If we just launch the spears right through it... They would likely get thrown off course by the storm.
So the Tacet Mark is in the gravity storm's center?
Hey, Rover, you see that big building? The Tacet Mark core of all these Incinero Petals is right there…

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Thank you!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I think the only option is to escape from the Gravity Storm and give it a try up close.
Hey Rover, remember when you met the Inferno Rider and it whispered “Rush… Till the end...”?
Maybe inside that TD, the wishes of the fallen Midnight Rangers still linger.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Rover, if you can outrun that TD, those fallen solders may help you… Help you reach the end, the finish line…
I understand.
Hey, Mimika. The catapult is all set.
All right. The rest is yours, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. This time, we will put an end to it all!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Though I still don't understand why you had all the Explosive Spears moved to the branch...
Shouldn't we move them to the heart of the Sea of Flames?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: What's on your mind exactly, Mimika? It should be time you tell us.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Right. I think it would be really tough to carry the heavy Spears through the Sea of Incinero Petals.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: That's when I came up with the alternative to ground transport: the air!
The air?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Back in the day, my manager Tang Manliu spent a fortune on a freight catapult for our branch. I figured, if we can catapult goods, why not the Spears too?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: We Promise, We Deliver! Your Explosive Spears have been delivered on time!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: {PlayerName}—!

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: The dangerous Gravity Storms that were gathering over the Tacet Mark core have vanished. We can confidently conclude that... Jinzhou is safe now.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: And it's all thanks to you!
This is a result of our coordinated efforts.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Then please come visit our branch when you're back in Jinzhou. We'll be waiting for you.
Mimika, are you alright?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: We're fine! I saw it! You just transformed into that Inferno Rider and flew all the way into the air, riding on that Gravity Storm!

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: A {Male=young man;Female=young lady} transforming into a flaming rider, rushing to the destination with unyielding conviction to charge at the Tacet Mark! Aah... What a beautiful story.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Derived from the fighting spirit of past warriors, the Inferno Rider, in its Echo form, delivered a powerful final blow to the Tacet Mark core of those Incinero Petals...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Perhaps it's just me, but... I think the fallen Midnight Rangers would be happy to see this.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Tang Manliu...
Is the danger of the Sea of Flames resolved?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Our observations show that the Tacet Mark core is nearly completely deactivated, so the toxin from the Incinero Petal pollen has almost disappeared.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Tang Manliu, {PlayerName} is here!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: You must be kidding, aren't you?
As I anticipated... I'm so, so sorry, {Male=sir;Female=miss}!
Don't be so shy. Feel free to praise me, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Anyway, I do need to thank you, Mimika.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: For real? What's with the sudden compliment? It feels so off to hear that from you.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Your insistence saved that customer in the Sea of Flames and ensured successful delivery of the Spears. Without you, our customer may have been consumed by TDs.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: You're right, Mimika. "We Promise, We Deliver"... This should never be a mere slogan. It should be the faith we stick to.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Hehe! I know right?!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: That being said, I must, however, ask you to reflect on your impulsiveness.
Well said.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I heard you, I heard you! No need to shout. My ears are ringing from the noise.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: O-Okay...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: That's the spirit. You will become an excellent courier one day.
I have faith in you, Mimika.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Thank you Tang Manliu, and thank you {PlayerName}! I will work hard!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Finally, on behalf of Lollo Logistics, allow me to express our sincerest gratitude to you, dear customer.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Without your help, this crisis would not have been resolved so well.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: We would probably have to doubt ourselves in regret and shame. It would be a disgrace to our slogan, "We Promise, We Deliver!"

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Therefore, we thank you... for letting us honor our promise and deliver this overdue order.
No need to thank me. It's a victory for all of us.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: You are being modest.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Please excuse us, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Mimika can be really loud. She probably caused you some trouble back in Port City of Guixu, didn't she?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The one-hundred-thousand-credit order you placed with us is hereby finished, but since it's your first order, a discount must apply.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The discounted amount will be returned to you as a token of our appreciation, mine especially. Please accept it.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Thank you for using our service. "We Promise, We Deliver!"

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: We look forward to seeing you again. Goodbye.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I didn't. Please, {PlayerName}, say something!
Mimika was a great help.
Mimika was a trouble maker.
I can't come up with a rating for her yet...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Thank you. It was my pleasure!
You hear that? I'm quite capable!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: Did you really just pass the test so easily? I'm speechless.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: We don't need them anyway!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: Yeah! Kick that TD's ass for us!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Lollo Logistics will take care of the transportation of the spear tips. Let's move on to the next research center.
Yes. The faster, the better.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: All the research centers here are ours. Say my name, and they'll comply.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: Watch out for those newcomers, though. They've been eyeing our territories.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: You might be seen as one of us and get attacked if you leave here.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Are they Exiles too?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: Yeah, these punks tried to take our spot and ambush us. They do raids, robberies, and all kinds of crap. No respect for anyone but themselves.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: Take care, will ya?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Oh... The "bullets" you shoot look like the tips of those Explosive Spears, don't they?
Thanks. Let's go, Mimika.
They do look alike.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Let's go ask Mr. Mortefi about this.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: These are indeed the tips of Explosive Spears...

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: And this test... Maybe it’s just another passion project from the Savants?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Though they are undeniably geniuses, they just have a thing for beating around the bush.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Hah... I really can't bring myself to understand the geniuses...

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: Then you can have these spear tips, as we agreed.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: You defeated all of them! My goodness, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Let's get inside before reinforcements show up.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: It, it is solved? So it didn't bother you much, did it?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Could you please help us retrieve the stolen filter?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: They may want to take the <color=Highlight>filter</color> back to their lair.
That's right.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Yes, we think so too. I'll send you the coordinates of their lair, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: I'm counting on you!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: Oh, by the way, one of my people wanted to ask you for a favor. If you could lend us a hand... We would really appreciate it.
I'll go check it out when I have the time.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Then the breech parts are Lollo Logistics' to deliver. We will make sure they safely arrives on time.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Now we just need one more barrel part, and we'll have all three components for the Explosive Spear.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: One moment, please... I just received an emergency contact from my friend...
What happened?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: The newcomers just ambushed our base in the Third Research Center and took the <color=Highlight>pollen filter</color>...

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: The concentration of toxic pollen is higher over there. Without the <color=Highlight>filter</color>, our people will be in grave danger.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Yes, that's it. We should return the <color=Highlight>filter</color> to the Third Research Center as soon as possible.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: {PlayerName}, we’re here!

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Just find the specs and send them over. Then we can search the warehouse for similar barrels to use as substitutes.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: What do you mean by "physically impacting them"?
I guess we just attack them with weapons?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: You're right, {PlayerName}. If they were standard <color=Highlight>barrels</color>, they wouldn't break so easily.

And those <color=Highlight>defective barrels</color>, once destroyed, contain a substance that can help neutralize the toxicity of Incinero Petals. This should allow you to stay in the Sea of Flames a bit longer.
Wow... They're scattered everywhere. I can even see some far away.
If we have to go deep into the Sea of Flames to retrieve them, we'll be exposed to toxins for a long time. Even someone as strong as you could be affected.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Wait a moment. Something seems wrong with these <color=Highlight>barrels</color>.
What's the problem?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: I checked the records again, and it turns out a lot of these spare barrels are defective. They were actually meant to be destroyed.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: If you were to make an Explosive Spear with defective parts, it could trigger an immediate explosion.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: An immediate explosion?! W-wouldn't want that...

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: That’s why you should test the durability of those barrels on the spot by by physically impacting them. You'll need at least three functional <color=Highlight>barrels</color>.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Are you all right, {PlayerName}? You stayed in the Sea of Flames for so long.
I’m okay. Where are the barrels?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: They're fine. The <color=Highlight>barrels</color> that passed the test have already been shipped to the assembly site by Lollo Logistics.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: We don't have much time left. Professor Woodrow is here too. Let's go meet up with them!

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: Hello! Here you are.
What should I do?

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: My Phonotesters will continuously attract those TDs.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: And these generators will generate new <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color> non-stop. Just throw them at those TDs with the Levitator on your Terminal.
That sounds rather crude.

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: You're right, but we don't have time to build a launcher... Or perhaps we can say, YOU are the launcher. Does it sound cooler now? Hahaha...

speaker: Speaker_927_Title
anh_en: A swarm of Tacet Discords is coming! Show them the power of the <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color> and give us a spectacular show,  {Male=young man!;Female=young lady!}

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Hmm... The box with the <color=Highlight>filter</color> is locked, but the key should be nearby. Let's search around.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: The thorns didn’t last long on fire, did they? Was kind of relaxing to watch them burn...

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: The items are yours now. Don’t forget to take them. And thank you very much!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: Bad luck. Just a few days left unattended, and the thorns just grew again and entangled themselves with the chest.
You can't open the it?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: Yes. Though the items within it are not so important, we do want to keep using this chest.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: But I don’t think I can cut open the thorns with this blade. What should I do...
We can burn them down.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: Oh, you just reminded me. There’s a <color=Highlight>flamethrower</color> not far from here, but I just don’t know how to activate it.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: Well, if you can get this done for me, you can take the items inside as a thank you from me.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Remember, you need to attack the <color=Highlight>barrels</color> until the Durability Bar above them is fully charged. That's how you’ll know if they're good enough.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Hm, this one looks good. You just found our first standard <color=Highlight>barrel</color>. Two more to go!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I don’t remember placing an order with Lollo Logistics. Did they get the wrong person?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Maybe I should go to their headquarters and clarify this.)

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: This one’s good, too. Now we just need another one.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Okay. We have everything we need now. Time to leave.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Hello, are you that Rover? Pleasure to meet you.
And you are...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Oh I almost forgot. I'm a researcher from Huaxu Academy.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Mr. Mortefi instructed to me to stay here and test the power of those <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color>. I’m just getting ready to do the previous test another time.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: By the way, do you want to join me, Rover? You’re a pro now, aren’t you?

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Tell me if you’d like to challenge it again. The goal is to protect the three Sound Emulators against Tacet Discords.
Let me give it a try.
Maybe not now.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Yes, yes. Let me calculate the explosion range now... Oh, don’t mind me. Carry on.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Hm, perfect. The data should suffice now.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Sigh, it was close... Never mind. We still have a lot of <color=Highlight>Explosive Spears</color> left.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên Trường Thương Bộc Liệt
anh_en: Tell me if you’d like to challenge it again. The goal is to protect the three Sound Emulators against Tacet Discords.
Let me give it a try.
Maybe not now.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Customer! Just a moment. The catapult will lock on the target in just a moment.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: Gotta clean up the rubble...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (As expected, the fire isn’t strong enough with only one fuel can...)

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hoảng Sợ
anh_en: B-be careful. It’s very dangerous in the Sea of Flames.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No! I. Won’t. Wear. It!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Spare yourself, will you! Our customers are watching.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: Turns out I got saved by you guys again... I'm so careless.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Nóng Nảy
anh_en: Hahaha. Yuni can be like that sometimes.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: Yeah she is. Anyway, thank you so much, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Yuni
anh_en: Let's end the chit-chat here. {PlayerName}'s got an urgent job to do.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Suy Yếu
anh_en: Cough, cough... It's killing me to stay here. I'm getting outta here one day.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: The supply chest is being piled with rubble. Have to dig it out to get rid of the thorns down there.
Need help?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Lo Lắng
anh_en: Thank you, but we can deal with it.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Good. Target locked. Ready to fire. Counting down...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Three! Two! One!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Fire!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Like it or not, we've already declined their package. Let's just pretend this order never existed.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Think about it! Whoever made the order must be trapped there, starving and freezing. That's why they ordered those things!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Even if that's the case, and I'm not saying it is... We wouldn't make much, just barely enough to cover our costs.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Listen, if they really needed it, wouldn't they just place another order?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: What if they can't just place another order?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Enough! This is my call to make as manager. Leave it.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: This isn't a blame game. We tell our customers “We Promise, We Deliver.” Is that all just for show?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Why you...!
Excuse me, are you talking about this "order"?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Wait... This is the rejection email I sent out! How did it end up here...?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Mimika! You must have sent it to the wrong recipient when you grabbed my touchpad earlier!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: You didn't ask anyone before sending that rejection, did you?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: There we go, it must be fate! Let me deliver it, please!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Oh my... I can’t stand this...
So, was this a misunderstanding?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I'm really sorry we wasted your time because of our mistake...
Yes, this is a waste of my time.
Don't worry, it's not a big deal.
It's all right. I’m idle anyway.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Mimika! Come here and apologize to the customer.
S-sorry!!
Thank you so much for understanding. You are one of those rare, generous individuals.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Even if I had, do you seriously think we could've delivered it?
I-idle, is it? Hmm, what a luxury... Ahem! Hehe, that is a relief.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Anyway, it was entirely our fault that caused all this...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: We'll issue a formal apology later, but for now, please allow me to sort out this strange order.
Sea of Flames... is that a dangerous place?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Do you not know about Sea of Flames, {Male=sir;Female=miss}?
I've been there.
I know.
I don’t know.
Your knowledge is truly impressive! In that case, I needn't blabber on about how dangerous that place is.
Hm. The flower there is spectacular for sure, but it's lethal at the same time.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Of course! No order is too tough for us to handle! "We Promise, We Deliver!"

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: You really don't know? The Sea of Flames is a vast field of Incinero Petals whose pollen is extremely toxic.
Not to mention the horrible TDs! Few have made it out there alive, as far as I know.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Now you see how dangerous it is, Mimika?

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: And that's exactly why we're needed!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: That customer must know that only Lollo Logistics can deliver what he needs there.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Just let me go! Please?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I said no!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: But why?!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Just take no for an answer... Ugh, she's so stubborn. {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}, could you help me convince her?
Don't risk your life so lightly.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: So why did you even make the promise in the first place? Ugh...
I agree. Fulfill your promise!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: You heard it? Those are words of reason! Don't go there!
I will go! If I don't, we may as well tell all of our customers that our slogan is a lie.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: That's right! No matter what, we have to fulfill our orders! That's what we do at Lollo Logistics!
{Male=Sir;Female=Miss}! What are you...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Now, just let me take it from here!

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: I'll take full responsibility as the courier for this job! Is that fair enough?
Hey!!!
Mimika grabs the touchpad, puts on her delivery gear, and hurries away.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Damn it! What now... She must have left for the Sea of Flames!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: You're talking about the Sea of Flames in Guixu Port City. There's no way I'm letting any of our staff go to such a dangerous place!

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Why? Of all places, why there...
Of all places?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Sigh... We don't let our employees go near the Sea of Flames. That place is off-limits.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The incident dates back to when Lollo Logistics established our first Jinzhou branch.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: That place got overrun by Incinero Petals, spewing toxic pollen that drove everyone away.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: And to make things worse, the Center for Wutherological Climate Studies found those Gravity Storms raging in the area. Talk about adding insult to injury.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: If that pollen ever got swept up into the upper atmosphere by those storms, it would spell disaster for Jinzhou and the surrounding regions.
That sounds really dangerous...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Absolutely. At the time, the researchers figured out that the only way to stop the spread was to deactivate the Tacet Mark core of those flowers.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The Huaxu Academy created Explosive Spears to do the job, but the terrain was too dangerous for any regular vehicle to get through.

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: But, but...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Most of the Tacetite vehicles were tied up at the frontlines with the Midnight Rangers, fighting off the TD Outbreak, so we couldn't get the Spears to the center of the Sea of Flames.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: That left Lollo Logistics to step in with our spare Tacetite vehicles and deliver them. The plan was for the Midnight Rangers to use them to take out the Tacet Marks, risking their lives in the process.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Everyone knew how dangerous the job was, but we took it on anyway—after all, our motto is "We Promise, We Deliver."

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: But... we couldn't get there in time. Our couriers tried their best, but they couldn't deliver the Spears in time.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: In the end, only one Spear made it through, and even though we fell short, the Midnight Rangers thanked us for our help.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: They had most of their people escort our couriers to safety, while a few brave souls stayed behind to charge at the Tacet Mark, knowing it could cost them their lives.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: They passed the Spear along, one after another, trying to get it to the Tacet Mark. But the deadly pollen was too much. In the end, they all ended up Overclocking.
Then why is there still pollen there?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Sigh... The Spear got damaged during transport, so it didn't fully deactivate the Tacet Mark when it hit. The explosion never went off.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: But, at least the attack weakened the Tacet Mark enough to stop the spread of the Incinero Petals, and the pollen concentration dropped to a level that no longer threatens Jinzhou.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Besides, who would order anything to a place like that? It's obviously a prank. What was even in the package?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Even though no one blamed them, the survivors at Lollo Logistics were wracked with guilt, thinking their mistake cost those brave soldiers their lives.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: That mission left a permanent scar on our company. After that, we made it a rule that any major order had to be handled by Resonators with combat skills.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: We Promise, We Deliver... It's just easier said than done...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Now you see why that place is such a taboo for us. We don't want couriers like Mimika getting mixed up with the Sea of Flames.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: All right. That's enough blabbering from me. Let’s focus on finding Mimika...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Ah, that girl is as stubborn as a mule and never listens to anyone, but she's also known for being ridiculously fast. If I don't head out right now, I might not be able to catch up to her.
Maybe I can help.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: No, no, {Male=sir;Female=miss}! How could I bother you with this...
I am partially responsible for Mimika running off.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Eh... But...

speaker: Mimika
anh_en: Uh... it was some food, medicine, and warm clothes for one person...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: All right then. Thank you very much for your assistance.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Let's search for her on the outskirts of the Sea of Flames first. I've sent you the coordinates.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Would you go with me, {Male=sir;Female=miss}?
(Go with Tang Manliu)
(Go alone)

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Okay. Then I'll go first. I'll see you there.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Have you found Mimika?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: How did Mimika get there? It's so dangerous...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Her location isn't moving. Could it be that she's already... !
I will go inside the Sea of Flames to save her.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: But... the toxic pollen is too dangerous, even for a Resonator as strong as yourself. The stakes are too high.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: How much do you know about the pollen?
A thing or two.
Not much.
I don't really care.
You are very knowledgeable, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. I trust you would be able to stay away from the toxic pollen on most occasions.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The toxicity of Incinero Petal comes mainly from its pollen. When it is inhaled, it generates a strong physical pain that feels like blazing.
Not yet...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: The pollen doesn't diffuse very widely, though. It is often gathered on the ground surface.
Therefore, as long as you are careful enough not to tread on an Incinero Petal bush, the pollen's threat is significantly undermined.
Eh... I won't make further comments since you are so confident.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Right. Let's get on with it, then.
You should stay here.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Thank you, but please don't worry. When I was a courier, I was quite familiar with this place.
Someone needs to stay here as backup.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: You are right... and I would know if she came back here herself.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Then I'll wait here. I have sent Mimika's coordinates to you.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I hope she's fine...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I couldn't find her either. I've looked everywhere...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Maybe she's already deep inside the Sea of Flames. Ugh... I'll give her a piece of my mind when I find her.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Though Resonators like you can withstand the toxin of Incinero Petal pollen longer, extended exposure will still lead to grave results.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: What should we do now?Are there other ways to locate her?
Can we track the comm touchpad she's using?

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: Oh right! She took my touchpad! There's a tracker inside it.

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: But the coordinates... That's right at the Sea of Flames' center...

speaker: Đường Mãn Lưu
anh_en: I've synced Mimika's coordinates to your Terminal. Please find Mimika for me.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (This should be the touchpad Mimika took, but where is she?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (What happened?! My hair is standing on end... Enemy ahead!)

speaker: Tàn Tượng Bí Ẩn
anh_en: Charge... till the end...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (This barrier is preventing all my attacks!)

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Arrived at the target security node. No traces of TD found. Speculation: The node is yet to discover for TDs.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Now, we have to manually close up the energy circuit to power the security node.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Caleb, tell me what Woodveil Hall was built for.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: ...Sorry, I can't find the relevant data. Please consult a researcher with a higher access.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Searching for the researcher payroll... Sorry, no valid results found in the database.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Security node back online.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Well done, Rover.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Mutiple Tacet Discords detected... On your guard, Rover. They have spotted us.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: We must buy the time for the node to reboot, or we are doing this in vain.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Suggestion: Freeze time with the Chronopin to hinder the enemy and help our mission.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Self-test complete.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: We are ahead of schedule. Everything will be fixed soon if we keep the pace.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: You've come just at the right time, friend. I just got my hands on an antique.
Fit the two parts together.
As you fit the two parts together, the assembled antique lets out a "click," and projects a miniature image.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Oh? How fantastic. Looks like it's connected with you.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: The projection seems to be a map. It points to... the Tianqu Tree, and has a note beside it, "Woodveil Hall."
Tianqu Tree... That giant, dying wood?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Precisely. I've also heard about this while I was in Hongzhen a few days ago trying to buy some good stuff.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: In its prime, Tianqu Tree was luxuriant and worshipped as a protection of Hongzhen.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: But after what happened, it started to wither away. All of Hongzhen mourns its loss.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Maybe Tianqu Tree's fate is sealed... Anyway, this key is yours, my friend.
Mine?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: It seems tied to a legend about Mt. Firmament, but the records have been lost over the years.
Really? For free?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I am a merchant, that's for sure, but I think I told you this when we first met...

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: ...I'm not stingy when it comes to money. It's more about serendipity and belief.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: This key looked so ordinary in my hands, but now, its connection to you is clearly revealed.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: In that case, why should I lock it away in my cabinet and make everything it stands for remain a mystery?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I cannot betray my belief simply out of greed. So take it, friend.
Got it.
I will bring back the story behind it.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Ha. That sounds proper. Then I'll wait for your story.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Now if you're interested, why don't you take a look at it for me?
Is this... a creation of the Court of Savantae?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Ha, you've got a keen eye! This is indeed a CSC creation. A key specifically, I think. As for what door it opens and how it works, that's beyond my knowledge.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Rover, you are the one who have solved countless puzzles left by the CSC. I wonder how this strikes you.
It looks like two parts that can fit together.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: It does, and I've tried doing so, but it made no difference. Nothing special came out of it.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: You can still try that yourself, though. Things might turn out differently.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Interesting. Security node here is still running... Accessing log.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: TDs triggered the security node here. Prepare for combat, Rover.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Confirming node status...

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Backup energy ready. Available for activation.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Great. All nodes are back online.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Planning route... This way, Rover. A shortcut back to the Prototype Chronosorter.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Energy circuit closed. Ready for activation. Wait, Rover, watch out.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Abnormal frequencies detected... Anticipation: active defense device, Lumiscale Construct.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: It identifies us as intruders. It seems we need to neutralize it.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: ...Well done, Rover. Testing Prototype Chronosorter status...

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: My mission is complete. All systems are operational. You may now activate it, Rover.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: What a fantastic sight, Rover. I'm sure the frequency of this tree was... faint until just now.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: I thank you for restoring the Lab, despite the failure of their research. You have given me the chance to continue their work and finish what they started.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Whether it takes a century or even a millennium... I will continue this work. It is my mission, and it is Victor's wish.
Actually, their research was successful.
Their efforts didn't go fruitless.
You tell Caleb the event at Mt. Firmament, and make clear the role Chronosorters played.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: So you're saying, the Chronosorters did save Mt. Firmament. Is that true, Rover?
A tiny seed...
...Has grown into a majestic tree.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: So it all paid off... Please forgive me Rover, what I'm feeling right now is beyond the capacity of my emotional module.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Some of the researchers... grew doubtful of their work, thinking it was mission impossible.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Analyzing... It appears the Prototype Chronosorter has positively impacted the local ecology, besides rewinding the time for the equipment in Woodveil Hall.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: While those who stayed left this world with regret and unfulfilled wishes.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Now it becomes all clear... Their work wasn't in vain. They would feel relieved too, if they were to learn this.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Thank you Rover, for telling me all this.
You mission is complete, Caleb.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Maybe... With the supreme authority in hand, you are now in the place to determine my tasks going forward.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Suggestion: You may instruct me to continue the research here. Many mysteries around Mt. Firmament remain unsolved. I'm confident we'll uncover the truth one day.
Go on then, if that is your wish.
You may have your well-deserved rest.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Order received... Thank you.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: I'd like to observe this tree for a bit longer, Rover. My work began the day it was just a seed.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: It wasn't designed for this. It seems more like an accident, caused by unknown factors.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: And now... it has become the shelter of the whole Lab. How time flies...

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: It didn't resurrect the dead or grant immortality to the living, but it did reverse what should be a natural cycle of life.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: It's a pity my creators aren't here to witness this.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Yes, Rover. My memory data has been corrupted over a long course of time. I've even lost their names.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: But since you restored Woodveil Hall, the data has... somehow come back to me.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: I thank you on behalf of the Research Director Prof. Bram S., Junior Researcher Victor Christopher, and the other thirty-three faculty members.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: How was your adventure, friend? I presume you have learned the secret of the key.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: This isn't the weirdest story I've ever heard, friend, but it is... intriguing.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Don't overthink. Tragedy or comedy, it's always part of destiny.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Keep this key, friend, as a reminder.
Thank you.

anh_en: A Prototype Chronosorter is deployed at the heart of the lab. Once activated, it will restore the entire facility.

speaker: NPC #700059

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: As you can see, it is bonded to the energy core of Woodveil Hall.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: The tree roots surrounding the energy core belong to the massive tree above Woodveil Hall. Some of the energy emitted from the core nourishes the tree.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: However, the damage caused by the TDs to the energy core has led to excessive energy leakage, which is killing the organism... If this continues, the tree is estimated to perish in 10 days.

speaker: NPC #700059
anh_en: Running system test... Bad news, Rover. The Chronosorter is locked due to potential security risks within the facility.

speaker: NPC #700059

speaker: NPC #850307

speaker: NPC #850308

speaker: NPC #850307
anh_en: Now's not the time to gawk! RUN FOR IT!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (If this keeps up, they'll be torn apart by the Kerasaurs!)

speaker: NPC #850308

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Putting the pieces together, I suspected that water might be key to awakening them, so I thought maybe we should wait for the riverbed to flood again.

speaker: NPC #850307
anh_en: So that's why you stopped us from smashing the statues... It all adds up now.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Anyway, I'm glad you're both safe. If there's nothing else, I'll be on my way. I've still got lots of places to check to fulfill my promise to Grandpa!

speaker: NPC #850307

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: It's alright. I'm glad no one was hurt.

Glad I acted in time.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Well... I came to that conclusion by analyzing the surroundings.

speaker: NPC #850308
anh_en: Yeah, we can't thank you enough.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Statues sitting on a dried-up riverbed were odd from the very start. If someone didn't place them there on purpose, then their presence there was likely related to the absence of water.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: I studied the nearby rock walls and found signs of erosion. Clear proof there was once water here.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Hmm? Do you need something else?

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: I don't know why they did that, but it's obvious that it was intentional.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: I'm going to search the area. Hopefully I can find some clues tied to the truth of the story.
What's the promise you made to your grandpa?

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Before Grandpa passed, he asked me to hunt the Kerasaurs and pay respects at the graves of the heroes who died here.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: He told me that twelve heroes once stood fearlessly against the Kerasaurs to protect him and some others... they gave their lives right here on this very ground.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Everyone they protected swore that they and their descendants would continue to fight the Kerasaurs when they returned and defend Septimont from their threat.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: That's all Grandpa told me, but... I've always felt something about the story didn't add up…
You think he hid something from you?

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Well... Not him, but all those children who were protected.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: I asked everyone who came here what their elders passed down. In all the stories, there's one single clue missing—the hero's identity.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Hmm? Do you need something else?

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: ...So the twelve heroes who saved Grandpa were actually prisoners of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: No wonder they deliberately erased their identities, leaving behind only a promise and a story.
What are you going to do?
Will you tell the truth to others?

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: Hmm... Yes. I think they deserve to know.

speaker: NPC #850309
anh_en: No matter what others think, anyone who stands up in a time of crisis is a hero.

speaker: NPC #850309
