speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: I can't. Mother told me I can't take things from strangers.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: Ahh, yes. Your mother is absolutely correct about that.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: How about this, I'm sure you know about the performance at the theater tonight, yes?

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: Hey, mister! Did you want to buy this record too?

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: Yeah! Mother is a fan. It's what we're visiting here for!

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: Perfect. Then I'll leave my signature on this record. After the performance, bring it with you and come to the backstage with your mother.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: Think of it as a special gift for a fan. What is your name, young girl?

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: Oh, really? Thank you, mister! My name is Siran!

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: Okay, Siran. Here you go.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: Ah, would you look at the time. I still haven't found a gift for my assistant yet.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: I look forward to seeing you tonight, little pianist.
Illusions. Here?
Rainwater leaking in. That explains the illusions in the store.
The mirage... disappeared.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: *chuckle* It's fine. Go ahead, you can have it.

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: Tee-hee. Thank you, mister.

speaker: Joshua
anh_en: Classical music. Quite the taste you have there, young girl.

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: This one? Hehe, it is kind of hard for me...

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: Mother told me, i-it's best for me to build my musical senses with the harder ones from the start!

speaker: Cô Bé
anh_en: My fingers hurt from all the practise, but I'll keep working hard!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This Hoartoise is getting mobbed by other Tacet Discords... Looks like it really needs help.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Seems like it wants to take me somewhere. I should follow it and see what's going on there.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Why is it fighting with the Tacet Discords again...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Is there another fight? Seriously?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: So you're leading me to help your friend? Didn't expect camaraderie among Hoartoises.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A miraculous music instrument? Chelonian Dance Troupe? What's this all about...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Hoartoises are heading back to the place we came. Is that "instrument" mentioned in the letter there?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The miraculous instrument is inside of this?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Hoartoises really are dancing... Incredible.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: They are jiggling more happily now...

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Got a notification saying someone just activated the tactical trial... Phew, turns out it was you {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Many gave up after a few rounds, complaining it was impossible to complete...

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Given the situation, could you please complete the rest of these challenges for me?
No problem.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Excellent. I've sent you the coordinates for the other challenges.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: I'm looking forward to witnessing your combat skills.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: I can't believe you took down those digital Tacet Discords so fast. Truly incredible speed.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Your combat records have met the special objectives. This will be a great help to my research. Please, take these as a token of my gratitude.
Sorry, but who are you again?
Combat challenge?

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Ah, my apologies. I got carried away. I’m Yhoran from the Black Shores' emergency response team.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: I'm researching combat strategies against Tacet Discords. The challenge you completed just now is part of my research.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: As you can see, I've set specific challenge goals with corresponding rewards for completion.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: But it's probably too difficult... I've only gathered a few valid records so far.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Good to see you again, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Yes, it's focused on optimizing our teams' combat training.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: By analyzing your records, we can better understand the Tacet Discords' combat patterns, body structure, and preferred techniques.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: With this data, we can design specialized training to improve efficiency and reduce casualties.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: I used to ignore my mentor's advice about the importance of combat efficiency and strategy... You can't really understand it until you've been through it yourself.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Now that I'm in a position to mentor others, I'm finding it challenging to teach newcomers.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: I'll be sure to study your combat records throughout.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Thank you so much for your help!

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Congratulations on completing all the combat challenges with perfection! Those legends about you certainly do you justice—you're an incredible combat master.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: So, how would you rate the difficulty of these challenges?
Piece of cake!
A bit tricky.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Aha, just as I expected.

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Such modesty...

speaker: NPC #750010
anh_en: Anyway, thank you so much. Without your records, it would be a real headache to proceed with the follow-up study.
Follow-up study?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It just appeared behind you out of nowhere... I know it doesn't hurt anyone, but still...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Like the phantom I was following. It immediately stopped moving after realizing I was behind it.
Sounds like it was waiting for you...
Strange. I wonder what kind of message it's carrying?
Quick! Use your decoder!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Indeed. Essentially, the information entities serve as a medium for carrying information, and they are not living beings. But perhaps their impulse to convey information can be considered a kind of instinct.
They yearn to be understood, like how we yearn to understand them.
Now that it has come to us, naturally, it's time to bring out... my frequency transcription program!
Ha, beat you there! I have already initiated the frequency transcription program.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Jiuyue points his Terminal towards the "phantom", committing full concentration as he reads out the results.)

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Death... I, cannot return... Resurrect... Not...
I thought you already saw it once.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Forget me... F-farewell?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: L-leave... No, wait. There's still more... And it's gone.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Death. I. Cannot return. Resurrect. Not. Forget me. Farewell... The words are making more sense this time. But it's still pretty hard to understand.
It's a different set of phrases.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Could it be that different "phantoms" carry different messages? No, that'll introduce too much noise and bring down the effectiveness of communication...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It would make more sense if one message was broken up into separate parts, and delivered piece-by-piece.
Some parts go here, some parts go there?
Like different segments of a poem.
Very much so. Yes.
Ahh a rather fitting and... sentimental analogy.
Looks exactly like how they described at the supply station.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It is possible that the phantoms each carry different bits of the full message. We need to collect all of them to truly decipher it.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: As for why and how the message is broken down: It could be purely random, or it could be constrained by the different sizes and energy capacities of the "phantoms".

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: After all, the information can get lost as they run out of energy. Like our two encounters with the "phantoms", we can only extract so much information from a single one.
Once their energy is exhausted, they disappear.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Precisely. But did you notice that this phantom we encountered inside the fog seems to be able to transmit more information?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It may be just a coincidence, but I presume the less distance it travels, the less energy it consumes.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Plus, so far they've only appeared within proximity of the fog, suggesting that... the fog may be their origin?
We should give it a further look once the fog's cleared.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Yes. As Hui mentioned before, Ecoacoustics and Ecology are two deeply connected disciplines of study. Through unraveling hidden secrets in the fog, we may gain a comprehensive understanding of these "phantoms."

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Let's press on. It's almost time for our meeting.
My heart missed a beat for a moment there...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Owing to your assistance, perhaps, we were barely stalled or disrupted and made much more progress in decoding on this trip.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Having a partner that you can get along with really makes for an untroubled investigation.
Well, last time I was the one chasing after it, not it jump scaring me!
Huh? So you've heard about it from the station. Seems like the number of eyewitnesses are beginning to grow.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Fear not. I-if anything does happen, I'll make sure to protect you!
Besides... it only scared us because we weren't expecting it. Now, it's just hovering over there like... a harmless puppet?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: But it appeared right by our side out of all the places it could be... It's almost as if it were actively seeking any person passing by.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: We're here. This is the place we've agreed to meet.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: But... Isn't Qisheng a retired army doctor from the Midnight Rangers? This guy looks too young. Who is he?

speaker: Chàng Trai Trẻ
anh_en: You must be the researcher from the Academy?

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: For the sake of ease, I encourage you not to wander too far during this time. You may walk around the settlement if you'd like.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: This is the closest human settlement to the fog and to where the two avian TDs had nested years ago, which formed the unique landscape you see.
Thank you. It's nothing my father can't handle on his own. The problem is he needs to get more medicine ASAP to handle the sudden influx of patients.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Also... not only did we break our arrangement, it simply wouldn't be fair to just ask for your help.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: It'll be another hour at most before my father is done. I'll let you know as soon as he gives me the word.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Do feel free to walk around the settlement if you're feeling bored.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: This is the closest human settlement to the fog and to where the two avian TDs had nested years ago, which formed the unique landscape you see.
Avian TDs... You mean the Mourning Aix?

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Yes, the Mourning Aix... Its cries are filled with mourn and shrill, randomly attacking any human that passes by. Like any other anomaly, it has caused us a great deal of trouble.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: But years ago, it didn't behave like this at all. When I was five or six years old, I first saw it with my father.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Yes. I am Jiuyue of the Huaxu Academy, and this is {PlayerName}. We're here to seek information regarding the derelict Court of Savantae facility recently discovered.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: It soared in the skies with another avian TD, singing to one another. Even as we stood close by, those TDs didn't pay us much attention, as if they only saw each other.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Later I heard that the other TD had died, leaving the Mourning Aix behind. Since then, it has changed, and this whole place has changed with it.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Must be in a lot of pain to be left alone.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: And with so much pain, I presume it had to unleash it somehow...
It's getting sad all of a sudden...
Sounds like you know a lot of the Mourning Aix.
Just as the name would suggest.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Oh, do I...? Well, of course! I'm a dedicated researcher in solving Mire's anomalies, of course!
Having this basic level of understanding of the issue is a basic requirement.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: It sounds like you're quite interested in the creature. If you want to know more, you can ask the elders in the settlement.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Yet... If my memory serves me correctly, it was Qisheng who had made the discovery. And you are...?
For me, memories about the avian TD have become vague and hard to recall.

speaker: Chàng Trai Trẻ
anh_en: Hello. You can call me Qijie. Qisheng is my father. He was on his way to meet you but ran into a few wounded residents.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Being a former army doctor, he wanted to take care of the injured before coming to see you.
So, are we supposed to...
Anything we can help you with?

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: You'll have to wait around for a while. My father was the one who stumbled upon the building in a detour while he was out scavenging. You'll have to ask himself for the details.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: It'll be another hour at most before he's back. I'll let you know as soon as he gives me the word.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Every single day, it's been fog and nothing but fog... When is it ever going to end?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: This weather pretty much sums up my life. No end in sight and no clear direction.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I think... this fog's got something to do with that Mourning Aix!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You sure?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Every time the Aix flies into the fog, there's always thunder and lightning. My friends and I have all seen it...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Are you saying the Mourning Aix may have caused this fog?

speaker: Kim Phương
anh_en: You said you're looking into all this mess, so... you got any conclusions yet? When are we getting rid of this fog?

speaker: Kim Phương
anh_en: You're our best bet now. Please make it go away already!
We are on this case.
We'll figure it out.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Rest assured, we'll get to the bottom of it!

speaker: Kim Phương
anh_en: What the...? Who even are you?
Jiuyue... You came on too strong.
We just happened to overhear your conversation...
Please pardon the interruption. I'm a researcher from the Huaxu Academy on a mission to investigate the fog. Please, I need to learn more about what you've just said.
Yes, I'm a researcher from the Huaxu Academy on a mission to investigate the fog. Please, I need to learn more about what you've just said.

speaker: Họa Uyển
anh_en: Well... I guess there's no harm in telling you. It's not like I'm making it up.

speaker: Họa Uyển
anh_en: We've seen it many times now. The Mourning Aix enters the fog and stays there for a while. But once it gets out from there, a big lightning strikes, and the fog thickens.

speaker: Họa Uyển
anh_en: The Aix must have done something!

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: I-I just can't do it, Grandpa. I can't even get a melody going, and my cheeks are getting sore...

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Is just an ordinary leaf.
A leaf? You sure you can really play music with it.
Wow, that's indeed a big surprise.

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: See, Grandpa? They don't believe you either!
Shush! Go away, you brat.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Find a leaf and pinch it together on one side like this... hold the other side close to your lips. Now blow along the edge to make sounds. You may even change the pitch—
Sounds a lot like a bird's singing.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Indeed. You can turn anything in the world into an instrument as long as you've got the music in you. If you put your heart into it, you can even use it to express your feelings.
When we were young, we would sit on the cliff after a long day of work and play some simple tunes with the leaves.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: The Mourning Aix and the other bird TD rarely attacked anyone, and we'd watch the two always flying right beside each other off in the distance, back and forth like a lovely couple.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: That's because you're doing it wrong, kiddo!

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Some random fellow then suggested that we use the leaves to say hello. So we gave it a try, and to our surprise, not only did they understand us, they even eventually joined in singing to our tunes.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Boy, those were the chill and relaxing days.
So sad that the good times didn't last...
So now only one of the two TDs is left?
Yep. Good times never last.
Yep. All because of what happened afterwards...

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: There was a TD Outbreak... Every TD out there was hungry for the sounds. Human or not human, they'd tear everything to shreds.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Trying to protect its partner, one of the "birds" were attacked and chewed up alive by rampant TDs. The one that survived went mad later because of it, becoming the Mourning Aix we all know today.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Perhaps from its perspective, time forever froze at that moment. From then on, it lived like a zombie, denying and attacking all living things that approached it.

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: So... you're saying the reason why big "birdie" became the Mourning Aix, is because it lost its loved one?

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: Can we take a break for just a little... Huh? Are you here for my grandpa?

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: Like Mrs. Qiu. After Mr. Qiu passed away, she no longer made delicious rice cakes like she used to. Now they taste either salty or bitter.

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: A bit too early to be getting into these things for your age, don't you think, my boy?
You're quite smart.
Sometimes kids can see things grown-ups don't.

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: Hehe. I learned it all from Grandpa!
Why you little... You're in for it now. You'll be practicing extra hours as punishment!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: In time, one must accept their losses before truly moving on. It doesn't do to dwell on it.
But it's hard to move on from such losses.
Agreed. Very important to stay positive.
Yeah, it's tough. But there are things I'd always feel driven to do, no matter what.
Yes. But we can wait...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Things like... exploring the unknown! Like this investigation!
Amazing how you always find ways to talk about your research.
I knew you'd say that again.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Now, let's push on!

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: Well, I can't have you waiting on me. Ask away.

speaker: Tiểu Mục
anh_en: Hehe. Then that means I can take a breath for a while!

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: You little rascal... Ahem. What can this old man do for you, strangers?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Oh, it's nothing serious. We noticed you were teaching your grandson to play music on a leaf. Can it really make the Mourning Aix sing along with you?

speaker: Ông Bách
anh_en: Sure it can. It's something that was uniquely popular among us older generations. And all you need, get ready for it...

speaker: Dạ Quy Trẻ Tuổi
anh_en: W-what the...? Where'd all these Exiles come from?

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Ngông Cuồng
anh_en: Fellas, we take these guys out, and the supplies here are all ours!

speaker: Dạ Quy Điềm Tĩnh
anh_en: Tread carefully there. You're in a restricted area. Drop your weapons and back away! You have been warned!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Ngông Cuồng
anh_en: Pfft. We know you're bluffing. With your supply chain bogged down by Tacet Discord activities. You're spread thin in the city.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Ngông Cuồng
anh_en: We're not the only ones screwed over by the weather.

speaker: Dạ Quy Trẻ Tuổi
anh_en: Damn it! These thugs' got it all planned out... Hold line everyone. They're not getting through!
Can't let those thugs take the supplies.
Help first, questions later.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Thank you for your patience, Jiuyue, {PlayerName}. I hope you've enjoyed your stay here so far.

speaker: Khải Kiệt
anh_en: Father told me the wounded have been treated, and he is on his way here. Shall we head to our meeting place from earlier?
Sure. See you there!

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: Sorry for keeping you waiting.
What's the problem?

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: I'm aware that you must've done a great deal of research regarding the fog. Yet once you've gone inside, you'll soon realize that the reality is completely different.

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: *sigh* With all the TDs growing ever so restless, plus those weird "phantoms"... and the mud, it's all over the place...
Don't worry, it's nothing we can't handle.
We've got everything in control.
Jiuyue already told me all there is to it.
Yes. With {PlayerName} and I's unparalleled teamwork, there isn't a task we can't accomplish.
That's right, leave all the science to me. We won't set up to fail.
Hehe. I was just doing my job... After all, you are my partner in this investigation.
I understand that you have your reasons for your persistence. But still, do prioritize your safety above all else.
Qijie told me all about it. Let's go help the wounded.

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: Let me think... Here, I'll mark all the routes and locations I used to reach the facility on the map for you. Follow them closely, and you'll be safe.

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: Take all the supplies you need from the settlement before you go.
It's fine. We took the opportunity to learn about the situation.

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: As this fellow researcher had told me, you're here to ask about the Court of Savantae facility, correct?
According to the archives, the Court of Savantae once built a dedicated facility to study the origin of this fog. I guess it could be the one you've discovered.

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: A research facility for the fog... Hmm... That explains why the facility is equipped for observation, with environmental simulators and a central control panel in the center.
I tried using it. Was still in working condition, but it needed authorization credentials or something.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: No need to worry! The Huaxu Academy has dedicated procedures set in place when it comes to matters relating to the Court of Savantae. Prior to my departure, Mr. Xiangli Yao told me everything I needed to know.

speaker: Khải Thịnh
anh_en: I will share with you the coordinates of the facility. But... are you really planning on going there?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: According to Qisheng's map, we should be approaching the facility right about... There! There it is!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: TDs... They seem to be covered in... Is that mud from the marsh?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: And they're standing right in front of the entrance, of all places... Like last time, we should clear the mud before we deal with them!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Fantastic! Splendid work as usual, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Let's go inside. If we can gain access to the control panel, we should find further information about the facility and the suppressors.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: This must be the control panel Qisheng spoke of.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: By the looks of it, the facility has been abandoned for quite some time, and no one's tampered with these controls since.
Why was it abandoned?
What... happened to this place?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I... do not know. I failed to find any relevant information when I was studying the archives.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: But sometimes, research gets cut short because of funding, outside pressure, or other issues. It's not always the researchers' choice.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Our predecessors were unable to find an answer, but at least they left behind these clues. It's on us to keep their legacy alive and move forward.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hmm... It's is still in working condition, and there's enough backup power... Now, according to Mr. Xiangli Yao's instructions... Username, and then...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: There, I'm in!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Err... Classified documents of team SR-461? Sounds more like some kind of “code of conduct”... Then again, it also feels strange to be one...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: But on the bright side, thanks to this strange manual, I now have more information on suppressors. There are a total of <color=Highlight>three</color> devices... Downloading keycode... Logs... Done!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I have the keycode. You should keep a backup in your Terminal as well.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The keycode and the suppressors share a same operating system. With this information we can pinpoint their positions neglecting any interference. Now we won’t lose our way in the fog.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The roads ahead should grow increasingly smoother if we activate the suppressors sequentially.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Visibility is lower than I anticipated, and the readings are all over the place... So this is what it’s like to be in the fog...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It’s completely coated in mud... Top to bottom.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Related or not related, we have to clean the device, or we can’t figure out where its controls are, let alone have it up and running again.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: How about we make use of the vortex to give it a deep clean?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: A highly compressed jet of water should clean the mud off in one go!
Just like those TDs from earlier.
Ugh. Where did all this stuff come from?
Is this why the suppressors needed routine maintenance?
Yes. But unlike the TDs, which covered themselves with these substances as protective cover, the suppressors’ operations are completely disrupted by it.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: After we departed from the edges of the marshlands and now reaching the insides of the fog, there’s been a steady increase in our sightings of this corrosive substance. Could it be... that it also came from the depths of the fog?
Or is the source of the fog the composition of some kind of powerful energized substance?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: You remind me. Normal devices do not require monthly maintenance or even frequent activation to this extent. At the end of the day, most issues can be resolved remotely.
Unless when it’s an external issue like the one we have here, where actual manpower is required to intervene.

speaker: Dạ Quy Điềm Tĩnh
anh_en: Thank you for your help back there. Could have been a tough fight.

speaker: Dạ Quy Trẻ Tuổi

the avian TD with human emotions.
Both.

speaker: Jiuyue

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Although it may sound bizarre, but I think... that this should be the most reasonable possibility.

anh_en: Recall that researcher “12” mentioned in his log that the Mourning Aix's vital signs grew weak each time it left the fog.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Could it be that they were the ones that built this facility? We should watch the other video...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It never ceased providing energy for the source, even at the cost of its own well-being. It must think it’s a necessary sacrifice.
All for the sake of its partner?
The messages mentioned "reborn"...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The answer is rather clear now.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The source with strong energy fluctuations and an absence of vital signs that we detected in the depths of the fog is a likely indication the Mourning Aix is trying to resurrect the other avian TD.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: We may find remains of TDs gathered around it.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Resurrection... it’s out of the question beyond any doubt.

speaker: Jiuyue

anh_en: Emotion can be the most uncontrollable force... It can drive an individual to do anything, an can also be there to support them to stand up again and start anew.

You won't know unless you try.
Quick! Pull out your decoder!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: There. That’s the final suppressor.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Considering how the fog significantly dissipated on the outer perimeter. Activating this one, at the very least, should give us a clearer view of the source.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Intensity of energy fluctuations has reached peak numbers... The source of the anomaly. The accumulation of TD remains.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: According to existing theories on Echoes, the residual consciousness can be converted into Reverberation frequencies and stored into a Terminal. Then, with some tweeking, it can be reproduced as a projection to mirrior its original appearances.
How long can the projection last?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: An hour at most...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Since the remains were pieced together, the consciousness will be inferior to that of a real Echo, but an hour should be more than adequate for them to confess each other’s feelings.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Now, let’s use the Terminal to absorb the Reverberations from the remains.

We’ll help them get the farewell that they deserve.

anh_en: The reason for the “phantoms" ability to carry information owes to the scraps of consciousness of TDs inside the remains.

speaker: Jiuyue

anh_en: <color=Highlight>Jiuyue:</color> The debugging is complete, but we need your power to sustain the projection in the beginning—Wait! It's gone rogue!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: <color=Highlight>Jiuyue:</color> Where is it going... the remnants of Reverberation can't hold out too long... if it keeps up like this... Are we going to miss out on the last chance, too?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: <color=Highlight>Jiuyue:</color> Rover, please! Take the bird-shaped TD with you, catch up with it, and calm it down!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The bird-shaped TD relies on your power to keep resurfacing, and you guys finally catch up with the guy who is obsessed and refuses to wake up.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The madness disperses, and Mourning Aix finally seems to recognize the presence that has been chasing after it - the one it tried to resurrect, its former mate.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: And what's left is fleeting, time just for them.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It appeared where the wreckage had previously gathered, but not with a strong energetic reaction like the wreckage.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Jiuyue said it was like an egg that terminated hatching, left in place by Mourning Aix and the departed TD.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: At this moment, it is surrounded by sprouting buds and flowers, calm and silent. Perhaps this is the final destination of life after it has faded - to become one with all that is still growing.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: Hmm, let's give it another go... Low frequency to level 3... Getting minimal biological response. What if I set interference to half?

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: No, hold it, I need to hear it one more time... I didn't catch all of it...

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: ...Too late. The signal's already gone...
Am I allowed to talk now?
So, you're Jiuyue, right?

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: What? Oh, excuse me! I've been trying to understand this <color=Highlight>"phantom"</color>, and I got overexcited for a moment... And yes, please talk anytime you want!

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: I'm Jiuyue, a researcher studying the fog in Whining Aix's Mire, from the Academy. I've been researching TD Ecoacoustics in this area.
You can call me {PlayerName}.
{PlayerName}.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: {PlayerName}... I'll be sure to remember that name.
I believe you had a question for me? Please, do ask away.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: Waveband convergence rate at 67%, 70%... 75%... Steadily increasing. It's working!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Umm, I am. Yet I don't believe you and I are acquainted?
You can call me {PlayerName}.
{PlayerName}. Pleasure to meet your acquaintance.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I see... Ah, and what is it that you wish to ask of me?
As you may have realized, I'm in the middle of investigating the fog-related peculiarities of this area. If it's something unrelated, I'm afraid it'll have to wait.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Assist me? You're implying that you wish to accompany me in completing my research?
Medium long hair, pale and skinny... You must be Jiuyue?
Oh, you don't want my help?
Relax, someone already paid me.
Do you need to act surprised?
No, feel free to come along! Academia may have its rules, but research has no limits. If you have the drive and determination to seek knowledge, you can become a researcher at any time!
I see. The Rangers at the station have already made a formal request for you to assist me in my research. This means that you have already reached an agreement on this matter.
No, not at all. It's just that it's been a while since I have worked with anyone, so my reaction was a bit exaggerated.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: With some extra hands, we can accomplish more. I would definitely welcome your help. Besides, the people at the supply station can rest easy with you around.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I didn't mean to sneak out alone and leave them behind. I just couldn't bear to wait another second before trying out my idea.
Your idea? Like... what you were doing just now?
That thing by your side just now, was it a "phantom"?
What's that... thing?
Oh, that? That was merely... a small experiment in my research.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I was indeed looking for a way to enter the fog. It was until I actually met a phantom.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It was my first time seeing one in person. Definitely not the rumored Waveworn Phenomenon, but more like an information-filled body that could be decoded.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: So, what information does it carry, you may wonder? Could it be related to the cause of the fog?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: With this possibility in mind, I followed the "phantom" all the way here. Which leads to how I was using the decoder on my Terminal to decipher it.
A decoder... Sounds very high-tech.
I think I got it, and then again I don't.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Well, certainly. I've improved upon it myself, based on the rudimentary version at the Academy.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The new design can automatically recognize and analyze sounds, making it great for dealing with unknown sources like "phantoms."

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Um, you seem like you're even more confused than you were before? Ahhh, Hui told me not to overload people with principles and terms first thing when I meet them, and here I go again...
What are you doing?
Phew... Good thing you stopped yourself in time.
No worries. I'll take it as a science class on the spot.
Who's Hui?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hehe, Hui is my childhood friend. She is the most brilliant researcher I've ever laid eyes on... and my beautiful beloved wife.
Now you're just plain showing off.
Well, isn't that true love if I ever saw one...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Anyway... The Ecoacoustics theories are indeed quite complex, and it also involves information transcription and such. It's difficult to explain in just a few words.
Simply put, with this device, we can decipher what the "phantom" is saying.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hmm, it's hard to explain how this machine works in a few words. Basically, it helps us understand what the "phantom" is saying and what they mean. Kinda cool, right?

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: Shhh, shush...
But it doesn't seem to be working so well.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Uh, yeah. "You", "I", "Song", "Sky", "Love", "Sorrow"... these incoherent words comprise the entirety of its message, but the meaning they point to...

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: {PlayerName}, what do you make of these words?
They seem like a broken and encrypted poem.
I don't understand, but they sound beautiful somehow.
Doesn't sound like it has anything to do with the fog.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hmm? A poem?
Songs rise above the sky, as love overcomes sorrow.
Songs of you and I will rid the sky of sorrow.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I see... With your added interpretation, it does indeed appear more romantic. It's surprising to see that you have such a creative side.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: Be quiet. It's a crucial moment!
Guess we can rule out the possible connection between the "phantoms" and the fog out there. After all, those anomalies are nowhere near as beautiful as poetry.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Indeed these words evoke a gentle and comforting imagery.
Guess we can rule out the possible connection between the "phantoms" and the fog out there. After all, those anomalies are nowhere near as beautiful as poetry.
Perhaps you are right. At least for now, I cannot see any connection between the "phantoms" and the fog through these words.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Well, at least that's what I deduced from my first encounter with it. I might be proven wrong later on, which is also natural. For now, let's focus on how to get to the center of the mist.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I've been digging through all the data on Whining Aix's Mire, and I think I found a way to make it work. We just have to find the site, reboot the device, clear the fog, and investigate the source!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Luckily, I had brought the ultrasonic pulse chips with me before setting off, so I can share them directly with you.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The actions I just mentioned involve traversing through the marshlands, but don't worry, as long as we have these chips, we don't need to fear the tornado... Wait, where's my backpack?
What backpack?
I don't think you had a backpack when we met.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: You... Hmm. "You and I"... Sing... "Song"?
I'm referring to the backpack in which I keep the equipment for investigation.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Oh no, how can I lose a large backpack like that? All those things in the bag... What about the chips?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hmm... It was when I met you—no, it was when I was chasing the... Yes, I was chasing after the "phantom"... I got so caught up, I probably forgot my bag somewhere!
Good thing you remember where it is. Let's go find it.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Alright, we should make haste and return to where I was before.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: *sigh* I got way over my head back there. It's good to have additional verification for my deductions, but it's not right to let it interfere with our original plan.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Now I can see why Hui never lets me go on investigations on my own...

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The Rangers back at the supply station wanted to make sure you were safe. I'm here to help you with the investigation.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Thần Bí
anh_en: ...Sky... What's that supposed to mean? And what is the last word? Love... Sorrow?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Ahh... And there they go, flying off into the distance. Understandable, as they should make the most out of their final goodbye before their energy is completely exhausted.
I tried my best to maintain an objective view, but it seems I just couldn't help myself.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Aha! It was my reaction that’s led to the verification of your speculations. Very cunning, {PlayerName}!
Alas, I’m sure you’d know... Love is something that simply cannot be hidden from sight, especially since... Hui’s my most beloved sugar-plum in the whole universe.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Although Hui has parted this world for ten months and thirteen days... I still miss her so much.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: She was the greatest researcher of them all. She’d always venture deep into Tacet Fields to acquire the latest data on the TDs.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: If only I had been at her side that one time, death wouldn’t have separated us at least. In the end, I wasn’t there for her, so she never came back, and I... am remained here.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: To certain extent, what happened afterwards was comparable to that of the Mourning Aix.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I refused to accept her departure, and lived as though entirely stripped of life... I also held on to the illusion that as a researcher, I may be able to find a way to bring Hui back to my side.
She wouldn’t want you to if she’s here.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Yes. As Xiangli Yao had said to me as well.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: An unthinkable reunion they’ve been yearning for all this time... A reunion that not everyone has the luxury to experience.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: How can anyone bear to see the one you deeply love live in a daze? You’d wish them the best and move on.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Even though left alone, there’s no need to be depressed. All there is for me to do is to carry the memories we shared, our past, and continue to move forward and live a good life. This is what Hui would hope for me to do.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I’m sure its what the avian TD would tell the Mourning Aix in their goodbye.
I wonder how their farewell’s going.
Do you believe the Mourning Aix is capable of completely letting it go?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It's hard to say, but I’m hopeful that it’ll be happy ending.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: If its capable of garning the determination to ressurect the other at the cost of inflicting self-harm. Then... I’m sure it’ll find a way to move on following it’s companion’s wishes.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Naturally, the Aix will have to endure a period of pain before achieving it, and saying goodbye is the first step to a fresh new beginning.
And for you as well.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: By all means.
Are you talking about the Mourning Aix or...?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Oh, by the way, have a look at this... I found it after the fog had cleared. Judging by its form, it's the same as the maintenance logs of the first two suppressors. Instead of a research record, this one appears to be more like a draft of a message.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It's yet another emotionally biased writing. However... considering the things we encountered during the investigation, it seems rather fitting.
The person you wish to reunite... Hui?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hmm... Seems like you caught on to it.
It was obvious to tell from your words.
It’s an understanding only someone who’s experienced it can grasp.
It's just an educated guess.
You’re right. Love is something that simply cannot be hidden from sight, especially since... Hui’s my most beloved sugar-plum in the whole universe.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Mist, thunderstorms, and the so-called "phantoms", all of these anomalies are due to the Mourning Aix's obsessions.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The CSC seniors were right in judging that there may be a similar bond between TDs as there is with humans, and I was right in judging that you are a very dependable partner.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I wish I could have you as my research partner in the future... Unfortunately, we have to transmit back the data we collect from this operation first.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Anyway, leave the wrapping up and documenting to me. If you have a chance, come find me in Huaxu! Next time we meet, I'll be sure to bring Hoshi's share along and become even more awesome!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Jiuyue also made observations and frequency recordings of the "Bird Egg" left in the field.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Here! This is where I encountered the phantom!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: But I don't see my backpack... Maybe we should search the surrounding area?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: A golden feather and a barrier... They’re some kind of energy barrier, as if to protect something...

speaker: Âm Thanh Quen Thuộc
anh_en: Sizzle

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The familiar murmur is back, and this time "phantom" is unmistakably in front of you.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Let's see... Perfect, nothing seems to be missing.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Because of water temperature differences, there's a large <color=Highlight>vortex</color> deep in the marsh. It used to be considered a local spectacle, but now with the bizarre fog, it has stirred up dangerous <color=Highlight>mud</color> and spilled it everywhere.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: By installing these chips, we can utilize the resonance of ultrasonic pulses to dissolve the <color=Highlight>mud</color>.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: It's hard to explain, so let me show you. Watch that mud over there.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I'll demonstrate what I mean.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I'll be sure to keep a firm eye on it from now on!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Now... About the <color=Highlight>ultrasonic pulse chips</color> we've discussed earlier. Here, put it inside your Terminal.
What does it do?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Dear me. It appears you lack the necessary knowledge regarding the Mire. This calls for a science lesson!
Science lesson, yes. Complicated terms, no please.
I'm all ears, Professor Jiuyue.
No need to worry, this will not involve any complex principles.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: This place is called the Whining Aix's Mire. Named after the bird-like Tacet Discord, <color=Highlight>Mourning Aix</color>, that lives here. Additionally, as you can see, this place has a lot of marshes.

speaker: Dạ Quy Điềm Tĩnh
anh_en: Clear. Targets have been eliminated around the entrance perimeter. All units return to the vantage point for a thorough sweep.

speaker: Dạ Quy Trẻ Tuổi
anh_en: Thank... Thanks for the assistance, friend. We need to get back to our positions. See you topside!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Well? Rather effective, isn't it?
It's all yours, Professor Jiuyue.
Come on, enough with the suspense.
Ooh. Now you're making me nervous.
Alright, Alright.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I'm not sure if the Rangers at the station told you or not. But all this fog, thunderstorms, and that huge vortex I just mentioned? They didn't just show up overnight.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: The exact spot where it began is now covered in thick fog, so we do know where these odd events originated.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: But we still don't know what caused them in this supposedly deepest area. The fog's thick, and wandering into it without caution could mean getting lost forever.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I read that the <ano=CSC>Court of Savantae Committee</ano> once built a dedicated facility here. They even developed <color=Highlight>suppressors</color> to disperse the fog from the inside.
But the fog is still here.
You mentioned reactivating these suppressors earlier.
Easy as breeze

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Yes. Despite of the well-intended attempts of the CSC scholars, the research facilities were eventually abandoned. Without proper maintenance, the suppressors were down soon after and couldn't be located.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: With these in mind, our priority is to locate the <color=Highlight>abandoned facility</color> in order to acquire the <color=Highlight>suppressors'</color> position and their activation key.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: We'll reactivate the suppressors and dissipate the fog as we progress. We should uncover everything once we reach the deepest place.
Sure is a plan filled with twists and turns.
Is there no easier way?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I agree. Should any aspect of the plan not be executed properly, the entire plan may come to a halt.
However, isn't it part of humanity to not back down when faced with the unknown?  If there is a way, we shall try it out and eliminate the uncertainty along the way.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Hmm... that's all there is to it. If it could be easily resolved, it wouldn't have been a lingering problem that has troubled everyone for so long.
But on the other hand, when you think about it, if we can solve even such a challenging problem, aren't we incredibly capable?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I have confidence, as I won't be alone this time, you will be accompanying me.
Well, at least it does the job.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: This will be my first time working together with anyone other than Hui. As my wife, she has always taken care of me, and as a researcher, she is among the most passionate and outstanding individuals.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Though she's not with me here today, I trust I can successfully complete the investigation with you, my new partner!
Now I'm feeling pumped!
Fine, can't argue with your optimism.
So why isn't Hui with you this time?
Hahaha. Yes! This is the spirit of science!
I'll take that as a compliment.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Well... This isn't the first time. We've been apart for a while now. Sometimes, it just can't be helped, you know?
Anyway, when the situation is against us, all we are left to do... is to put ourselves to work!

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Now, without further ado, let us set out to the settlement closest to the fog.
I'll say it's got room for improvements.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: During my previous investigation, residents of that settlement mentioned someone named Qisheng who ran into an unknown CSC building while scavenging. It's likely the facility I've read about in the logs.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: I've arranged a meeting with him. We should inquire him about the facility's location.
As I predicted. You seemed like the adaptable type.
Good. Should we encounter more mud later on, do give it a few more runs. Practice makes perfect.
Ah, yes. I'm still optimizing its functionality and handling. But this current version is what we have that works. But do share your detailed feedback with me once we've completed the investigation.

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Now, with the chips installed, our prep work is nearly complete... Now back to the detailed plan of this operation. The first question —

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: How do we access the center of the fog for further investigations?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: That sound... Do you hear that, {PlayerName}?

speaker: Jiuyue
anh_en: Oh my...! B-behind you...It's the phantom!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yah-ha—!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ooh-la, ooh-la!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey-yah!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh-yah, oh-yah?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Mom, can't we keep the drawings on the big tree?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I know. It feels wrong to erase them. Hmm, what should we do then...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Such fine strokes and daring colors. Who could be the artist?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 4
anh_en: I say we just leave them as they are.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Remarkable... it's almost as if the expressive graffiti has brought these dull stone walls to life.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Grandpa, isn't calling graffiti "remarkable" a bit much? And it's in such a dangerous spot!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Eeya—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu seems to have sensed "Painter"—better keep up with her!

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}! What wind blows you here today?
Is that… graffiti?

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: There are more of them, and they aren't just any graffiti. I can feel a unique frequency lingering on them, likely from an Echo.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu seems to be fascinated by the graffiti, her eyes studying every mark with an intense curiosity.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: If anyone tries to clean up the graffiti, Chalulu will dash over to stop them.

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Ooh-la ooh-la ooh-la—ya-ha!
I never knew Echoes could paint.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: For Echoes with a strong urge to express themselves, graffiti might just be the easiest way.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: The question is, what is this kid trying to express? Makes you wonder, doesn't it?
Kid... that's an unusual way to put it.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Ah, excuse me! Let's call this one "Painter" then.
And what wind blows you here?

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Speaking of Echoes, your connection with them is truly something else. You probably understand their "thoughts" better than I ever could.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Could you photograph the artworks by Painter before they get wiped off? We might find something intriguing.
Alright, let's get started.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Egla Town is where I grew up. I always come back during the troupe's off-seasons.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: And this time, I've invited someone special to join me. Chalulu, go ahead and say hello to {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Eeya—ha!
We've met in the troupe.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Chalulu really seems to fancy you, {PlayerName}. You must have a charm that speaks to Echoes.

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Eeya—eeya!

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Easy there, easy. Seems like she can't wait to share her new discoveries with you. Look—

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Eeya-ha!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu points at the graffiti, as if reminding you to take a look at it now.

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Ooh-la ooh-la?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu is studying the graffiti, as if something's on her mind...

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Ya-hah!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu's expression brightens. Did she just realize something?

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Eeya! Eeya!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu looks very excited! The truth could be at hand now.

speaker: NPC #50046
anh_en: Ooh... Ooh-la, ooh-la...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chalulu's expression turns sad all of a sudden… What's troubling her?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A moon and a sword.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: This one seems to be depicting the "Night Reveries" of Egla Town.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: At night, the villagers lock themselves away, while the knight Tacet Discord rises, sword in hand, under the pale moonlight.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A sparkling eye... with a sword at its center?

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: The sword must mean something important to Painter.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: And the sparkling eye might be a symbol of hope, or admiration.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A knight's mask and swords on one side, a black mask and brushes on the other.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: The knight is the only hero in the story, and the black mask likely stands for the side characters.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: I'd bet three Pizza Classica that the black mask symbolizes the evil giant's underling.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A knight's mask, with crossing brush and sword.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: It seems to mean a face-off. The knight has to defeat the underling before the final battle with the giant.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A crying black mask, yearning for the brush it holds to turn into a sharp sword.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Chalulu is trying to wipe the tears from that mask.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: That brush is fashioned to look like a sword. Very interesting.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: That's all the graffiti Chalulu wanted you to see. Let's meet at the usual place, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: What kind of role do you imagine Painter plays in the "Night Reveries"?

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Eventually, as the first light of dawn broke, the knight felled the giant and his cursed underling. The Echoes then escorted the knight out of the town in cheers.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: But in a shadowed corner, the "felled" underling slowly rose, fumbling to remove his simple costume. Beneath it was no crazed minion—just a large, lonely Cuddle Wuddle.
It's a little heartbreaking.

speaker: NPC #50048
