speaker: NPC #100184
anh_en: I hope I'm not disturbing your work here, but today is Rakosan's birthday. I've made some dishes from our hometown and wanted to—
As you two are talking, Rakosan hurries over.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: What are you doing here? We talked about this. No celebrations until after the project! I don't have time for this!

speaker: NPC #100184
anh_en: But I got all the ingredients from—

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I said no! My birthday... How could I celebrate anything now...
Don't let Odette's kindness go to waste, Rakosan.
Happy birthday, Rakosan.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This pizza… It tastes just like the ones we had back in Rinascita. Thank you for making it, dear.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hehe, it's the least I can do for you.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: This pizza… It tastes just like the ones we had back in Rinascita. Thank you for making it, dear.

speaker: NPC #100184
anh_en: Hehe, it's the least I can do for you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You should have a proper celebration, Rakosan. It's also a way to honor the good wishes of the one who cares about you.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I know. But the only reason I can still celebrate my birthday… is because I survived. The others... those I worked with... were all lost in that Void Storm.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I was lucky not to be in the Observatory that day. But Dhalifa… I can hardly bring myself to think about her condition.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I'm sorry, Odette, but I can't celebrate my survival when others never had that chance. Let me just… finish the reconstruction first.

speaker: NPC #100184
anh_en: Rakosan…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Dhalifa's hungry! Dhalifa's hungry!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Shh—

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Dhalifa's hungry! Dhalifa's hungry!

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Then comes the gemberry sauce that blends with the sausage and cheese in a perfect, layered harmony. Every bite brings a new, lingering taste to savor, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Perfection.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: A pizza baked by a classic clay oven… absolutely perfect. My final verdict? Another one, please, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Wow... that was a real gourmet review right there.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Shh—
Look what I brought you, Dhalifa!
The pizza is fragrant enough to bring something resembling a grin to Dhalifa's face.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Smells so good...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: The warmth wraps the air in an irresistible aroma. Just the scent alone paints a picture of how it'll taste, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Crunchy.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Crispy crust and gooey cheese meet each other in a small bite, bursting with flavor that dances across my tongue, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Rich flavor.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Those railings that trapped the Ironhoof… They don't look Royan. I should look into it.)

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Thanks for helping us out! Seriously, if you've got any questions, just fire away!
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Right now, we're in the Foundation Phase. Basically, we're fixing the baseplates you see around us. They're part of the energy conversion array.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: My plan is to split the whole project into three phases. First, we lay the foundation and power grid. Second, we erect the Suspension Platform. Third, we construct the main Signal Panels and Projection Ring.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Given the Observatory's sheer size and the advanced tech involved, it's going to take a lot of effort. But I'm sure we can pull it off together, {PlayerName}!
I have other questions to ask.
How long have you known Dhalifa?
How's the reconstruction going?
I'm good. Thank you.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: A couple of years, I'd say. But before all this happened, we'd only met a few times. Just acquaintances, really.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I was just in charge of routine maintenance, y'know, fixing the little things that broke around here. But Dhalifa was a core member of the Navigation Department!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Her team was the one steering the whole Observatory, lining up the main dish with survey targets. I heard her manual precision was even better than the computer's targeting modules!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You're leading the project now. That's pretty impressive too.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Thanks for the compliment! But honestly... I just landed this job by chance.

speaker: NPC #701060
anh_en: You won't believe how busy the route network is now, {PlayerName}! It's all thanks to you!

speaker: NPC #701060
anh_en: So many departments that wanted to help can finally get their supplies through! With their support, we've already wrapped up all the prep-work for the first phase!

speaker: NPC #701060
anh_en: These beautifully designed baseplates are ready to be deployed anytime. We're just waiting on you to come and give the final "all-clear" before we power them up!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's different this time, Sephira! The reconstruction is going really well now! Don't even think about interfering again!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You say that every time. I'm not here to argue with you again. I just want to see Dhalifa.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: It's different this time, Sephira! The reconstruction is going really well now! Don't even think about interfering again!

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: But I do have Exoswarm to tend to. As for you, Rakosan, I hope your big project fails spectacularly.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: You are just here to start a fight, aren't you?!
Humming softly, Sephira turns away and leaves.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Finally, she's gone… Anyway, {PlayerName}, we're all set to kick off the Foundation Phase and expand the baseplates. As for Dhalifa… if Sephira's here, she probably brought the villagers with her.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Dhalifa's likely gone to meet them. Could you fetch her? We'll need her here in case anything goes wrong.
Of course. I'll go get her.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: You say that every time. I'm not here to argue with you again. I just want to see Dhalifa.
We've got a new helper?

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: You could say that. She's Dhalifa's childhood friend, though for the life of me, I can't figure out why she's so against this project.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: I said I just—Ugh, never mind. Hello, the name's Sephira. I'm a Shepherdess.
{PlayerName}. Nice to meet you, Shepherdess Sephira.
I'm {PlayerName}. Any Exoswarm with you today?

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: Hehe, interesting name. I will remember you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: You know our Royan customs. I will remember you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Energy detected transferring into baseplates. Foundation Phase initiation imminent. Time to go, Dhalifa! Time to go, Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Energy detected transferring into baseplates. Foundation Phase initiation imminent. Time to go, Dhalifa! Time to go, Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: I will. After the reconstruction.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Thanks for the concern, {PlayerName}. The baseplate expansion siren just went off. Let's go, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Alright. I'll contact Rakosan and let him know we're fine here.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The baseplates are ready to expand, Dhalifa. It's not safe to stay here.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: I see. Thank you. Restore the network.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Thank you so much for restoring the route network. People from all over Lahai-Roi have come to deliver supplies. It's been so long since I've talked to this many people, says Dhalifa!
You're speaking more than before.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Communicate? Talk with people. Getting better.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I'm surprised, too. The doctor didn't find any brain injuries, so we still don't know why my speech is affected like this.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I thought I'd be like this forever, but it's getting better! Maybe one day I'll be able to talk without Talkie. Then it can focus on helping more with the project, says Dhalifa!
Will you go for a check-up then?

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Finally… Just two more phases to go. I can finally—

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Sephira… They—

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: {PlayerName}, that's Sephira's village! It's really close!
Don't worry, I'm on it.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Ahem… Sorry, got a little choked up there. Thank you, {PlayerName}. We never gave up, but we were totally stuck before you came. This project would've taken us years.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Foundation Phase, complete. Platform Phase, begin.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Up next, we rebuild the Suspension Platform! This thing has to hold the entire main Observatory, plus be our main workspace. It's a huge job!

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: We'll need more resources and time, but we'll make the most of the opportunity you've given us, says Dhalifa!
Aren't you going to rest?

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: You. Need rest. Spacetrek Observatory. Can't wait.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: You're the one who needs a break! You've done so much! The Spacetrek— [TRANSLATION INTERRUPTED] Detected: Sephira's Exoswarm herd rampage.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Multiple injuries detected in the Royan settlement north of the Observatory.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The settlement is right near where I just saw Dhalifa! No time to lose!

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: {PlayerName}! The Lightbeam Fencing is losing power! I can't—

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: There's a faint Threnodian frequency coming from this Ironhoof...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll look into that later. For now, I'll let it tire itself out by ramming into the Lightbeam Fencing.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: Nice to meet you, {PlayerName}! I'm KU-Raji, and I'll be supporting your work in Lahai-Roi from the Black Shores.
Abby's Life: Ehehe!

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Abby's Life: Hello!

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Abby's Life: Ehehe!

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: Alright! Let's get to it. There's a giant facility built in the mysterious and rather dangerous land of Lahai-Roi—the Spacetrek Observatory.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: The Spacetrek Collective once used it to observe and record everything happening in the region. But a Void Storm struck years ago and left it in ruins. Repairs have been... slow, to say the least.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: Since its functions align with those of the Black Shores, and with all the unusual activity of the Threnodian in the region lately, bringing the Observatory back online could really help us handle future crises.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: So, we'd like you to head over, check on the site, and see how we might assist with the repairs.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: Oh, and there's one more thing. There's a girl there, using her Forte to keep the place running, all on her own.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: A lone girl living among the ruins… Hm, she might need a helping hand too, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #701059
anh_en: It's a little nerve-wracking, honestly… but also exciting to finally work with an elite Bloombearer like you!
Abby's Life: Hello!

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: Good job! It'll collapse any time now!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The Threnodian frequency is gone...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I should report this to KU-Raji. The Black Shores can run a full analysis on it.)

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: Thank you. I could tell you were trying to stop it without hurting it. There's something special about you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: I know it means a lot to her, but...

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: Forget it. Thank you again, {PlayerName}.
I'm just a random biker.
What's wrong with this Ironhoof?

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: Heh, funny. And humble too.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: I'm not sure. I thought it'd go berserk like those other crazed Exoswarm, and we'd have no choice but to... well, you know.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: That Ironhoof only lost it right after you people installed those big baseplates. Normally, that level of noise wouldn't have startled it...

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: See? They never should have started rebuilding that Observatory. And Dhalifa...
What about her?

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: …Nothing. I just wish she'd come home to us. If the Observatory comes back online, she'll probably just stay there forever.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Are they really going to finish it...? What am I supposed to do now...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Phew... I can't wait to tell everyone I got launched by an Ironhoof and lived to tell the tale!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Did you see that person who jumped the fence and tamed the Ironhoof? {Male=He's;Female=She's} so cool...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah, yeah! Just get yourself patched up first!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Lightbeam Fencing? Why do we even use it? It's what those lowlifes use to hurt the Exoswarm!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ironhoof? Why?

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Ironhoof? Why?

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: That day. People with the Exoswarm. Ma and Pa. They missed me.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: That day, a group came by with some Exoswarm. I don't remember their reason for being here, but I remember my parents' faces in the crowd. They waved at me, said it felt like ages since they'd seen me... that they missed me, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: I listened. Pa, healthy. Ma, pregnant. Void Storm, coming.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I was leaning against a mech reindeer, and Pa was saying how the Spacetrek Collective's medicine was working well. Ma was saying I'd soon have a little brother or sister. And then... that familiar roar sounded, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Forte and Exoswarm material. Saved me.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: When I came to my senses, Exoswarm material covered all the places I was injured. The doc said I might've Overclocked my Forte. I think... I must have used it to absorb the Exoswarm's components, stealing its functions. That's how I managed to survive, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Me. Only me. Survived.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I was the only survivor. Only me... says Dhalifa.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't feel guilty. It's a good thing you survived.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sephira said she didn't know what caused its rampage either. But don't worry, I've already asked my friends to look into it.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Thank you...
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Talkie. In the Academy. Looked after me.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: After the Void Storm, I recovered at Startorch Academy. That's where I met Talkie. It's been by my side ever since, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Good friend. Protected me. Damaged.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: One day, it jumped in front of a Hauler to warn it away from me. Got knocked into the water. By the time they got it out, the damage was extensive, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Linked. Understands me.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I couldn't bear to lose Talkie, too. I used my Forte on it, and somehow, it triggered a Bridge. After that, it was like our systems linked up! It could read my thoughts. Though, uh... it did get a bit chattier, says Dhalifa!
A Bridge?

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Bridge... Static...

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: {PlayerName}. Good person. Protected Ironhoof and us.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: My Forte lets me control a mech's behavior, but the results are unpredictable. At its worst, it causes what I call 'Static,' and at its best, it forms a kind of 'Bridge.' But it never does anything totally impossible,  says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Accelerate...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Like, if I use my Forte on a vehicle, I might be able to make it move for a bit without it using any energy. But it's not like I can instantly teleport mechs somewhere, says Dhalifa!
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Sephira. My dearest friend.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Before I joined the Observatory, Sephira was always there for me. She took care of me during my time at the Academy. Handled all the paperwork, too, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Sephira. Care about me.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Maybe my current condition is too much for her to accept. She thinks I never should've taken this job. With the Observatory destroyed, she believes I should just go home, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: The Spacetrek Observatory. Needs me. She doesn't understand.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: But she doesn't understand how much the Spacetrek Observatory means to me. I want to stay and rebuild it, to keep working here, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I saw how you leapt into the fence without hesitation, just to help everyone and save the Ironhoof. Not many could do that. Thank you, says Dhalifa!
You should tell her how you feel.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Perhaps. In the future.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I will. But for now, what matters most is the reconstruction, says Dhalifa!
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: See you. Work together.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Communicate. Any questions?
So, you survived the Void Storm?
How does Talkie know what you're thinking?
Do you know why Sephira doesn't want the Observatory to be reconstructed?
I'm good. Thank you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You can relax. Aid will arrive very soon.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: You can relax. Aid will arrive very soon.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You're leading the project now. That's pretty impressive too.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Thanks for the compliment! But honestly... I just landed this job by chance.
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Next up is the Platform Phase! We're building a massive, floating Suspension Platform right in the center. It's going to be the heart of the entire operation!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: The whole project has three phases. With the foundations complete, we'll get started on the Suspension Platform. The final phase will be to construct the main Signal Panels and Projection Ring.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Given the Observatory's sheer size and the advanced tech involved, it's going to take a lot of effort. But I'm sure we can pull it off together, {PlayerName}!
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Of course. The Roya are Lahai-Roi's natives. The Collective couldn't do half its research here without their help, and we still learn new things from them every day.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: The Observatory itself worked better than anyone expected, all thanks to their input. And Dhalifa, the Navigation Department's star? She's Roya!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: But honestly, even without those reasons, we'd still help anyone in need!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}, I saw how you being bounced around in there! Haha, I knew you were something else from the moment we met!
I have other questions to ask.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: You're welcome. I'll stay here to tend to the injured. Just come find me if you have any other questions.
How long have you known Dhalifa?
How's the reconstruction going?
Will the Spacetrek Collective send aid to treat the injured?
I'm good. Thank you.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: A couple of years, I'd say. But before all this happened, we'd only met a few times. Just acquaintances, really.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I was just in charge of routine maintenance, y'know, fixing the little things that broke around here. But Dhalifa was a core member of the Navigation Department!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Her team was the one steering the whole Observatory, lining up the main dish with survey targets. I heard her manual precision was even better than the computer's targeting modules!

speaker: NPC #100153
anh_en: That's Dhalifa's robot, no? The little rascal who abandoned the village!

speaker: NPC #100153
anh_en: Crush it!

speaker: NPC #100154
anh_en: Violence detected! Please stop attacking immediately! Please—HELP ME!

speaker: NPC #701060
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Word about you has been spreading everywhere... Or more specifically, every "road," heh! Everyone using the restored routes in Lahai-Roi knows it was you who fixed them.

speaker: NPC #701060
anh_en: And it's not just us. People all over have benefited from your efforts.

speaker: NPC #701060
anh_en: But anyway, back to business. The Platform Phase is ready to go. It's an even bigger project than expanding the baseplates. Same as before, we won't start anything without you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Thanks to {PlayerName}, we gathered all the materials for the Suspension Platform in record time!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Welcome back, {PlayerName}. We're ready.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Thanks to {PlayerName}, we gathered all the materials for the Suspension Platform in record time!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Wh-what?! How?! Was it the blueprint? The rotation axis? The circuit board?! No way... we checked everything a million times!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Don't panic. Run diagnostics.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Please calm down, Rakosan. Our preparation was flawless. This isn't an engineering failure. Something else must have happened. Just let Talkie connect to the Terminal and run a full diagnostic, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I wish I had your confidence… I'm just—just an ordinary—

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Error! Error! Abnormal damage detected across the Observatory. Cause assessment: SABOTAGE. Repeat—SABOTAGE.
Show me the most recent damage, Talkie.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Command accepted. Command accepted.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I-I'll check the other areas with Dhalifa. Be careful, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Oh, take this Geospider. Its scanning system might come in handy.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Welcome back, {PlayerName}. We're ready.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Welcome back, {PlayerName}. Supplies have been pouring in, and Rakosan has asked the Collective to send over more helper robots. It's been ages since this place felt so alive, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: That's right! The Suspension Platform has been built. All that's left is to activate it. Are you ready?
Let's do it!

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you... the Suspension Platform!

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Dhalifa is speechless!

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Proceeding to damage site. Proceeding to damage site.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Abnormal current detected! Abnormal current detected!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This must be the source of the problem. Time to scan with that Geospider Rakosan gave me.)

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Zip Zaps! Aaaahhh—don't take my power—

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: Dhalifa, I...

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: And what if another Void Storm strikes again and wipes everything out? What if you…? The thought alone is too horrible!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Sephira. I understand your—

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: No, you don't! If you really did, you'd come home with me right now!
You have to give her an answer, Dhalifa.
This isn't something that can wait until after the reconstruction, Dhalifa.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: I see. Sephira. I'll go with you.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Sephira. You shouldn't.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Rakosan, and I… so many people have worked so hard to rebuild the Observatory. You can't be doing this, Sephira! says Dhalifa.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: I don't care what you say about us, but sabotaging our equipment? You've crossed a line! You're not walking away from this without taking responsibility!
You can tell us what you really think, Sephira.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: {PlayerName}... Alright. Dhalifa, I... I just want you to come home.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: When you left back then, people already spoke ill of you. Now you're hurt because you stayed, and what happened to your Ma and Pa...

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: I thought you would come back after the incident, but you didn't... And if they finish rebuilding it, you'll never leave!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Sephira. The Roya. The Exoswarm. Our architecture and culture… must be protected.

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Warning! Warning! Vital signs unstable! Dhalifa needs rest! Let me translate! Let me translate!
Sephira, do you see Dhalifa's determination now?

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: …I know. I've always known. Every Roya knows how terrifying the Void Storm is. And I know better than anyone how hard Dhalifa and the Spacetrek Collective have fought against it.

speaker: NPC #100159
anh_en: I know what you're doing is for the greater good, but I'm not like you two. I just want to keep my best friend safe.
You can't protect Dhalifa by sabotaging her work.

speaker: NPC #100159

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: My Forte...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: When I came to my senses, Exoswarm material covered all the places I was injured. The doc said I might've Overclocked my Forte. I think... I must have used it to absorb the Exoswarm's components, stealing its functions. That's how I managed to survive, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Only me...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I was the only survivor. Only me... says Dhalifa.

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Need a hand? Just say the word! We're all in this to get the Observatory back on its feet! says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Friend...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: One day, it jumped in front of a Hauler to warn it away from me. Got knocked into the water. By the time they got it out, the damage was extensive, says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Connected...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: I couldn't bear to lose Talkie, too. I used my Forte on it, and somehow, it triggered a Bridge. After that, it was like our systems linked up! It could read my thoughts. Though, uh... it did get a bit chattier, says Dhalifa!
A Bridge?

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Bridge... Static...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: My Forte lets me control a mech's behavior, but the results are unpredictable. At its worst, it causes what I call 'Static,' and at its best, it forms a kind of 'Bridge.' But it never does anything totally impossible,  says Dhalifa!

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: Accelerate...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: Like, if I use my Forte on a vehicle, I might be able to make it move for a bit without it using any energy. But it's not like I can instantly teleport mechs somewhere, says Dhalifa!
I have other questions to ask.
So you survived the Void Storm?

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: See you. Good luck...
How does Talkie know what you're thinking?
I'm good. Thank you.

speaker: NPC #100158
anh_en: The Exoswarm...

speaker: NPC #100155
anh_en: That day, a group came by with some Exoswarm. I don't remember their reason for being here, but I remember my parents' faces in the crowd. They waved at me, said it felt like ages since they'd seen me... that they missed me, says Dhalifa!

anh_en: They...

Yangyang's Letter

Still haven't learned that song from last time... Grandpa said he's going to hire a musician from Mengzhou City to teach me, but I'm kind of over it. I should tell him soon so he doesn't waste his money.

...

Grandpa took me to Xuanfang Hold today. It's huge and impressive! So much good food and fun stuff. On the way back, I saw someone flying in the sky on a sword... Was that a real Transcendent?

...

Duzhong taught me a few moves today. He said I'm a natural! I think so too. Swinging swords and spears is way more fun than playing the liuqin. If I can get into the Ministry of War, it'll really make Grandpa proud.

...

The exam results are out! The examiner said my scores are good enough to work at the Mengzhou City branch. I've only been there once. It's very different from Xuanfang, and I'm not sure how I feel about it... But moving somewhere new could be fun. 
Grandpa and the elders want me to go, but if I leave, who's going to take care of him? He doesn't have any kids of his own. I'm all he has.
It's a lot to take in. I need more time to think.

...

When that Tacet Discord pushed me off the cliff, I thought I was dead for sure. I can't believe I became a Resonator! Controlling wind is actually quite handy. Just one thing... why did my Tacet Mark have to appear on the back of my neck? I can't even see it...

...

Qingyan keeps asking me to teach him a few moves. Our sister won't allow him to practice martial arts. She wants to send him to school to study instead... I can understand where she is coming from, but he is just a kid. We should let him decide his own future.

Speaking of which, his birthday is coming up. He has been dreaming of having his very own wooden sword. I should head over to Mengzhou City on my next day off and have a carpenter there craft one for him.

But if I give him that, Sister will probably scold me again... Well, whatever. Worst-case scenario, I will just buy her a few nice fragrant pouches to help her cool off.

Brother Qian,

The doctor from Mengzhou City came yesterday. He said there's no curing it anymore. Just leave it to fate now.

To have a daughter so late in life was already my greatest joy. It breaks my heart that I won't see Liangyu grow up. But I don't blame heaven or fate. I just feel for my child. As a father, I've let her down.

I know my time is short. A few more months, maybe, and I'll follow her mother. When I'm gone, please look after Liangyu. Keep her safe. Let her grow strong. If you can do this for me, I'll rest easy...

Please start your journey to Mengzhou soon. Keep moving forward, and don't look back.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Come to think of it, there's only one Chamber left to explore. I'll finally get to see my master soon. I'm so nervous...

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are you really an Autopuppet?

speaker: NPC #1316

speaker: NPC #750584
anh_en: Patrol location error. Awaiting return.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Heheh. That depends on how you look at it, doesn't it? And just so you know, my master is a "human-like" Autopuppet too, like me.

speaker: NPC #750584
anh_en: Patrol location error... Patrol... Ensure personnel safety.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Looks like it's developed a new problem... Anyway, we're different from this kind of Autopuppet.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: W-w-w-what's happening?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Master, I'm coming to find you right now!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Massive... Autopuppet...

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Ah, you're back! I heard you the moment you stepped into the foyer!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Data from all five Chambers has been collected...

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: This deep shaft in the center leads to the Sunken Warren. Oh my goodness, I can't believe I'll finally see my master!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Sorry, I got a little too excited... So, did you find out why this Autopuppet came here?
Not yet...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Not yet... Could I go down with you to this Sunken Warren and take a look? Maybe there are clues there, too.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Of course! I tinkered with a few of its parts, so it'll stay put here for now.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Well then, let's go together!

anh_en: Intelligence reports an anomalous event in the current area.

speaker: NPC #350274
anh_en: A Kernel Puppet frequently leaves its assigned patrol zone to linger around Fogveil Pagoda.

speaker: NPC #350274
anh_en: Event Status: Insufficient intelligence.

speaker: NPC #350274
anh_en: Recommended Action: Investigate available clues and locate the Kernel Puppet. Determine the cause of its interest in Fogveil Pagoda.

I'll find some time to look into it.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Okay, I'll keep a lookout for this Kernel Puppet.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Okay, I'll keep a lookout for this Kernel Puppet.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I can't believe it's this huge down here! It's like they built an entire underground palace!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: My master and I built all this, you know. The elevator we're riding in is called Fogveil Shaft, and it's the only passage connecting the Sunken Warren to the surface.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: We've made it to the Sunken Warren!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: My master is just up ahead. Let's go find him together.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Who goes there?

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: My name is T-G0NG. The Sunken Warren is fraught with danger. You would do well not to linger.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Apprentice, escort this guest back.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: But Master, I want to retrieve the data down in the Fogveil Pivot.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: But {Male=he;Female=she} is not the one we are looking for.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Even if that's true, we can still give {Male=him;Female=her} all the data from the Fogveil Pivot to bring to the people of Xuanfang.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: You are being naive, Apprentice. The route to the Fogveil Pivot is treacherous. How can you be certain {Male=he;Female=she} will survive the journey?

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Moreover, we cannot involve an innocent civilian in such danger.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: If {Male=he;Female=she} can't do it, I'll go to myself. I'll bring the data back... Master, we've already waited for too long!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: We don't even know if the others are alive or dead... We can't wait anymore. We have to find a way to contact the outside world!

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: ENOUGH!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master!

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Still as blind to the bigger picture as ever? Have you forgotten why we have been waiting here?

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: How could I forget! We gave up everything for this. It's been over a hundred years within Fogveil Pagoda's walls...

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: And after all this time, only {Male=he;Female=she} has been able to reach this place. If we let this chance slip by, how much longer will we have to wait?

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: I have to seize this chance.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Hmph...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: T-G0NG lets out a deep, heavy sigh, then falls silent.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Your master is quite the sight...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: So it is you, my apprentice! Since you are here, the one at your side must be the person who came to collect the data?
I'm here to investigate.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hello, I'm here investigating a wayward Autopuppet.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: AN OUTSIDER?! HOW DID YOU GET HERE?

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master! Please, this is our guest. {Male=He;Female=She}helped me gather all the Chamber data. That's how I was able to come see you.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I see...

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Just now, your master mentioned someone you're both waiting for. Who are they?

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: An old comrade. We made a promise back then that one day, he would come back to find us.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Well now... You know the Chambers you explored earlier are where I kept my work records.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Now I need to go into the various zones of the Sunken Warren to retrieve my master's records. But this place is far more dangerous than any of the Chambers.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master was right. We shouldn't drag innocent people into this... If you don't want to come, don't feel like you have to.
It's okay.
Let's set out together.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll go with you, and I'll keep an eye out for clues about that Autopuppet along the way.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Thank you... Then let's look out for each other. We need to be very, very careful!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: T-G0NG didn't seem too happy to see us.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: My master doesn't mean any harm... He just takes his duty very seriously.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: So, about what he and I just talked about... Surely, you have a lot of questions?
About the data you mentioned...
About the person you're waiting for...
No more.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Speaking of the data you mentioned... could that Autopuppet be trying to sneak in and steal it?

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Not likely... To anyone not in the know, that data would just look like a string of garbled code.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Ahead is the Lockpit. Any Tacet Discords that wander into Fogveil Pagoda, along with any abnormal Autopuppets, get put away in there.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: There could be a lot of enemies in this area. We need to keep our eyes peeled.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: So many cages! And look at all the Tacet Discords inside of 'em!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ah! One got out!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: This doorway seems to be missing a few components... Let's search higher up.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: This is it! Let's head back and open the doorway!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: This is the passage meant for shuttling Tacet Discords. The Censure Cages containing them are transferred through here to other areas.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: We were just in the Lockpit, where all the Tacet Discords are held. Those Censure Cages then get transported in an orderly manner down to the lower levels.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Come on, I'll show you around.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Looks like no one's been here in ages... Huh? I think I caught a whiff of an Autopuppet!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Feels like it's being sneaky... Could be the one they mentioned in WavesLine! Let's go in and take a look!

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: I never thought I'd see it again. Feels both unfamiliar and... nostalgic.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: The Censure Cage's shuttling passage seems to be down. Let's see if we can fix it.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Realign these shuttling passages, and that should fix it.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: All set! This passage will take us to the final area!

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: The Censure Cages from the Lockpit eventually reach it. It's where Tacet Discords get exterminated.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Let's go!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Oh no! How'd this stupid passage trap me?!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: I'm not a Tacet Discord! Don't roast me!

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Thanks... I almost got turned into a "toast-bot" back there...
How did you get trapped in there?

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Thankfully, I got all the data. Couldn't have done it without you.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: I'll hand these over to you for now. After all, whether it's the Chamber or the Sunken Warren data, we only managed to collect it thanks to you!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Now, let's go tell Master the good news!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: There might be Tacet Discords on the way back too, so be careful!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master, the brave guest and I got the data! Can I head to the Fogveil Pivot now?
Please, go ahead.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Now that you have obtained the three data sets from the Chambers, the Lockpit, and the Purging Mill, we need only reach the Fogveil Pivot to integrate them into one.

speaker: NPC #750585

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Should we ultimately reach the Pivot, would you be willing to take the data and deliver it, on our behalf, to the one who once vowed to come?

speaker: NPC #750585

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Don't take on any more work... We should get some proper rest.

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750585

speaker: NPC #750585

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Let's go!

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: I was just now preparing the means to counter them.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master...

speaker: NPC #750585

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master, stop beating around the bush! If you wish to help us, just say so!

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: ...Brave guest, there is one more matter in which I would ask your aid.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Brave guest... hold on tight!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: So this room can turn into an elevator, too!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: The Autopuppet guarding the Pivot has appeared!

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Brave guest, I will aid you!

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master, careful! Don't twist the shaft by accident!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Whoa! This thing's huge, too!

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: So many defensive Autopuppets...

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: It's finally over! That was one rough trip...

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: So that is how it is...

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Long ago, our old comrade made us a solemn promise right there in Yuan Fortress.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: We built Fogveil Pagoda to validate in advance the procedures for the locking, the shuttling, and the purging of Tacet Discords. All of it.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: And by the original plan, our work records were meant to serve as the data supporting Xuanfang Hold's construction.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: But more than a hundred years have passed... and that person never came.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: Now, hearing from you that Xuanfang Hold stands completed, I suppose we have achieved what we set out to do...

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: All that is left is for us to find a new path forward...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A WavesLine message suddenly interrupts your conversation.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: This is where the Fogveil Pivot lies.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: But there is one more question I would ask of you, brave guest.

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: How fares Yuan Fortress now?
Yuan Fortress?

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master... you already knew, didn't you?

speaker: NPC #750585
anh_en: I want an honest answer.

anh_en: Master...

Qiaoling and Tiangong...

anh_en: Qiaoling and Tiangong... Were those your original names?

anh_en: So all along, this Autopuppet was trying to... No, our comrade Xinli was trying to get in and tell us that all is well in Xuanfang Hold...

anh_en: Xinli, you've carried a heavy burden all these years...

speaker: NPC #750584
anh_en: ...Tiangong... The Tacet Discord offensive has already reached Yuan Fortress. Xuanfang Hold's defenses have activated ahead of schedule.

speaker: NPC #750584
anh_en: I'm sorry. I couldn't reach Fogveil Pagoda in time... But your experiments offer invaluable practical reference. You are heroes of Xuanfang!

speaker: NPC #750584
anh_en: ...Agh! Qiaoling, Tiangong...Yuan Fortress may fall. We've already prepared for the worst...

speaker: NPC #750584

anh_en: Now that we know Xuanfang Hold has been completed, we can finally be at ease.
Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Master has always been stubborn, but he never used to be this reclusive... He's just been alone for too long.

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: Brave guest, could you go to the Fogveil Pivot and retrieve our source data for us?

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This should be Q-L1NG and T-G0NG's data... I'll take it back to the Lexicon Axis in the city.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It seems something wandered into the foyer again...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Placing it here... that should do it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: When I have time, I'd like to go back to Fogveil Pagoda to see how Q-L1NG and T-G0NG are doing......

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Q-L1NG isn't here... I'll try looking in the Sunken Warren.

anh_en: Brave guest, you're back!

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750583

speaker: NPC #750584

speaker: NPC #750585

speaker: NPC #750583
anh_en: If you're out on the tundra and spot a lone portal, that might be a Chamber entrance.
